jobs.excerpt: SitusAMC is where the best and most passionate people come to transform our client’s businesses and their own careers.
jobs.description:
SitusAMC is where the best and most passionate people come to transform our client’s businesses and their own careers. Whether you’re a real estate veteran, a passionate technologist, or looking to get your start, join us as we work together to realize opportunities for everyone, we proudly serve.

At SitusAMC, we are looking to match your unique experience with one of our amazing careers, so that we can help you realize your potential and career growth within the Real Estate Industry. If you are someone who can be yourself, advocate for others, stay nimble, dream big, own every outcome, and think global but act local – come join our team!

The Legal Operations AVP will report to VP, Legal Operations and serve as dedicated project management and coordination resource supporting initiatives across the Legal and Chief Administrative Officer functions. This role will provide structured tracking, documentation, and cross-functional coordination for enterprise data governance efforts and other projects within the function’s project portfolio. The position ensures disciplined project execution, milestone management, policy documentation support, and consistent reporting across multiple concurrent initiatives.

This position is ideal for a highly organized, analytically strong professional with experience in project management, legal environments, data governance, and regulatory compliance frameworks. The Legal Operations AVP will play a central role in coordinating and documenting standards across the enterprise.

Essential Job Functions

Enterprise Data Governance Support

  • Support execution of the Enterprise Data Governance & Lifecycle Risk Program, including discovery and data classification initiatives.
  • Maintain structured governance dashboards tracking deletion backlogs, retention compliance, and milestone progress.
  • Coordinate cross-functional governance working sessions across Legal, IT, InfoSec, business lines and other functional areas.
  • Assist in maintaining data glossary documentation and coordinating Data Champion engagement across business units.
  • Support training materials and governance awareness initiatives.
  • Assist in integrating governance metrics into enterprise reporting structures.

Legal Operations & Project Management

  • Maintain trackers and structured reporting for concurrent legal and governance projects.
  • Design and maintain executive-level status reports and KPI dashboards, leveraging Excel, SharePoint, and reporting tools to deliver real-time visibility into governance initiatives, risk metrics, and milestone performance.
  • Coordinate communications between Legal, IT, business stakeholders, and third-party vendors, when necessary.
  • Draft and update SOPs, policy documents, and governance reference materials, ensuring alignment with privacy and retention frameworks (e.g., GDPR, CCPA, and other regulatory expectations).
  • Ensure documentation is audit-ready and centrally maintained.

Qualifications/Requirements:

  • Associate’s degree or equivalent required; bachelor’s degree preferred.
  • Project Management Professional (PMP) certification or equivalent training strongly preferred.
  • Minimum of 6+ years of industry and/or relevant experience, typically with 1+ years in a Senior Associate level role or external equivalent.
  • Demonstrated experience managing multiple concurrent, cross-functional initiatives.
  • Working knowledge of data governance principles, retention policies, privacy frameworks, and lifecycle controls required.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (particularly Excel and PowerPoint) with the ability to design complex tracking models, governance dashboards, and executive-level reporting. Demonstrated experience building structured SharePoint-based dashboards, automated trackers, and centralized governance documentation systems; familiarity with Power BI or similar reporting tools is a plus.
  • Familiarity with CLM systems (e.g., Ironclad) and enterprise documentation tools is a plus.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, and documentation skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a cross-functional, fast-moving environment.
  • Discretion and ability to handle confidential information is a must.
  • Exposure to data discovery or classification tools (e.g., DSPM solutions) preferred.
  • Familiarity with Zero Trust principles and AI governance frameworks preferred.
  • Strong executive communication and reporting skills preferred.

Note: This job description is not intended to be all inclusive or exclusive. At any time, employees may perform other related duties as required to meet the ongoing needs of the organization and participate in additional trainings. SitusAMC does not accept unsolicited resumes from staffing agencies, search firms or any third parties. Any unsolicited resume submitted to SitusAMC in any manner will be considered SitusAMC property, and SitusAMC will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume.

The annual full time base salary range for this role is

$95,000.00 - $130,000.00

Specific compensation is determined through interviews and a review of relevant education, experience, training, skills, geographic location and alignment with market data. Additionally, certain positions may be eligible to receive a discretionary bonus as determined by bonus program guidelines, position eligibility and SitusAMC Senior Management approval. SitusAMC offers PTO and paid holidays, the terms of which are set forth in the program policies. All full time employees also are eligible to participate in various benefit plans, including medical, dental, vision, life, disability insurance and 401K; in each case in accordance with the terms of the applicable plans.

jobs.excerpt: Ready to do the most impactful work of your career?
jobs.description:
Ready to do the most impactful work of your career? At Coinbase, we are uncompromising on our mission to increase economic freedom. The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” learn more about working at Coinbase.

Team/ Role:

Coinbase is building the future of institutional trading as part of the Everything Exchange, powering the systems that let the world's largest financial institutions trade across markets with speed, depth, and trust. As a Risk Architect on the Trading team, you'll design, build, and own the real-time risk engine at the heart of a unified trading platform: cross-asset user and portfolio risk evaluated in real time on the core trading system that serves our Retail, Prime, and wholesale brokerage customers. It's a rare chance to architect risk infrastructure from the ground up, with the ownership of a startup and the reach of Coinbase.

What you’ll do:

  • Own the architecture of the real-time, cross-asset risk and margin engine: user and portfolio modeling, multifactor and borrow risk, and cross-portfolio evaluation at scale.
  • Design low-latency, high-throughput risk systems, keeping correctness and performance in step with a growing trading platform.
  • Drive reliability and performance, owning SLOs, observability, and incident response for risk-critical systems.
  • Set the technical bar through code, design reviews, and standards, and pay down the technical debt that matters most.
  • Serve as the risk-architecture anchor for the team, mentoring engineers and reducing single-point-of-failure risk.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Product, Trading, Financing/Credit Risk, Security, and Compliance to turn technical vision into a roadmap.

Required skills and experience:

  • Hands-on architect, able to design, build, deploy, and support 24/7 risk systems that process billions of dollars of transactions daily.
  • Extensive backend engineering experience, with demonstrated ownership of complex, production-grade distributed systems.
  • Track record of architecting a cross-asset risk system (crypto, equities, FCM, or derivatives) with user/portfolio modeling and real-time, cross-portfolio evaluation at scale.
  • Deep proficiency in low-latency Java and high-throughput messaging (Aeron, SBE, or similar), designing event-driven, high-availability systems.
  • Experience with multifactor and borrow risk, margin, or clearing in a regulated or financial environment where correctness, auditability, and low-latency performance are critical.
  • Experience delivering projects end-to-end: scoping, architecture, implementation, monitoring, and iteration.
  • Experience making decisions that balance engineering trade-offs with end-user quality, demonstrated through shipped products.
  • Responsible use of generative AI, maintaining human oversight to deliver business-ready outputs and drive measurable improvements in workflow efficiency, cost, and quality.

Company Introduction

Based in Irvine, CA, PSD Underwear is a designer, marketer, and distributor of high quality, affordable, and premium briefs, boxers, sports bras, and loungewear. The company serves a diverse customer base (men’s, women’s, and youth) through company-owned web, wholesale, and international distributors. PSD is renowned for its specialty designs and for collaborating with the biggest brands from Warner Bros., Nickelodeon, DC, Hooters, and Naruto. Additionally, the company has an unmatched and growing roster of celebrities, social media influencers, and top-tier athletes including, Bronny James, Jimmy Butler, Ja Morant, Marshawn Lynch, and Tyler Herro.

General Summary

PSD isn't built to be a brand that only shows up when we have something to sell.

We're looking for a Director, Social & Experiential to lead the part of PSD that keeps us connected to the consumer, culture and community every single day.

This role leads two critical workstreams: Social Media & Influencers and Events & Ambassadors and is fluent in culture knowledge and community building.

If Marketing Strategy owns much of the planned world, culture & community owns the part that doesn't fit neatly into a calendar. This is where PSD reacts to culture, finds the next thing, gets into the community, creates conversations and turns the brand into something people want to be part of.

You will build the strategy, lead the team and set the standard, but you also need to be a player. You should be comfortable capturing content, jumping into social, building relationships with creators, attending events, pitching ideas and figuring things out in real time.

This is the heartbeat of PSD..

What You’ll Own

Social & Cultural Strategy

  • Own PSD's organic social strategy and cultural point of view across platforms.
  • Build an always-on approach that keeps PSD culturally relevant and connected to our consumer.
  • Identify trends, creators, memes, communities, conversations and opportunities that can move the brand forward.
  • Establish platform-specific best practices and continually evolve how PSD shows up.
  • Partner with Marketing Strategy to ensure social and community insights inform larger campaign strategies.

Influencers & Creators

  • Build and lead PSD's influencer and creator strategy.
  • Identify creators who are culturally relevant and brand-right.
  • Develop creative partnerships that prioritize interesting ideas and organic reach over traditional paid endorsement.
  • Build long-term relationships with creators, tastemakers and communities.
  • Create a point of view on who PSD should be in culture and why.

Ambassadors

  • Build and evolve PSD's Ambassador program.
  • Develop a network of brand-right people who authentically represent PSD.
  • Create programs that drive both community and measurable commercial value.
  • Establish the distinction between creators we collaborate with and ambassadors who participate through affiliate relationships.
  • Develop systems that make the program scalable without losing authenticity.

Events & Community

  • Own the strategy for PSD's events and community presence.
  • Develop a portfolio of events and grassroots activations that make PSD matter beyond traditional marketing moments.
  • Willing to roll up the sleeves, set up a tent, pack boxes, run the POS and troubleshoot on the fly.
  • Ensure events are culturally relevant, experiential and rooted in the communities we're trying to serve.
  • Build relationships with local communities, schools, athletes, creators, venues and cultural partners.
  • Create a point of view on where PSD should show up and where we shouldn't.

Lead at the pace of culture

  • Be the person who sees something happening on Tuesday and asks, What can PSD do about this by Friday?
  • Move quickly without sacrificing brand quality.
  • Make decisions with imperfect information.
  • Create content and participate in the culture rather than simply observe it.
  • Know when something needs a plan and when it simply needs someone to go do it.

Lead and develop the team

  • Build and eventually lead a team of 4-5 across Social, Influencers, Events and Ambassadors.
  • Coach the team to be both strategically sharp and highly hands-on.
  • Establish a culture of experimentation, speed, accountability and creativity.
  • Raise the standard for how PSD participates in culture.

Who you Are

  • You are obsessed with the consumer and youth culture.
  • You know what people are talking about before it becomes a trend report.
  • You understand platforms because you actually create for them.
  • You know creators because you know their work, not because you have a spreadsheet of their follower counts.
  • Obsessed with Instagram, TikTok, YouTube and Discord (and willing to find new platforms to leverage)
  • You're creative, but you're also a leader.
  • You're comfortable directing a strategy meeting at noon., shooting content at 2 pm and standing in the middle of an event at 10 pm
  • You don't need everything figured out before you start.
  • You thrive in the chaos.

What you Bring

  • 8+ years of experience across social, culture, community, influencer marketing, events and/or brand marketing
  • Deep expertise in social platforms, content and emerging cultural trends.
  • Experience developing and executing social strategy for a consumer-facing brand.
  • Strong creator/influencer relationships and experience developing partnerships.
  • Experience building ambassador, affiliate and/or grassroots community programs.
  • Experience developing events and experiential activations.
  • Strong creative instincts and an ability to identify what is culturally relevant.
  • Experience managing and developing teams.
  • Exceptional communication and relationship-building skills.
  • Willingness to travel frequently and work nontraditional hours when the moment requires it.
  • A genuine passion for being in the culture, not just marketing to it.
  • You must be brand-right. This is not negotiable.

This position is open for Remote or Hybrid, based on candidate location. Preferred candidate locations: Los Angeles, Portland, NYC or Nashville.

Benefits

PSD offers a comprehensive benefits package for regular, full-time employees designed to support overall well-being and work-life balance. Eligible team members can participate in:

• 401(k) Retirement Plan

Climbing/Stooping/Kneeling: Must be able to stoop or kneel to pick up products.

jobs.description:
Description

MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

As a product-focused Senior Frontend Developer on our AI track, you'll own frontend delivery end-to-end for products that directly affect how patients access mental health care and how our clinicians and staff work day-to-day. Your work sits at the intersection of a large, actively evolving Angular codebase and our AI-first product surface - patient-facing applications, internal tools for doctors and administrators, and the frontend for AI-powered features like our AI clinical assistant and AI receptionist. You'll work in a small cross-functional product team, taking features from requirement refinement through production release.

﻿Why this role:

  • Real product ownership in autonomous cross-functional team, you shape what gets built, not just how.
  • Deep hands-on work on AI-powered clinical and administrative products, with AI-assisted development as a first-class part of the engineering culture (Claude Code, Cursor, and beyond).
  • Modern Angular at scale: an actively evolving monorepo on the latest Angular versions, not a legacy graveyard.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain product features end-to-end within a cross-functional team, from requirement refinement to production release.
  • Take ownership of existing Angular codebase areas after the departing engineer: understand, stabilize, and improve them without slowing down the roadmap.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested code: code reviews, unit tests (Vitest), and lightweight design documentation as part of the daily routine.
  • Contribute to frontend architecture decisions and platform health: performance, framework upgrades, NX monorepo structure, CI/CD improvements.
  • Drive AI adoption on both fronts: building frontend for AI-powered product features, and integrating AI tooling into the development workflow itself.
  • Actively contribute to the continuous improvement of engineering processes and tooling across the community.

﻿This role is not for you if:

  • You're waiting for someone else to define what to build,we expect you to come up with ideas, take them through discovery and development, ship them, and own the results after launch.
  • You need a fully-specced ticket queue and a PM/BA translating everything for you
  • You see AI coding agents as a novelty rather than a core part of how modern frontend work gets done.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of commercial experience with Angular(latest versions preferred).
  • Experience owning a product end-to-end, including analysing the metrics that tell you whether it actually worked.
  • Strong product and UX judgment, you can recognize when an interaction doesn't feel right and propose a better solution.
  • Fluency in modern Angular: standalone components, signals, current change detection and DI patterns, not experience from several years ago followed by a switch to another framework.
  • Advanced RxJS and TypeScript in real production scenarios: confident design and debugging of complex reactive flows (stream composition, cancellation, race conditions, error handling) and fluency in a strictly typed codebase.
  • Proven expertise in designing and implementing complex Angular application architectures at scale, module and component boundaries, decisions that hold up as the codebase grows.
  • Hands-on experience with unit testing (Vitest preferred, Jest acceptable) as a regular part of the daily routine, not an afterthought.
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI development. For us this is a must, not a bonus: active daily use of coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, or similar), the ability to write effective skills, prompts, and instructions for them, understanding of the principles behind how agents operate (context, tools, feedback loops), and structuring code and documentation so agents can work with the codebase effectively.
  • Comfort working across the backend boundary: writing or fixing a SQL query, adjusting endpoint validation, or tracing an issue through the API layer. You don't need to be a backend engineer, but stopping at the frontend border isn't an option.
  • Intermediate English (B1+) and fluent Russian.
  • Full overlap with CET working hours.

Would be a plus:

  • Experience building UI for AI/LLM-powered features.
  • Deep understanding of responsive design, our patients access the platform primarily from mobile devices, and interfaces must be flawless across screen sizes.
  • Proficiency in optimizing web application performance across different surfaces: patient-facing product and internal tools for doctors, managers, and admins (data-heavy interfaces, large tables and lists, real-time updates).

What we offer

  • High-impact environment: A chance to contribute to a product-driven company in the medical tech space.
  • Growth & compensation: Clear growth opportunities and a competitive compensation package.
  • Remote-first: Fully remote long-term collaboration under a B2B model.
  • Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
  • Career development: Clear growth opportunities, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
  • Time off: 19 paid vacation days annually, 4 additional wellness days each year, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
  • Culture: Thoughtful gifts for key life events and offline corporate events.

The start date for this position is 11/2/2026. Training period: 8 to 10 weeks.


During the training period, the hours will be Monday through Friday 9am - 5:30pm ET. Once training is completed, schedules will be assigned as noted below:


Consult: Monday through Friday

  • FL- 11:30 am – 8 pm ET
  • OH- 11:30 am – 8 pm ET

  • There will also be 1-evening shift per week from 2:30 pm -11 pm ET and a Saturday rotation 10 am - 6:30 pm every 4-weeks. When working a Saturday shift there would be a weekday off.

**Candidates must be able to commit to the training and future schedules noted.


POSITION SUMMARY

The Staff Pharmacist interprets physicians’ prescriptions, contacts doctors or other prescribers and/or patients to verify information on prescriptions and expedite processing of order.

The Staff Pharmacist may track order status and outstanding issues as well as consult with patients regarding the use of medications and potential drug interactions.

This individual may take calls from customers regarding lost orders or dispensing errors, maintain daily production, quality and service levels, vary work priorities and activities to accommodate business needs.

The Staff Pharmacist may also train less experienced pharmacists.


ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS Consult with patients regarding the use of medications and potential drug interactions. Contact physicians for new and/or transfer authorization. Collaborate with physicians to convert prescriptions to generic or preferred drugs whenever possible. Interpret physicians’ or prescribers’ prescriptions. Contact doctors and/or patients to verify information on prescriptions such as drug strength, prescription sig., and drug name in order to expedite processing of orders. Provide oversight and quality assurance to pharmacy technicians. Verify and confirm validity of controlled substances. Verify prescription information entered in the system by data entry or order entry. Back up other pharmacists as needed, perform additional duties as assigned by management, or train less experienced pharmacists.


QUALIFICATIONS

Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy required, PharmD preferred

Current active resident pharmacist license in good standing.

Advanced problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively with other departments to resolve issues.

Good oral and written communication skills.

Ability to read and interpret prescriptions.

Strong focus on customer service, quality and accuracy.

Ability to manage timelines and meet tight client deadlines.

Ability to adapt in a changing environment.

Ability to work a flexible schedule for peak volume times.

jobs.title: Senior Federal Pricing Manager
jobs.excerpt: The Challenge:JCTM is increasing the size, complexity, and strategic importance of the federal services opportunities it pursues across prime, subcontract, joint venture, IDIQ, GWAC, and task-order environments.
jobs.description:
The Challenge:

JCTM is increasing the size, complexity, and strategic importance of the federal services opportunities it pursues across prime, subcontract, joint venture, IDIQ, GWAC, and task-order environments. As our federal portfolio grows, JCTM is strengthening its pricing capability to bring competitive pricing analysis earlier into capture, improve proposal economics, protect execution feasibility, and give leadership better information for pursuit and investment decisions.

The successful candidate will be able to analyze available customer, competitor, labor-market, contract, and cost information and clearly explain: “Here is the likely competitive range, here is where our current price sits, here are the major drivers, here are the available levers, and here is the pricing approach I recommend.”

JCTM is looking for an experienced, hands-on federal pricing professional who understands that successful pricing goes beyond completing a cost model. This person will help JCTM understand what a competitive price may look like, how the proposed solution and staffing model affect that price, and what adjustments may improve both competitiveness and execution.

Build Your Career:

This role is an opportunity for an experienced Senior Pricing Analyst, Pricing Manager, Senior Pricing Manager, or similarly qualified federal pricing professional to take on greater ownership, work directly with senior leadership, and help mature JCTM’s strategic pricing capability. You will remain close to the work, building and reviewing pricing models, analyzing competitive ranges, evaluating staffing and labor assumptions, supporting BOEs, and pricing major federal pursuits, while gaining increased responsibility for pricing strategy and executive-level recommendations.

Challenging Projects:

As the Senior Federal Pricing Manager, you will lead hands-on pricing activities for significant federal pursuits and help mature JCTM’s competitive pricing and Price-to-Win capabilities. You will develop and evaluate pricing scenarios, conduct competitive pricing analysis, assess staffing and solution economics, review BOEs, and translate incomplete market and acquisition information into defensible recommendations.

Working with Growth, Capture, Finance, Operations, Proposal, Recruiting, HR, and technical SMEs, you will help leadership understand where JCTM’s proposed pricing sits relative to the competitive environment and identify practical levers that can improve competitiveness without undermining successful execution. This position offers significant visibility to JCTM leadership while providing room to grow into broader ownership of the company’s pricing strategy, processes, tools, and competitive-pricing infrastructure.

Key Responsibilities:

Federal Proposal Pricing & Financial Modeling

  • Independently develop, maintain, audit, and troubleshoot complex federal proposal pricing and financial models.
  • Develop pricing for labor-intensive federal professional services opportunities, including complex multi-year pursuits and task orders.
  • Support FFP, FFP-LOE, T&M/Labor Hour, CPFF/cost-reimbursable, IDIQ, GWAC, and task-order pricing environments.
  • Model and analyze direct labor, fully burdened rates, fringe, overhead, G&A, escalation, subcontractors, consultants, travel, ODCs, fee/profit, gross margin, and total contract value.
  • Perform mathematical, formula, compliance, reasonableness, and sensitivity checks before executive review and proposal submission.
  • Develop multiple executable pricing scenarios and clearly explain the financial, competitive, staffing, and margin implications of each.

Competitive Pricing & Price-to-Win Analysis

  • Conduct or materially contribute to Price-to-Win analyses for priority federal pursuits using both top-down and bottom-up methodologies.
  • Develop defensible likely competitive or winning ranges based on available customer, competitor, acquisition, labor-market, historical-award, and pricing information.
  • Clearly document assumptions, confidence levels, known facts, analytical estimates, and material uncertainties.
  • Compare JCTM’s estimated price against likely competitive ranges and identify the principal labor, staffing, indirect-rate, fee, subcontractor, workshare, and solution drivers creating variance.
  • Reconcile top-down competitive analysis with bottom-up solution and cost modeling.
  • Help mature JCTM’s approach to incorporating competitive pricing analysis earlier in capture as additional experience and intelligence are developed.

Capture, Qualification & Pricing Strategy

  • Engage with Capture before final RFP release when sufficient information exists to begin meaningful pricing analysis.
  • Evaluate draft RFPs, PWS/SOWs, RFIs, acquisition strategy, historical awards, incumbent position, customer budgets, evaluation methodology, staffing assumptions, and available competitive intelligence.
  • Use pricing and competitive intelligence to inform or influence capture strategy, staffing, teaming, solution design, and Bid/No-Bid decisions.
  • Identify and professionally challenge unsupported pricing, staffing, labor-mix, margin, teaming, and execution assumptions when the available analysis indicates a material concern.
  • Provide pricing analysis and recommendations for significant pursuits and participate in applicable gate and Bid/No-Bid reviews.

BOE, Solution Economics & Staffing Analysis

  • Work with technical, capture, proposal, and operations leaders to develop and review Basis of Estimate documentation.
  • Maintain alignment and traceability between solicitation requirements, technical solution, staffing plan, BOE, hours, labor categories, and pricing assumptions.
  • Work with Operations, Program Management, Recruiting, HR, and technical SMEs to develop defensible labor categories, labor mixes, staffing levels, hours, phasing, and rate assumptions.
  • Evaluate staffing models for competitiveness, affordability, and execution feasibility.
  • Identify areas where labor mix, experience bands, staffing levels, phasing, or teaming may be adjusted without undermining technical execution.

Competitive, Customer & Labor-Market Intelligence

  • Research federal award history, incumbent contracts, customer buying patterns, competitor positioning, probable competitor rates and indirect structures, market compensation, public job postings, BLS data, government databases, and available commercial market-intelligence sources.
  • Use partner and subcontractor intelligence when useful and validate material assumptions where practical.
  • Clearly distinguish known information, inferred information, and analytical estimates.
  • Help develop and maintain reusable competitor-pricing, labor-rate, historical-award, and competitive-pricing intelligence so lessons from each pursuit strengthen future pricing decisions.
  • Incorporate relevant win/loss and debrief information into future pricing analysis.

Teammate, Subcontractor & Workshare Pricing

  • Coordinate pricing inputs and data calls with subcontractors, teaming partners, consultants, and joint venture participants.
  • Evaluate teammate pricing for competitiveness, labor-category alignment, indirect treatment, escalation, ODCs, period-of-performance consistency, workshare requirements, and pass-through/margin impact.
  • Analyze the pricing implications of labor allocation, teammate rates, workshare, pass-through, and subcontractor economics.
  • Support teammate and subcontractor pricing discussions and negotiations as required.

Executive Pricing Communication

  • Prepare concise, decision-quality pricing analyses for Growth, Finance, Operations, and executive leadership.
  • Clearly communicate likely competitive pricing ranges, JCTM’s estimated pricing position, significant assumptions, key cost and staffing drivers, margin implications, uncertainties, and available pricing levers.
  • Recommend pricing approaches based on available evidence and explain the assumptions and tradeoffs underlying those recommendations.
  • Defend pricing recommendations under questioning and professionally challenge unsupported assumptions.

Compliance, Process & Pricing Infrastructure

  • Apply working knowledge of FAR, DFARS, federal acquisition requirements, and government contract pricing principles to pricing activities.
  • Support compliance with solicitation-specific pricing instructions and applicable requirements concerning allowability, allocability, reasonableness, labor standards, and cost or pricing data.
  • Help develop and improve pricing models, rate libraries, templates, assumption logs, review checklists, and version-control practices appropriate for a growing small/mid-market GovCon.
  • Protect proprietary, procurement-sensitive, source-selection-sensitive, and contractor bid/proposal information.
  • Help capture lessons from awards, losses, and debriefs to improve future pricing analysis and processes.

Room to Grow:

This position provides meaningful exposure to JCTM’s CEO, CGO, CFO, Capture leadership, Operations, and other key decision-makers. You will have the opportunity to take increasing ownership of JCTM’s pricing strategy and infrastructure as the company grows. A successful individual can help shape how JCTM approaches competitive pricing, opportunity qualification, capture strategy, pricing posture, and investment decisions. This role is particularly well suited for a strong Senior Pricing Analyst, Pricing Manager, Senior Pricing Manager, or comparable federal pricing professional who has performed substantive pricing work on major federal pursuits and is ready for greater ownership and executive visibility.

You Have:

  • 7+ years of progressively responsible federal government contracting pricing, cost analysis, proposal pricing, competitive pricing/Price-to-Win analysis, or closely related experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently own complex federal pricing models and proposal-pricing activities.
  • Experience conducting or materially contributing to federal competitive pricing/Price-to-Win analyses and developing defensible likely competitive or winning ranges.
  • Demonstrated ability to perform and reconcile top-down and bottom-up pricing analysis.
  • Significant experience pricing labor-intensive federal professional services.
  • Experience supporting significant federal services pursuits, including complex multi-year opportunities and task orders.
  • Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and the ability to independently build, audit, and troubleshoot complex pricing and financial models.
  • Strong understanding of labor-rate development, compensation markets, indirect rates, wrap, escalation, fee/profit, gross margin, and sensitivity analysis.
  • Experience developing and reviewing BOEs and aligning the technical solution, staffing, hours, and pricing assumptions.
  • Experience using pricing and competitive intelligence to inform or influence capture strategy, staffing, teaming, solution design, and Bid/No-Bid decisions.
  • Working knowledge of FAR, DFARS, federal acquisition requirements, and government contract pricing principles.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to clearly explain and defend pricing recommendations under questioning and professionally challenge unsupported assumptions.
  • Ability to operate hands-on in a lean small/mid-market GovCon environment without requiring a large pricing department around you.
  • Ability to manage multiple concurrent pursuits and compressed proposal timelines.
  • Eligibility to obtain and maintain a U.S. government security clearance.

Nice to Haves:

This role plays a critical part in maintaining accurate financial records, supporting cash flow management, ensuring timely invoicing and collections, and providing executive leadership with actionable financial visibility.

Key Responsibilities

1. Accounts Receivable & Billing Administration

  • Delivered Not Invoiced (DNI) Management: Maintain and monitor DNI reports. Identify delivered shipments lacking billing documentation, communicate missing items to operations, and distribute updated DNI reports every Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.

  • Daily Invoicing: Ensure all eligible shipments are billed daily (Monday–Friday). Verify all required documentation prior to invoicing and maintain strict adherence to billing accuracy standards.

  • Aging & Terms: Set invoice aging to begin on the shipment pickup date (unless otherwise directed). Monitor customer payment terms, maintain billing profiles, and recommend improvements to billing processes that impede collections.

  • Payment Application: Accurately record customer payments, apply receipts to open invoices, and reconcile unapplied cash or payment discrepancies.

2. Collections Management

  • Process Coordination: Serve as primary coordinator for customer collections. Routinely monitor aging reports, identify delinquent accounts, and conduct polite, firm outreach via telephone and email.

  • Record Keeping: Maintain detailed, up-to-date log notes regarding all outreach, customer responses, and payment promises.

  • Escalations: Identify high-risk accounts or payment disputes and escalate them promptly to executive leadership with actionable recommendations. (Note: This role executes collections but does not independently authorize payment plans, discounts, terms revisions, or write-offs).

  • Weekly A/R Reporting: Prepare and distribute a comprehensive weekly A/R report sorted from oldest to newest open balance, including:

    • A/R Aging Summary: Current, 1–30, 31–60, 61–90, and 91+ days past due.

    • Open Invoice Detail: Customer name, invoice number/date, shipment/load number, due date, balance, and days outstanding.

    • High-Priority Collections Section: Detailed tracking for over-terms accounts, major balances, disputes, non-responsive accounts, and special watchlist accounts.

    • Cash Flow Projections: Expected collection forecasts for 7-day and 30-day windows, along with risk assessments and trend analysis.

  • Payable Administration: Monitor upcoming payment due dates, track payment terms, and prioritize payables according to operational impact.

  • Weekly A/P Reporting: Prepare and distribute a weekly A/P report categorized into:

    • All Payables: Complete list of obligations sorted by due date (oldest to newest).

  • Payment Posting: Accurately log approved vendor/carrier payments in the accounting software and maintain clean ledger histories.

  • Assist with administration within QuickBooks Online and associated financial software tools.

Authority & Decision-Making Guidelines

The Accounting Assistant executes, monitors, and reports on accounting procedures but does not possess independent authority to bind the company financially or alter terms.

Prior Approval from Executive Leadership is required for:

jobs.excerpt: About ev. energy We are building the world's largest EV-centric virtual power plant (VPP).
jobs.description:
About ev.energy
We are building the world's largest EV-centric virtual power plant (VPP). By connecting to vehicles, chargers, batteries, solar, and other distributed energy resources, we turn households into flexible grid assets that balance supply and demand, preventing blackouts and reducing reliance on fossil fuels.
We are scaling rapidly across North America and Europe. We are moving fast, we are AI-first, and we are looking for builders who want to power the grid of the future.

About the role
Our core platform is built in Python and Django, so we're looking for experienced backend software engineers with strong Python skills; Django experience would be beneficial but we’re open to other frameworks.

You'll be the person who takes a product idea and builds the systems, services, and infrastructure that make it real — reliable, scalable, and fast to iterate on. We're not looking for generalists who dabble across the stack — we're looking for someone with deep backend craft who can move fast, build with AI as a core part of how they work, and take genuine ownership of what they ship.

We're hiring for a number of roles across both of our Technology teams: new product development and customer delivery. We'd love to talk to you about both teams, understand what excites you, and place you into the team where we think you'll thrive best.

What you’ll do

Backend engineering and architecture
  • Design, build, and own backend services and APIs that power our product — from data models to infrastructure to production reliability
  • Make sound architectural decisions that balance shipping speed against long-term maintainability and scale
  • Take ownership of significant technical areas — from identifying the right approach to shipping and iterating in production
Building and shipping with AI
  • Use AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, or equivalent) as a core, daily part of how you write and ship code — not an occasional add-on
  • Build working backend prototypes fast — good enough to validate with real usage, not over-engineered before it's proven
  • Know when a rough implementation is right for the moment and when production-grade engineering is needed — and apply that judgment confidently
  • Ship, measure, learn, iterate — kill what isn't working, double down on what is
Product and stakeholder collaboration
  • Work closely with product, design, and commercial stakeholders to translate customer problems into technical solutions
  • Act as a credible engineering voice in cross-functional discussions, pilot programmes, and technical scoping conversations
  • Partner with Customer Support, Program Management, and Demand Generation to understand how customers find, adopt, and stay with ev.energy
Raising the bar
  • Share what you learn openly, challenge how things are built, and raise the technical bar for the engineers around you
  • Model what AI-native backend engineering looks like in practice — not in theory
  • Contribute to a culture of experimentation, velocity, and commercial impact

Our tech stack
  • Python and Django for our core platform
  • Django REST Framework for our APIs
  • React, React Native and TypeScript for our web and mobile app
  • PostgreSQL, Redis and DynamoDB for data storage
  • AWS for hosting, with infrastructure managed as code using Terraform
  • Claude (via the Anthropic API) features to power AI

What we're looking for

Must-haves
  • Strong Python experience (5+ years), with a clear track record of building and shipping production backend systems
  • Experience building backend services with a Python framework (e.g Django, FastAPI or Flask)
  • Strong experience building with AI — you've taken AI-powered features or products from concept through to production, and use AI coding tools (Claude, Cursor, or equivalent) as a genuine daily practice, not just occasionally
  • Solid understanding of backend fundamentals — APIs, data modelling, databases, system design, and production reliability
  • Experience leading technical decisions and influencing direction without relying on hierarchy
  • Strong communication skills — written, verbal, and technical — credible with engineers, product, and commercial stakeholders
  • High bias for action and comfort with ambiguity — you make good technical decisions with incomplete information
Nice to haves
  • Experience in energy, utilities, cleantech, or adjacent domains
  • Experience with Django
  • Familiarity with EV fleet operations, home energy management, or grid services
  • Front-end or full-stack capability that lets you prototype independently without blocking on others
  • A portfolio of backend systems, tools, or products that prove how you work
  • Direct customer conversation experience that's shaped what you've built

Salary, benefits & how we work

The salary range for this role is £69,300-£84,900 GBP.

Key benefits include:
  • Equity - you'll own a part of the business through our share options program
  • Healthcare options - to help keep you and your family in tip-top condition (provided by Bupa & Medicash)
  • Life assurance of 3x your salary
  • Co-working access via WeWork (if you'd like it)
  • Annual 'Team Week' whole company offsite
  • L&D allowance of £1,000 per year - everyone is learning, developing and challenging themselves so we have a professional development fund per year for you to learn new skills
You can find out more about our full range of perks and benefits here.

Location & how we work
This role is fully remote in the UK.
The majority of people at ev.energy work on a fully remote basis, with a small number of roles based on-site in our testing sites.
This means that most of our people work from home, but we're happy to provide co-working subscriptions if you'd like to spend time at a WeWork (or other co-working space close to you).
We balance our remote set up by getting everyone together once a year for an offsite, as we know that spending time together IRL is super important.

Belonging at ev.energy
We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity: we do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status or disability status. If you'd like a copy of our DE&I policy you can reach us at . We'll always do our best to accommodate reasonable adjustments to the interview process if needed - just let us know.

Who We Are

At Conquer, we help go-to-market teams connect more meaningfully, act more effectively, and grow more predictably. As a leader in intelligent revenue engagement, we empower our customers to orchestrate the right message at the right time across every channel.

Real-time communication sits at the heart of the Conquer platform. As our Senior Platform Engineer, Voice Infrastructure, you will own and evolve the systems that power how sales teams connect with customers through calling, routing, and intelligent workflows.

Voice at Conquer is more than communications infrastructure. It is foundational to how we understand customer interactions and increasingly how we deliver real-time, intelligent experiences across our platform.

This is not a traditional telecom operations or high-level architecture role. We are looking for an engineer who combines deep telephony expertise with strong software and platform engineering skills. You should be equally comfortable designing how the platform should evolve and getting into the code, FreeSWITCH, SIP routing layer, containers, and production infrastructure to build it.

Your work will directly impact call quality and reliability today while helping build the voice foundation for the next generation of Conquer's platform.

What You Will Do

  • Document systems and create tooling and runbooks that improve team understanding and operational readiness

  • Deep, hands-on production experience with FreeSWITCH, including dialplans, call logic, ESL, and complex production troubleshooting

  • Strong hands-on experience with OpenSIPS or comparable SIP proxy technology, including personally building or modifying routing logic

  • Deep understanding of SIP and RTP and experience diagnosing signaling, media-path, NAT, codec, and call-quality issues using packet captures and SIP traces

  • Experience owning real-time communication systems in production environments

  • Experience with Go, Python, or another backend/systems programming language

  • Experience designing reliable, scalable systems with a focus on performance, resilience, and uptime

  • Experience building or operating low-latency, real-time media systems

  • Experience with streaming audio, speech-to-text, transcription, or real-time inference pipelines

  • Experience building infrastructure that supports AI-driven voice or agentic experiences

  • Experience with real-time media observability and monitoring

  • Experience with VoIPmonitor, Homer, or similar voice observability tooling

  • Experience with call recording and transcription

  • Exposure to telephony-related compliance considerations such as TCPA, STIR/SHAKEN, call recording laws, and consent management

What Success Looks Like

  • You have closed gaps in observability and improved visibility into real-time signaling and media performance

  • You are contributing production code and platform improvements, not simply recommending them

jobs.description:
About the role

Plan Left is hiring a Video Editor to turn our long-form content (webinars, podcasts, interviews and talks) into short, scroll-stopping clips that grow our B2B audience. You'll work closely with the marketing team, owning the edit from raw recording to platform-ready video for LinkedIn, YouTube and other channels.

This is a marketing role as much as an editing role: we want someone who knows what makes a business audience stop, watch and click.

What you'll do

  • Review webinars, podcasts and recorded talks (30–90 minutes) and pull the strongest moments into short clips (15–90 seconds)
  • Produce 15–25 short-form videos per week from each long-form piece, plus highlight reels and trailers
  • Write or refine hooks, on-screen text, captions and titles that land with business buyers
  • Format and optimize every clip for its platform: LinkedIn, YouTube Shorts, Instagram, TikTok and paid ads
  • Add motion graphics, subtitles, b-roll, branded intros and lower thirds consistent with our brand guidelines
  • Partner with marketing to align clips with campaigns, product launches and demand-gen goals
  • Track clip performance (views, watch time, engagement, clicks) and use it to improve the next batch
  • Keep an organized library of source files, templates and finished assets

The creative side

We don't want clips that look like a webinar recording with captions slapped on. We want short-form content with a point of view that feels native to each platform and still fits a credible B2B brand.

You'll get creative ownership to:

  • Find the story. Spot the surprising stat, the contrarian opinion or the honest moment in an hour of talk, then build a clip with a clear beginning, tension and payoff
  • Hook in the first 2 seconds. Try cold opens, pattern interrupts, bold text and smart reordering so viewers keep watching
  • Bring talking heads to life. Use punch-ins, jump cuts, b-roll, kinetic typography, emoji and icon callouts, split screens and simple animations to keep the energy up
  • Use sound well. Pick music, sound effects and pacing that match the mood, from punchy and fast to calm and authoritative
  • Develop a visual style. Help shape and evolve recognizable templates, caption styles, color treatments and series formats for our channels
  • Pitch new formats. Suggest series, recurring segments, carousel-to-video ideas and trend-based edits that suit a B2B audience
  • Experiment and learn. Test different hooks, lengths, aspect ratios and styles, and double down on what works

  • Trace an experiment from configuration to output and document which inputs, model versions, random states, and artifacts are required to reproduce it.

  • Establish an implementation contract for treatments, populations, execution, and result aggregation, with meaningful correctness checks.

  • Profile a representative workload and improve its largest quality, throughput, or cost constraint without silently changing the experimental question.

  • Build a research-to-production path with versioned interfaces, reviewable changes, and explicit failure handling.

How we will judge progress

Research ideas become reusable capabilities with explainable behavior. Track reproducibility, correctness under independently specified test cases, experiment throughput, and cost. Make changes in model behavior distinguishable from execution defects.

What you bring

  • You have led research engineering, simulation, scientific computing, or ML systems work and shipped robust implementations of complex methods.

  • You can reason about stochastic systems, numerical behavior, experiment design, and performance while writing and reviewing production code.

  • You can lead a technical roadmap across researchers and engineers and make explicit tradeoffs between exploration and stability.

We are looking for evidence of judgment, execution, and leadership. A particular company pedigree or previous executive title is not a substitute for that evidence.

Compensation and funding

We are actively fundraising. Only equity-based compensation is currently available; no cash salary is available today. The equity grant and its terms have not been set for this role and must be agreed before joining. Any future salary, incentive plan, benefits, hiring budget, or paid start date depends on financing and written agreement. Funding and its timing are not guaranteed.

Before deciding to join, discuss the grant structure, fully diluted ownership basis, vesting, dilution, applicable exercise terms, company funding position, and working arrangement. A company valuation is not the cash value of an equity grant.

How we work

Remote · United States. The planned role is full time; timing is to be agreed. Expect direct collaboration with the founders, work across scientific and commercial boundaries, and responsibility for doing the early work yourself. The current role does not include visa sponsorship. Confirm practical collaboration hours and any travel expectations during the initial conversation.

Start with work you already own

Describe a research method you brought into production. What could go wrong in the translation, how did you test correctness, and what did you change after real use?

Please do not share confidential employer or customer materials. Bring your questions about our product, evidence, team, finances, and the authority attached to the role. Mutual diligence matters for a decision of this size.

For more information, please visit .

Summary

The Sr Director, Revenue Accounting & Commercial Finance will lead a small team responsible for strengthening the company’s revenue accounting capabilities and providing finance partnership to the Commercial organization.

This role requires strong ASC 606 expertise, analytical judgment, financial-modeling capabilities, and the ability to connect accounting, operational, market, and commercial considerations into practical financial insights.

On the revenue accounting side, the role will partner closely with Accounting, Revenue Cycle, Market Access, and Enterprise Analytics to lead a rigorous, scalable, and well-controlled revenue close process. The Sr Director will help ensure revenue is accurately accounted for, accrual-rate estimates are supported by appropriate analysis, and relevant payer, reimbursement, policy, billing, collections, and operational developments are reflected in revenue-accounting judgments.

On the commercial finance side, the role will partner with Commercial leaders in making better business decisions through financial modeling, business-case development, performance analysis, and assessment of growth initiatives, translating data and analysis into clear recommendations and decision support.

Job Responsibilities

  • Lead and develop a small Revenue Accounting & Commercial Finance team
  • Partner with Accounting to lead accurate, timely, and well-controlled revenue month-end-close processes
  • Interpret and apply ASC 606 revenue-recognition guidance, including the evaluation and documentation of accounting conclusions, estimates, and related controls.
  • Lead public-company reporting, external-audit activities, and internal-control requirements related to revenue accounting and revenue close processes.
  • Own or lead the development, maintenance, and review of revenue accrual-rate estimates and related models
  • Work closely with Revenue Cycle and Market Access to identify market, payer, reimbursement, policy, and operational developments that may affect revenue realization and incorporate them into accrual-rate estimates and revenue-accounting assumptions.
  • Partner with Enterprise Analytics to develop and improve the data model, reporting infrastructure, reconciliations, and analytical tools needed to lead an efficient revenue-accounting month-end close and more accurate accrual rate estimates.
  • Work with large and complex datasets to analyze revenue trends, evaluate estimate performance, identify emerging risks, and diagnose variances.
  • Evaluate the impact of payer behavior, coverage and policy changes, prior authorization, denials, underpayments, claims operations, billing processes, and collections performance on revenue estimates and financial results.
  • Establish reporting and review processes that connect operational, billing, collections, and financial data; identify material variances; and drive timely resolution with accountable stakeholders.
  • Lead annual operating planning, long-range planning, forecasting, scenario analysis, and variance analysis, with a particular focus on revenue per test and commercial operating expenses
  • Lead commercial finance activities, including financial modeling, business-case development, evaluation of commercial initiatives, and analysis of revenue drivers and performance.
  • Prepare concise, decision-oriented executive presentations
  • Manage multiple priorities and respond effectively to evolving and ad hoc business needs while maintaining high standards of accuracy, timeliness, and analytical rigor.

Education, Experience, and Skills

  • 12+ years experience in revenue accounting, commercial finance, strategic finance, FP&A, public accounting, or a related finance role within a public company or similarly rigorous financial-reporting environment.
  • Strong expertise interpreting and applying ASC 606 revenue-recognition guidance, including technical accounting analysis, accounting conclusions, revenue estimates, and control considerations.
  • Public-company experience, including familiarity with financial close, external-audit support, internal controls, financial reporting, and executive communications.
  • Experience leading, developing, or mentoring a small finance or accounting team.
  • Demonstrated ability to partner effectively with Revenue Cycle, Market Access, Commercial, Accounting, FP&A, and executive leaders.
  • Experience assessing how reimbursement, payer, policy, and operational developments affect revenue realization, accrual estimates, and financial performance.
  • Strong financial-modeling and business-case-development skills, with the ability to evaluate investments, commercial initiatives, and expected financial outcomes.
  • Advanced analytical capabilities and experience working with large, complex datasets to reconcile financial and operational information, identify trends, evaluate estimates, and diagnose performance gaps.
  • Experience working with analytics or data teams to design or improve data models, reporting infrastructure, dashboards, reconciliations, and financial-close processes.

Co budujemy i z kim chcemy współpracować:

WinStreamly/New Game +tworzymy rozwiązania marketingowe, które pomagają markom docierać do graczy. Łączymytechnologię, gaming i AI, a nasze produkty wykorzystujemy w kampaniach prowadzonych na wielu rynkach.

Regularnie realizujemy kampanie dla największych globalnych marek, takich jak Netflix, Adidas, PlayStationczySamsung. Budujemy ekosystem mar-tech, który pomaga markom skutecznie komunikować się z graczami. To oznacza szybkie tempo, częste zmiany priorytetów i dużo procesów, które nadal trzeba zaprojektować lub uporządkować.

Równolegle rozwijamy własny system pracy, w którym zaufanie zastępuje kontrolę czasu i sposobu działania. Dajemy ludziom dużą autonomię, ale oczekujemy w zamian odpowiedzialności za wynik.Tutajmożesz dowiedzieć się więcej.

Co charakteryzuje nasz system pracy?

  • Myślimy o organizacji jak o drużynie: system działania oparty jest o wysokie wymagania i dążenie do mistrzostwa na każdej pozycji. Kładziemy jednocześnie bardzo duży nacisk na zespołowość i partnerskie podejście.

  • Ufamy i oczekujemy wyników:nie kontrolujemy procesu ani czasu pracy, ale bezkompromisowo rozliczamy rezultat – co jest trudne, bo wymaga samodzielności i brania odpowiedzialności.

  • Nie boimy się konfrontacji:publicznie oceniamy pomysły i wyniki. Analiza błędów to dla nas jedyna droga do progresu. Jeśli potrzebujesz miękkiego feedbacku lub boisz się bezpośredniej oceny efektów swojej pracy – może być Ci ciężko się tutaj odnaleźć.

  • Mamy wysokie tempo i zmienność: szybko reagujemy na rynek, co oznacza, że w ciągu roku zmieniają się priorytety strategiczne oraz projektowe. Potrzebujemy ludzi, którzy potrafią błyskawicznie dostosować swoją grę do nowych celów. W tym tempie kluczowa jest dla nas innowacyjność - aktywnie wykorzystujemy AI i automatyzację, by eliminować powtarzalne procesy i skupiać się wyłącznie na tym, co skaluje nasz biznes.

Więcej o sposobie naszej pracy możesz posłuchać w naszympodcaście.

Kontekst roli i wyzwania:
Jako GamingClient Growth Manager będziesz odpowiadać za identyfikacjęi rozwój szans biznesowych poprzez aktywną współpracę z działem Business Development, budowanie iskalowanie relacji z klientamiorazinicjowanie działań upsellowychicross-sellowych. To rola na styku sprzedaży, strategii i relacji - kluczowa dla skalowania współpracy z markami działającymi w świecie gamingu i livestreamingu.

Twój docelowy zespół:
Twoim bezpośrednim managerem będzie Jan Czerniecki, Head of Gaming Solutions. Na co dzień będziesz współpracować z całym zespołem Sales & Account Management:
z osobami odpowiedzialnymi za pozyskiwanie klientów (Business Development) i prowadzenie kampanii (Account Management) oraz z Project Managerami z zespołu New Game +, którzy prowadzą projekty naszych klientów.

Jak będzie wyglądał dzień w Twojej roli:

  • Współpraca z zespołem Business Development w celu skutecznego pozyskania nowych klientów.

  • Prowadzenie strategicznych działań mających na celu rozwój istniejących relacji klienckich (farmowanie + cross-sell/upsell).

  • Proaktywne identyfikowanie i rozwijanie nowych możliwości biznesowych w oparciu o dane rynkowe, potrzeby klientów i insighty konsumenckie.

  • Projektowanie i prezentacja propozycji współpracy odpowiadających na cele marketingowe klientów.

  • Stała współpraca z działem campaign delivery oraz produkcją w celu dostarczania wartościowych doświadczeń dla klientów i ich marek.

  • Udział w warsztatach strategicznych z klientami oraz partnerami (np. agencjami, domami mediowymi).

  • Wsparcie w tworzeniu i egzekucji strategii klienta w ramach produktów New Game+ (produkty specjalne, długoterminowe współprace, integracje).

  • Monitoring efektywności kampanii i aktywne rekomendowanie kolejnych kroków (koncepcyjnych lub sprzedażowych).

Szukamy osoby, która posiada:

  • Min. 3 lata doświadczenia w sprzedaży B2B lub obsłudze klienta w agencji reklamowej, firmie technologicznej lub marce z sektora digital/gaming.

  • Doświadczenie w pracy z markami FMCG, telco, tech lub gaming będzie dodatkowym atutem.

  • Umiejętność prowadzenia rozmów z klientami na poziomie strategicznym (działy marketingu, brand managerowie, media managerowie).

  • Wysoko rozwinięte umiejętności interpersonalne i prezentacyjne.

  • Zorientowanie na cel i umiejętność priorytetyzacji działań.

  • Proaktywne podejście do rozwijania klientów i projektów – mentalność „hunter/farmer hybrid”.

Najlepsi gracze to tacy, którzy potrafią szybko adaptować się do gry. Jeśli czujesz, że nasz system idzie w parze z Twoim i chcesz w nim dowozić wartość, zachęcamy Cię do aplikowania - nawet jeśli nie spełniasz teraz wszystkich oczekiwań z listy.

Co oferujemy?

  • Pracę na stykutechnologii, AIi gamingu, z realnym wpływem na strategię komercyjną oraz kierunek rozwoju produktów inStreamly.

  • Projekty o dużej skali:Możliwość współpracy z topowymi markami w Polsce i na świecie

  • Kulturę zaufania i autonomii:działamy w poczuciu extreme ownership, opartym na partnerstwie, szczerości i dużej decyzyjności.

  • Udziały w firmie (ESOP):Wierzymy w budowanie wspólnej wartości, dlatego oferujemy program akcji pracowniczych - stajesz się współwłaścicielem biznesu, który rozwijasz.

  • Model remote-first: Pracujemy w 100% zdalnie i asynchronicznie, stawiając na efekty, a nie godziny spędzone przed monitorem.

  • Nielimitowany płatny urlop:Ufamy naszemu zespołowi i stawiamy na work-life balance bez sztywnych limitów dni wolnych.

  • Kompleksowe wsparcie zdrowotne:Prywatna opieka medyczna oraz dedykowane wsparcie psychologiczne.

We’re looking for a VP-level AI Architect to define and drive a consistent, modern AI- and agentic-first architecture across CrowdStrike. This company-wide role spans business units, customer-facing products, shared platforms, and internal AI capabilities.


You’ll connect AI applications with the software and infrastructure that make them work at scale.   • Architect production AI systems for performance, resilience, and scale. Benchmark model and serving options, investigate bottlenecks across software and infrastructure, and improve latency, throughput, and compute efficiency. Guide deployment choices across cloud and edge environments.

Establish reproducible workflows, automated quality gates, and observability for model quality, agent task success, reliability, and cost. Build safe rollout, rollback, and recovery into production systems.
  • Embed security, governance, and auditability into AI architectures. Define permissions and execution boundaries for agents, address prompt injection and data exposure, and make system actions traceable. Partner with Security and Legal to translate requirements into practical engineering controls.

What You’ll Need:

  • Strong foundations in distributed systems, software design, APIs, and performance engineering, with the ability to work across application and infrastructure layers.
  • Practical experience with model integration, inference serving, retrieval, and evaluation, including the tradeoffs involved in deploying and operating AI systems at scale.
  • Experience establishing shared platforms and engineering standards across independent teams. Ability to align senior stakeholders, explain architectural tradeoffs, and mentor engineers through implementation.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.

jobs.excerpt: Do You... 1.  Get genuinely excited about testing campaign changes, analyzing the data, and optimizing for better results?
jobs.description:
Do You...

1. Get genuinely excited about testing campaign changes, analyzing the data, and optimizing for better results?

2. Think analytically rather than emotionally—trusting data over hunches, and learning just as much from failures as from wins?

3. Have hands-on experience managing substantial advertising budgets across multiple platforms (Google Ads, Facebook, TikTok, YouTube)?

4. Thrive on structured experimentation, documenting results, and systematically applying learnings to future campaigns?

5. Enjoy collaborating with creative, product, and engineering teams to solve growth problems end-to-end?

6. Have the discipline to work independently in a remote environment, maintain meticulous documentation, and report results weekly?

7. Combine the mindset of a scientist (hypothesis, testing, measurement) with the execution of an operator (speed, rigor, results)?

8. Take ownership of outcomes and continuously ask: 'How can we improve this?'

If you answered yes to most of these questions, we would love to talk to you!

Tasks

The Role

We are seeking a hands-on Performance Marketing Lead who thinks like a scientist, operates like an engineer, and reports like a professional. This is an execution-focused role for someone who loves solving growth problems, testing ideas, and seeing measurable business impact from their work.

This is not an administrative role; you'll be in the campaigns daily. You'll set up tracking, optimize targeting, launch experiments, analyze results, and make recommendations backed by data. You'll work closely with creative, product, and analytics teams to continuously improve customer acquisition and campaign efficiency.

The ideal candidate combines the empathy of understanding customer experience with the discipline of a process-driven operator—meticulous on documentation, firm on timelines, rigorous in testing, and persuasive in presenting data-backed recommendations.

Requirements

What You'll Own

As Performance Marketing Lead, you will own the following functional areas:

1. Daily Paid Media Execution & Campaign Optimization

2. Build, launch, and manage campaigns across Google Ads (Search, Display, Performance Max), Microsoft Ads (Bing), YouTube, and TikTok

3. Monitor campaign health daily: CTR, conversion rates, CPC, CAC, ROAS

4. Manage budgets to maximize ROI; scale winning campaigns, pause underperformers

5. Refine audience targeting, keywords, bidding strategies based on performance data

6. Report campaign performance to CEO weekly with clear insights and recommendations

Structured Experimentation & Learning Program

1. Design and execute 4-6 structured experiments per week across targeting, keywords, bidding, creative, landing pages, offers

2. Document 100% of experiment results with hypothesis, results, insights, and business impact

3. Conduct weekly performance reviews with CEO: analyze results, identify winners, plan next week's tests

4. Systematically scale winning experiments into ongoing campaigns; retire underperforming approaches

Creative Performance & Collaboration

1. Analyze ad performance by creative asset; identify winners and detect creative fatigue

2. Provide data-driven feedback to Creative Strategist on what's working and what to test next

3. Scale high-performing creative; test new hooks, messaging, and offers continuously

4. Work with the creative strategist to maintain the pipeline

Funnel Optimization & Cross-Team Collaboration

1. Analyze acquisition funnel end-to-end: ad click → landing page → registration → paid member

2. Work with Product/Design on landing page optimization and A/B testing

3. Collaborate with Engineering on registration flow optimization and conversion improvement

4. Provide weekly funnel insights to Product, Engineering, and Sales teams

Analytics, Reporting & Data Integrity

1. Set up and maintain accurate tracking via Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, platform native reporting

2. Track all key metrics: impressions, clicks, conversions, CTR, CPC, CAC, ROAS, cost-per-registration

3. Prepare detailed weekly reports for CEO on revenue, ROAS by channel, CAC trends, and actionable insights

4. Ensure data integrity and troubleshoot tracking issues across all platforms

Qualifications:

1. 5+ years managing paid digital advertising campaigns at scale

2. Demonstrated track record of improving measurable business results through paid acquisition (revenue growth, CAC reduction, ROAS improvement)

3. Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads (Search, Display, Shopping, Performance Max)

4. Experience managing campaigns on at least one additional platform: Microsoft Ads (Bing), TikTok, YouTube, or Meta

5. Proven ability to set up tracking (Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager) and analyze marketing funnel metrics

6. Experience with A/B testing, experimentation, and landing page optimization

7. Strong analytical and quantitative skills; comfortable analyzing data and making evidence-based decisions

8. Excellent written and verbal communication skills; ability to explain complex concepts clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences

9. Comfortable working independently in a remote environment with minimal supervision

10. Highly organized, meticulous with documentation, and disciplined about process

Benefits

What We're Looking For

The ideal candidate:

1. Thinks analytically rather than emotionally

2. Takes ownership of outcomes and learns quickly from both successes and failures

3. Is naturally curious and continuously seeks improvement

4. Communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences

5. Thrives in a fast-moving environment where testing and optimization never stop

What Success Looks Like

Within your first six months, you will have:

1. Developed a deep understanding of our customer acquisition funnel

2. Identified the highest-impact opportunities to improve paid marketing performance

3. Established a consistent cadence of structured experimentation

4. Improved campaign efficiency across multiple advertising channels

5. Built strong working relationships with Creative, Product, Engineering, and Analytics

6. Reduced acquisition costs while increasing marketing-generated revenue

7. Delivered reporting that helps leadership make better marketing decisions

About Together Light Inc.

Together Light Inc. operates several online businesses serving an international customer base, including Christian Filipina, Filipino Visa, and related travel services. Every month, thousands of prospective customers discover our brands through paid advertising.

We believe exceptional marketing is built through disciplined experimentation, rapid learning, and continuous optimization—not opinions.

We're looking for a hands-on Performance Marketing Lead who enjoys solving difficult growth problems, improving advertising performance, and using data to make better decisions.

This is an execution-focused role for someone who loves testing ideas, optimizing campaigns, and continuously improving results.

Company: Playbypoint
Team: Core Platform
Location:LATAM remote. Open to other timezones with overlap to UTC-3 / UTC-5.
Employment: Full-time
Reports to: SVP of Engineering



About Playbypoint

We're a rapidly expanding startup at the forefront of the racquet sports industry. At Playbypoint, we specialize in providing innovative enterprise software solutions that empower clubs, players, and coaches to streamline their operations and enhance their game. We're backed by top investors, trusted by leading clubs, and scaling fast – and we're looking for passionate individuals to join us in revolutionizing the racquet sports world with cutting-edge software.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Engineering Manager to lead our Core Platform team — a group of 10+ engineers responsible for the foundation everything else runs on: infrastructure, reliability, developer experience, billing, payments, and data.

This is a people-first role with deep technical roots. You'll set the direction for foundational systems, remove friction for the broader engineering org, and build a team that other teams depend on. We're looking for someone who came up as a strong individual contributor and chose to grow into leadership — someone who still thinks in systems, still reads the code, and still holds a high technical bar.

What You'll Do

  • Lead, grow, and develop a team of 10+ engineers across infrastructure, Payments, Data, Developer Experience, and L3 engineering.

  • Own the technical roadmap for Core Platform — partnering with engineering leadership and product to prioritize what the foundation needs next.

  • Drive reliability and operational excellence: define SLOs, lead incident response culture, close the loop on postmortems.

  • Reduce friction for the engineering org — improve CI/CD, local development, observability tooling, and deployment practices.

  • Own billing and payments infrastructure in partnership with the Payments team — ensuring correctness, scalability, and compliance.

  • Hire, mentor, and retain senior engineers. Build a team that sets the organization's technical standard.

  • Translate business constraints into platform capabilities — work across Finance, Product, and Engineering to ship foundational features that unlock product growth.

You Might Thrive in This Role If You

  • Have 8+ years of software engineering experience, with a meaningful portion in platform, infrastructure, or foundational systems — and 3+ years leading engineering teams.

  • Spanish and English business proficiency.

  • Grew into management from a strong IC track — you've been a staff or senior engineer and you still think like one.

  • Have led teams of 8 or more engineers and know how to develop talent, handle performance, and build team culture in a distributed environment.

  • Are technically credible: you can review architecture, participate in design discussions, and push back on technical decisions with conviction.

  • Have experience owning reliability at scale — SLOs, on-call culture, incident management, and the postmortem discipline that actually changes behavior.

  • Understand the economics of platform work: how to make the case for foundational investment, and how to balance long-term health with short-term delivery pressure.

  • Communicate clearly and default to async. Strong written and spoken English is a must — we work closely with US-based stakeholders and partners.

Engineering in the AI Era

We expect every engineer at Playbypoint to work with AI as a core part of their craft — not as a novelty, but as a force multiplier across the entire SDLC. That means:

  • Actively using AI tools throughout the development lifecycle — design, coding, code review, testing, debugging, and incident analysis.

  • Having built AI-powered tooling or agents — whether internal automation, LLM-integrated features, or workflow improvements that shipped to production.

  • Knowing when AI adds real value and when it doesn't — judgment matters more than enthusiasm.

We don't expect everyone to be an AI researcher. We do expect you to be fluent in the tools and patterns of the moment, and curious about what's next.

Bonus

  • Background in payments, billing systems, or fintech — understanding money movement, reconciliation, or PSP integrations.

  • Experience scaling engineering orgs during rapid headcount growth.

  • Familiarity with Ruby on Rails at scale, or similar monolith-era systems evolving toward service decomposition.

About ev.energy
We are building the world's largest EV-centric virtual power plant (VPP). By connecting to vehicles, chargers, batteries, solar, and other distributed energy resources, we turn households into flexible grid assets that balance supply and demand, preventing blackouts and reducing reliance on fossil fuels.
We are scaling rapidly across North America and Europe. We are moving fast, we are AI-first, and we are looking for builders who want to power the grid of the future.
