Olive & June opened its first location in Beverly Hills in 2013, and elevated the nail salon experience by giving women personalized attention and luxury service at an approachable price. Our founder, Sarah Gibson Tuttle, has since been on a mission to make beautiful nails accessible to everyone. With a growing line of nail care must-haves that are changing the at-home manicure game, Olive & June is a hyper-growth DTC ecommerce startup with meaningful momentum. We have best-in-class investors, huge press coverage, and most importantly, a strong community. We’re continuing to hire and would love to speak with you!

About the Role:

Olive & June is looking for an Assistant Manager of Retention Marketing to own execution across our email and SMS channels while taking strategic ownership of our retention programs. This is a high-visibility role on a fast-moving team. You’ll be a key driver of how we keep customers engaged, coming back, and deepening their relationship with the brand.

You’ll report to the Senior Manager of Lifecycle Marketing & CRM and work closely with the creative team, ecommerce team, and data partners to build strategy and programs that move the needle.

Email & SMS Execution

  • End-to-end campaign management across email and SMS: briefing, scheduling, QA, segmentation, and deployment
  • Day-to-day management of Klaviyo, including flows, segments, and list health
  • Campaign performance tracking and weekly reporting with clear, actionable takeaways
  • A/B test ideation, execution, and documentation of learnings

Retention Program Strategy

  • Strategic ownership of loyalty, referral, and membership programs - identifying opportunities to improve engagement, conversion, and LTV
  • Cross-functional collaboration to align program mechanics with broader brand and business goals
  • Ongoing analysis of program health with recommendations for optimization

Key Performance Indicators:

Channel Performance

  • Email and SMS revenue, revenue per recipient, and engagement vs. benchmarks
  • Flow performance across the full customer lifecycle, with ongoing optimization toward conversion and LTV
  • List health metrics including deliverability, unsubscribe rate, and opt-in growth

Retention Program Health

  • Loyalty program adoption, growth, engagement, and redemption rates
  • Referral program conversion and new customer acquisition contribution
  • Membership retention, churn, and revenue impact

What Success Looks Like

  • Within 90 days: fully ramped on channel execution, contributing to the campaign calendar strategy and producing weekly reporting independently
  • Within 6 months: owning the retention program campaign calendar end-to-end and driving measurable improvements to at least one retention program through data-backed strategy and testing
  • Within 12 months: demonstrable impact on repeat purchase rate and LTV across owned channels

Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing or related fields
  • 2-3 years of retention marketing experience, with hands-on email and SMS execution at the core
  • Strong working knowledge of Klaviyo (or comparable ESP)
  • Demonstrated ability to own a program end-to-end, from strategy through analysis
  • Strong analytical skills and ability to easily translate data into actionable insights; comfortable communicating performance insights and recommendations to cross-functional stakeholders
  • Experience with loyalty, referral, or membership programs
  • Highly organized and able to manage competing demands while adhering to deadlines
  • DTC or ecommerce background preferred

Company Benefits

  • 401k matching program
  • Competitive healthcare / dental care packages offered
  • Flexible vacation policy
  • Remote-first

Macnica Americas, Inc. is the North American division of Macnica Fuji Electronics Holdings, Inc. a $10 billion technology solutions provider with a stronghold in semiconductor distribution. Macnica excels in customizing solutions to client requirements and leveraging skilled engineers to expedite product development without compromising outcomes for our clients.

Learn more about the Macnica team members you’ll be joining!

Job Summary:

The Regional Director, Business Development & Strategic Sales- West is responsible for driving revenue growth, expanding strategic customer relationships, and increasing Macnica Americas' market presence throughout the Western United States. This senior-level role serves as both a strategic sales leader and a highly technical customer-facing resource, helping customers identify and implement semiconductor, networking, AI/IoT, imaging, and embedded solutions.

The successful candidate will have extensive experience in semiconductor distribution, electronic components, and solution-based selling. This individual will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, developing executive-level customer relationships, influencing design-win activity, and collaborating closely with supplier partners, Field Application Engineers (FAEs), Supplier & Solutions Management, and leadership.

This role requires the ability to engage with both engineering teams and executive decision-makers while independently managing a portfolio of strategic accounts and large business opportunities throughout the region.

Duties/Responsibilities:

  • Develop and execute strategic sales plans to drive revenue growth throughout the Western United States.

  • Identify, qualify, and pursue new business opportunities across key accounts, emerging customers, and targeted vertical markets.

  • Build and maintain strong relationships with engineering, procurement, operations, and executive leadership teams at customer organizations.

  • Drive design-win activity and revenue growth for Macnica's semiconductor, embedded, networking, imaging, AI/IoT, and solution offerings.

  • Own and manage a pipeline of opportunities from prospecting through design-win, production, and revenue realization.

  • Conduct high-level business and technical discussions with customer engineering teams to identify market opportunities and recommend solutions.

  • Deliver customer presentations, business reviews, and solution demonstrations with support from technical resources as necessary.

  • Work closely with Field Application Engineers to support technical evaluations, product qualifications, and customer design cycles.

  • Collaborate with Supplier & Solutions Management to align business strategies, supplier objectives, and customer opportunities.

  • Develop strategic account plans designed to increase wallet share and expand Macnica's presence within targeted accounts.

  • Monitor industry trends, competitive activity, market developments, and emerging technologies to identify new growth opportunities.

  • Provide market intelligence, customer feedback, and sales forecasts to leadership and supplier partners.

  • Support supplier business reviews, joint customer visits, and executive-level engagements.

  • Act as a trusted advisor to customers by providing both commercial and technical guidance throughout the sales process.

  • Meet or exceed assigned revenue, gross profit, design-win, and strategic growth objectives.

  • Develop, mentor, and manage a team of sales professionals within the territory, providing coaching, performance management, and strategic direction to drive business growth and achieve sales objectives.

  • Establish and maintain strong executive-level relationships, including engaging with C-suite leaders to identify strategic opportunities, align business objectives, and position Macnica as a trusted partner.

  • Travel throughout the territory as required to support customers, suppliers, and business development initiatives.

Requirements

Required Skills/Abilities:

  • Demonstrated success selling semiconductor, electronics, embedded, networking, or technology solutions within a B2B environment.

  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to communicate effectively with engineers, technical decision-makers, and executive leadership.

  • Proven ability to develop new business and close complex, long-cycle sales opportunities.

  • Experience managing strategic accounts and influencing customer purchasing decisions.

  • Excellent presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.

  • Strong understanding of semiconductor sales cycles, design-win processes, supply chain considerations, and electronic component markets.

  • Ability to develop and execute territory growth strategies with minimal supervision.

  • Experience collaborating across sales, engineering, product management, and supplier organizations.

  • Strong analytical, forecasting, and pipeline management skills.

  • Self-motivated, highly organized, and capable of managing multiple priorities simultaneously.

  • Proficient with CRM systems, Microsoft Office Suite, and sales reporting tools.

  • Proven experience leading, developing, and managing high-performing sales teams.

Education and Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent combination of education and industry experience.

  • 8-15 years of experience in semiconductor sales, electronics distribution, technical sales, business development, or strategic account management.

  • Experience working with suppliers, manufacturers, and engineering-focused customer organizations.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Operations Engineer - Email, Mautic & Data (Remote, Spain)
jobs.excerpt: If you love getting deep into servers, databases, networking, and the inner workings of how email really gets delivered at scale, you'll feel right at home with us.
jobs.description:
If you love getting deep into servers, databases, networking, and the inner workings of how email really gets delivered at scale, you'll feel right at home with us.

At Metricool you will be able to do so with real ownership and ample room to make the system your own. You will have the possibility to work 100% remotely, working in a high-growth international B2B SaaS, in which all members love to create, work in teams, analyze and help Community Managers make their work easier.

Your mission is to become the dedicated, specialized owner of our Mautic infrastructure (hosted on AWS, sending through Amazon SES), working closely with Borja, who will be your technical lead, and partnering with Marketing, Product, Data and Revenue to move the team from firefighting to a stable, scalable system. In the medium term, you'll also help build out our data platform and attribution work.

In this position, you will be able to make a wonderful contribution and impact in different areas:
As Senior Technical Operations Engineer,
Systems optimisation: optimise the servers, heavy MySQL databases (slow queries, indexes, table maintenance, historical data cleanup) and queues (RabbitMQ) behind our Mautic instance, a very large setup sending millions of emails a day, hosted on AWS and sending through Amazon SES.

  • Mautic process improvement: improve how Mautic processes run (segment synchronization, campaigns, sending jobs, croons) so segments update daily and reflect reality, and sends are fast.

  • System stability: monitor sends, queues and servers, detect and fix issues before they impact a campaign, and scale the platform so it can send ~3M emails/day without outages.

  • Keep deliverability (SPF/DKIM/DMARC, bounces, complaints) running smoothly. It's already automated, so this is more about occasional fine-tuning than a main focus.

  • Handle and triage requests and bug reports from Marketing (and Product) via Slack: reproduce, fix, explain, and follow up.

  • Respond to incidents during sends. There's no formal on-call, but availability is expected when a send is failing, and you'll always have backup.

  • Maintain and evolve Mautic's custom code (PHP/Symfony plugins and modules), using AI tools as support.

  • Document the architecture, runbooks and fixes.

  • Medium term: contribute to our data platform (ClickHouse, Python export pipelines, Go services, Aerospike) and to attribution.

As a Team Member,

  • Cross-functional Alignment: Collaborate closely with Marketing, Product, Data and Revenue, turning their tickets and complaints into lasting fixes rather than quick patches.

  • Continuous Improvement: Share what you learn, document fixes and runbooks, and help the team move from firefighting to a stable, scalable system.

  • Culture of Excellence: Work side by side with Borja, your technical lead, and support a feedback-driven, service-minded environment.

Long story, short: How will your first days in Metricool look like?

  • First month: Full context on how Mautic is set up at Metricool, infrastructure, databases, queues, SES, integrations and known issues.

  • First Quarter: Mautic is stable, segments update correctly, databases run healthily and Mautic doesn't go down. You'll take part in this year's Black Friday sending process and start preparing to take full ownership of it next year.

  • To the moon: Mautic works perfectly. You've helped build internal processes, advanced reporting and specific customizations on top of it, and you're already contributing to our data work.

Job requirements. You'll be successful on your mission if you have:

  • The candidate must be located in Spain.

  • Seniority: at least 5 years of experience in systems, infrastructure or technical operations.

  • Experience: the knowledge of a senior technical support specialist at a hosting company, covering servers, Linux, DNS, infrastructure, networking, traffic, email sending, domain reputation and security.

  • Proven experience administering and optimizing MySQL databases under heavy load.

  • Languages: English is mandatory (minimum B2); Spanish is highly preferred.

Hard skills:

  • PHP, with Symfony as a strong plus.

  • Experience with AWS (EC2, SES) is highly valuable.

  • Experience managing email-sending infrastructure is highly valuable.

  • Bonus, not required from day one: Mautic itself, RabbitMQ, Aerospike, ClickHouse and data pipelines, Go, and using AI tools to write and maintain code.

Soft skills:

  • Loves solving problems and keeping complex systems running, with a strong service mindset.

  • Understands the needs of non-technical teams and communicates clearly with them, without taking bug reports or tickets personally.

  • Stays calm and curious under a high volume of requests.

  • Genuine curiosity and passion for how the Internet works, backed by solid hands-on fundamentals.

  • Collaborative and low-ego, seeing Marketing and Product as partners

Why will you fall in love with Metricool?

  • Truly Remote: Work from wherever you're most productive. We provide the tools; you provide the talent.

  • 100% Flexible Schedule: We care about the work getting done, not the hours you're sitting at the desk. You organize your own time so you can live your life, as long as you're there to collaborate when the team needs you.

  • Health Insurance: We've got you covered so you can work with peace of mind.

  • Language Lessons: We're an international team speaking English, Spanish, French, and German. We'll help you learn a new language to help break down barriers and connect better with your colleagues.

  • The Epic Weekend: Once a year, we all get together in person to hang out, touch grass, and remind ourselves we're not just avatars on Slack.

  • Salary: We are actively working to align our budgets with market standards, offering highly competitive salary packages. For this position we estimate between 40,000€ and 47,000€ (annually)

  • Growth: We're a fast-growing company. If you're curious and take ownership, there's no ceiling here.

What are the steps of the hiring process?

  • First interview: cultural fit interview with People.

  • Second interview: get-to-know interview with Víctor and Borja.

If you are excited about the things that you just read, don't hesitate to apply for the job position!

jobs.title: Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) – Wealth Management
jobs.excerpt: Position SummaryThe Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) – Wealth Management is responsible for designing, implementing, and overseeing the compliance and regulatory framework for the wealth management business.
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Chief Compliance Officer (CCO) – Wealth Management is responsible for designing, implementing, and overseeing the compliance and regulatory framework for the wealth management business. The CCO ensures adherence to applicable securities laws, fiduciary obligations, anti-money laundering regulations, privacy requirements, and industry standards while promoting a culture of integrity, ethical conduct, and regulatory excellence.

The role serves as the primary advisor to executive leadership and the Board on compliance matters and provides independent oversight of regulatory risks across wealth advisory, private banking, investment management, brokerage, trust, and fiduciary services.

Key Responsibilities

Compliance Strategy & Governance

  • Develop and execute the enterprise-wide compliance strategy for the wealth management division.
  • Establish and maintain compliance policies, procedures, and governance frameworks.
  • Ensure compliance programs align with business objectives and regulatory expectations.
  • Advise executive leadership and the Board on emerging regulatory developments and compliance risks.
  • Promote a strong culture of ethics, integrity, and regulatory accountability.

Regulatory Compliance Oversight

  • Ensure compliance with applicable securities, investment advisory, fiduciary, and banking regulations.
  • Monitor regulatory developments and assess their impact on the organization.
  • Oversee regulatory examinations, inspections, and inquiries.
  • Coordinate responses to regulators and ensure timely remediation of findings.
  • Maintain effective relationships with regulatory authorities and industry bodies.

Wealth Management & Advisory Compliance

  • Oversee compliance programs covering:
    • Investment Advisory Services
    • Private Banking
    • Brokerage Services
    • Trust and Fiduciary Services
    • Retirement and Estate Planning Services
    • Discretionary Portfolio Management
  • Review new products, investment strategies, and business initiatives for regulatory compliance.
  • Ensure adherence to suitability, fiduciary, and best-interest obligations.

Financial Crime Compliance

  • Oversee Anti-Money Laundering (AML) and Know Your Customer (KYC) programs.
  • Ensure compliance with sanctions screening and anti-bribery regulations.
  • Monitor suspicious activity reporting and transaction surveillance programs.
  • Assess financial crime risks associated with clients, products, and jurisdictions.
  • Coordinate investigations and regulatory reporting requirements.

Surveillance, Monitoring & Testing

  • Establish risk-based compliance monitoring and testing programs.
  • Oversee employee trade surveillance and conflict-of-interest management.
  • Conduct periodic compliance reviews and control assessments.
  • Monitor client communications, marketing materials, and investment recommendations.
  • Ensure corrective actions are implemented for identified compliance issues.

Fiduciary & Conduct Risk Management

  • Ensure compliance with fiduciary duties and client best-interest standards.
  • Oversee management of conflicts of interest and disclosure requirements.
  • Promote fair treatment of clients and ethical business practices.
  • Assess conduct risks associated with advisor and relationship manager activities.

Training & Awareness

  • Develop compliance training programs for advisors, bankers, and employees.
  • Promote awareness of regulatory obligations and ethical standards.
  • Ensure timely completion of mandatory compliance certifications.
  • Provide advisory support to business units on compliance matters.

Reporting & Board Engagement

  • Prepare compliance reports for executive leadership, risk committees, and the Board.
  • Present compliance risk assessments, monitoring results, and regulatory updates.
  • Develop key compliance indicators (KCIs) and compliance dashboards.
  • Escalate significant compliance issues and regulatory concerns.

Leadership & Team Development

  • Lead and develop compliance professionals across multiple jurisdictions.
  • Build a high-performance compliance function.
  • Foster collaboration with legal, risk, audit, operations, and business teams.
  • Support succession planning and talent development initiatives.

Qualifications

Education

  • Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.
  • Master's degree, MBA, Juris Doctor (JD), or equivalent advanced qualification preferred.

Professional Certifications

Preferred certifications include:

  • Certified Regulatory Compliance Manager (CRCM)
  • Certified Anti-Money Laundering Specialist (CAMS)
  • Investment Adviser Certified Compliance Professional (IACCP)
  • Chartered Financial Analyst (CFA)
  • Bar admission or legal qualifications may be advantageous.

Experience

  • 12–15+ years of compliance, legal, regulatory, or risk management experience.
  • Significant experience within wealth management, private banking, asset management, or brokerage environments.
  • Experience interacting with regulators, boards, and executive leadership teams.
  • Demonstrated success leading enterprise compliance programs.
  • Strong knowledge of fiduciary and investment advisory regulations.

Technical Competencies

  • Wealth Management Compliance
  • Securities Regulation
  • Investment Advisory Compliance
  • Fiduciary Oversight
  • AML/KYC Compliance
  • Financial Crime Prevention
  • Regulatory Change Management
  • Compliance Monitoring & Testing
  • Conduct Risk Management
  • Trade Surveillance
  • Conflict of Interest Management
  • Regulatory Reporting
  • Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC)
  • Data Privacy & Information Security Compliance

Leadership Competencies

  • Strategic Leadership
  • Ethical Judgment
  • Regulatory Influence
  • Executive Communication
  • Board Engagement
  • Risk-Based Decision Making
  • Stakeholder Management
  • Change Management
  • Team Leadership
  • Problem Solving

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

  • Regulatory Examination Outcomes
  • Compliance Breach Frequency
  • AML/KYC Compliance Effectiveness
  • Timely Regulatory Filings
  • Compliance Monitoring Results
  • Employee Training Completion Rates
  • Remediation of Regulatory Findings
  • Fiduciary Compliance Performance
  • Internal Audit Results
  • Client Complaint and Conduct Metrics

jobs.description:
About Curve Dental:

Build the Intelligence Layer for Modern Dentistry

Curve Dental is the leading cloud-based dental practice management platform, helping thousands of dental practices streamline operations, improve patient experiences, and grow their businesses.

We’re entering the next phase of the Curve platform. We believe the future of dental software isn’t simply AI-powered, it is AI-enabled. Curve is building a shared intelligence platform that brings agentic AI into every aspect of the dental practice. From revenue cycle management and patient communications to scheduling, clinical documentation, insurance workflows, and operational automation, our goal is to create intelligent systems that help practices operate more efficiently while allowing dental teams to focus on delivering exceptional patient care.

To help bring this vision to life, we’re looking for an AI Platform Software Developer to join our team. Working alongside a highly experienced architecture team, you’ll bring deep expertise in agentic AI, machine learning, and intelligent systems while helping shape how AI is applied across the Curve platform.

This is a hands-on development role where you’ll collaborate on architectural decisions, build production AI capabilities, and help establish the development patterns and practices that enable intelligent applications across our products.

We move quickly, collaborate closely, and take ownership. Whether you’re designing a new platform capability, reviewing code, troubleshooting a production issue, or helping another team solve a difficult technical challenge, you’ll be expected to jump in where needed and help deliver the best possible product.

This is an opportunity to help build the AI foundation that will power the next generation of dental software.

What You’ll Do

As an AI Platform Software Developer, you’ll work alongside our Architecture, Development and Product teams to help define and deliver the next generation of intelligent capabilities across the Curve platform.

This is a hands-on engineering role. You’ll spend the majority of your time designing, building, reviewing, and delivering production software while helping guide the technical direction of AI across the organization.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Partnering with the Architecture team to evolve Curve’s AI platform and establish development standards, reusable frameworks, and development patterns that enable teams to build intelligent applications at scale.
  • Collaborating on the technical design, development, testing, and delivery of production services, agentic workflows, MCP servers, machine learning capabilities, and shared platform components.
  • Writing high-quality production code while leveraging modern AI-assisted development tools, including Claude Code, to improve engineering productivity and software quality.
  • Working side-by-side with developers, product managers, and UX designers to transform business requirements into secure, scalable, maintainable production software
  • Performing technical design reviews, performing code reviews, mentoring developers, and contributing hands-on throughout the entire software development lifecycle
  • Solving complex development challenges involving distributed systems, intelligent workflows, APIs, cloud-native services, and modern AI technologies
  • Continuously evaluating emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and development practices, bringing practical ideas that improve both our products and the way we build them
  • Partnering with internal development teams and external partners to build, extend, and continuously evolve Curve’s AI platform
  • Taking ownership of production software by helping troubleshoot complex issues, improving reliability, and ensuring our AI capabilities meet the high standards our customers expect

What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for an exceptional software developer who combines deep hands-on AI expertise with a passion for building production systems.

Required Qualifications

  • 8+ years of professional software development experience building scalable SaaS applications
  • 3+ years designing, building, and deploying production AI applications, platforms, or intelligent workflow solutions
  • Demonstrated experience taking AI solutions from proof-of-concept through production deployment and continuously improving them through evaluation, monitoring, iteration, and operational feedback
  • Demonstrated experience writing high-quality production code and delivering software that customers rely on every day
  • Strong expertise in modern backend development, with experience in Python or similar technologies
  • Experience building or extending agentic AI systems, MCP servers or similar integration frameworks, machine learning solutions, and LLM based applications
  • Strong understanding of distributed systems, APIs, cloud-native architectures and modern software development practices
  • Experience participating in technical architecture discussions and collaborating across development teams to solve complex technical challenges
  • Passion for mentoring developers through technical design, code reviews, pair programming, and hands-on collaboration
  • Experience supporting and operating production software, including troubleshooting complex issues and driving problems through resolution
  • Experience using AI-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, Cursor, GitHub Copilot, or similar technologies with a desire to continually improve productivity and quality
  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment, embraces ownership, and enjoys tackling difficult technical challenges wherever they arise

Preferred Qualifications

Experience with one or more of the following:

  • Production AI platforms (LangGraph, Amazon Bedrock, OpenAI, Anthropic, or similar technologies)
  • Agentic AI frameworks and MCP servers, and AI integration ecosystems
  • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), vector databases, and semantic search
  • Production AI operations, including model deployment, evaluation, observability, governance, or MLOps
  • Conversational AI, speech technologies or customer facing AI applications
  • Building AI capabilities within large-scale, multi-tenant SaaS platforms
  • Experience building software in healthcare or other highly regulated environments

As an engineer on the team you'll contribute across the full spectrum of our systems, from foundational processing and storage to scalable pipelines to the frameworks, tools, and internal applications that make data easily and efficiently available.

We have a number of open roles within the Data Platform team, each with a different focus area; read on to see if you'll be a good fit as a Data Engineering Platform Engineer.

This role sits between our platform and the analysts, data scientists, and data engineers who use it every day. You'll build the SDKs, self-service apps, and abstractions that let thousands of pipelines and analyses run without those users needing to understand the plumbing underneath.

What you'll do:

  • Build and maintain data integration and processing SDKs used by data teams and internal services across Coinbase.
  • Design and build self-service applications that let analysts and data scientists create, manage, and troubleshoot their own pipelines without deep platform knowledge.
  • Build tooling for data security and observability: access controls across storage and access layers, data quality tracking, dataset cataloging and lineage, usage auditing.
  • Work cross-functionally: consult upstream teams on structuring their databases to expose good data APIs, and give downstream data scientists well-designed, well-documented data models and metrics.
  • Convert functional requests from data analysts, ML, and security & compliance into reusable, scalable patterns.

Company overview:

TraceLink is the world’s largest Agentic Business Network, enabling life sciences and healthcare companies to build and manage a scalable digital workforce of governed, no-code AI agents that execute and coordinate mission-critical supply chain operations alongside human teams. Powered by the Integrate-Once™ OPUS platform, TraceLink links more than 300,000 network participants, enabling multi-enterprise processes at global scale.

Founded in 2009 with the simple mission of protecting patients, today Tracelink has 5 global offices, over 800 employees and more than 1700 customers in over 60 countries around the world. Our expanding product suite continues to protect patients and now also enhances multi-enterprise collaboration through innovative new applications such as MINT.

Tracelink is recognized as an industry leader by Gartner and IDC, and for having a great company culture by Comparably.

The Senior SC Business Process Architect is as a strategic and trusted advisor to customers evaluating TraceLink's Supply Chain Agentic Business Process solutions as they navigate their agentic Supply Chain journey.


Working closely with Sales Executive, Product Management, Value Engineering, Professional Services, and customer teams, the Senior SC Business Process Architect leads discovery sessions, evaluates current end-to-end supply chain processes and systems, and designs Agentic Business Process solutions aligned with the customer's Agentic Supply Chain Operating Model and Operating System.


The role also delivers tailored demonstrations, solution presentations, technical workshops, and responses to RFPs and RFIs.


As an Senior SC Business Process Architect is focused on Supply Chain Agentic Business Processes, you are the primary technical expert and strategic advisor guiding customers through the adoption of TraceLink's OPUS Platform, OPUS Agents, Agentic Control Tower and Agentic Business Network.


Many customers pursue a Track & Trace journey at the same time. When they do, the Senior SC Business Process Architect works with the Track & Trace Sales and Architect teams, ensuring customers experience a coordinated commercial engagement across both journeys.


Key Responsibilities

Drive Adoption of Agentic Business

  • Partner with the Sales Executive to manage the customer journey, acting as a trusted advisor who helps prospects identify, map, and evolve their current end-to-end supply chain processes into Agentic Business Processes.
  • Own and facilitate structured discovery to understand the customer's use cases and archetype, mapping how a prospect's supply chain planning, execution, and orchestration processes will evolve.
  • Become a trusted advisor for executive, business, supply chain, operations, and IT stakeholders.
  • Support Customer Operational Reviews, Executive Business Reviews, commercial planning sessions and strategic account reviews to reinforce TraceLink's value story.
  • Develop deep expertise in each customer's supply chain operating model, business priorities, and digital and agentic transformation initiatives.
  • Translate those findings into a defensible future-state roadmap that shows the customer exactly how they move from their current-state architecture toward the Agentic Supply Chain Operating Model, reducing manual touchpoints across the supply chain.
  • Introduce Track & Trace ABP to show additional value from the TraceLink platform, and support colleagues working on the Track & Trace opportunities.

Deliver Solution-Centric Demonstrations/Workshops

  • Own, manage and deliver product presentations build on thorough customer discovery and focused on the prospect's use cases.
  • Prepare materials for and lead interactive solutioning workshops and demonstrations. Review the customer’s supply chain architecture and process flows, and map TraceLink capabilities to specific operational and financial outcomes.
  • Design and present the customer's future-state Agentic Supply Chain Operating Model, including where OPUS Agents can absorb work done manually, such as exception triage, order orchestration, or supply/demand reconciliation before it becomes a disruption.
  • Position Supply Chain-related Agentic Business Processes that improve operational efficiency, resilience, and customer business outcomes.
  • Position the OPUS Platform, OPUS Agents, Agentic Control Tower, and Agentic Business Network, along with additional capabilities including MINT, POET, and future Supply Chain products and services.
  • Work collaboratively with Value Engineering to build executive business cases that demonstrate measurable operational and financial outcomes.

Subject Matter Expertise in Supply Chain Agentic Business Processes

  • Serve as the definitive expert on TraceLink's Supply Chain Agentic Business Processes solutions , the go-to voice when a deal's technical credibility is on the line.
  • Maintain deep, current knowledge of end-to-end supply chain business processes and how TraceLink's OPUS Platform and OPUS Agents are architected to transform them.
  • Confidently handle complex use cases and technical inquiries across planning, execution, and orchestration processes.

Cross-Functional Feedback Loop

  • Act as the connection between the field and the product organization, relaying market feedback on evolving supply chain requirements and recurring customer pain points to Product Management, the Center of Excellence, and Professional Services.
  • Ensure that proposed solutions are built for the customer's long-term value, not just the immediate deal, and that patterns observed across deals actively inform the product roadmap.
  • Represent customer priorities internally and advocate for customer success across the organization.
  • Help identify commercial, operational, competitive, and customer health risks.

Drive the Technical Win

  • Own technical accuracy at every stage of the sales process — the person other stakeholders trust to have gotten the details right.
  • Provide high-quality, well-substantiated inputs for complex RFPs and RFIs, often under tight turnaround windows and with significant deal value riding on the response.
  • Collaborate with the Sales Executive on closing strategies and on running the Agentic Accelerator Program to improve close rates and recurring revenues Support disciplined MEDDPICC-based opportunity qualification and accurate scoping throughout the sales cycle.

Skills & Qualifications

Experience

  • 5+ years in a client-facing role combining technical presales and strategic consulting (e.g., Business Process Architecture, Solution Consulting, Implementation Services, or Supply Chain Consulting) within Enterprise SaaS, life sciences, or supply chain environments.
  • Consultative & Value Selling: Demonstrated expertise in consultative and business value selling methodologies.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present both business and technical topics to individuals at all levels of an organization.
  • Exceptionally strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills.
  • Familiarity with cloud hosting architecture.
  • Demonstrated track record of sales achievement, technical competence, and customer satisfaction.
  • Team player and collaborator.
  • Innovative thinking to open expansion opportunities within Supply Chain ABP and Track & Trace.
  • Up to 35% travel.

Preferred Experience

  • Life sciences, healthcare, supply chain, ERP, or enterprise SaaS experience.
  • Knowledge of supply chain planning, execution, business process transformation, operational excellence, or enterprise AI.
  • Experience working in cross-functional enterprise commercial organizations and matrixed global organizations.

What Success Looks Like

Successful Agentic SC Business Process Architects serve as the trusted advisor for the customer’s agentic Supply Chain journey. They partner with the Sales Executive to translate customer supply chain transformation challenges into compelling technical solutions, lead discovery to uncover business and system requirements, and design and deliver demonstrations and proof-of-value engagements that showcase new Supply Chain Agentic Business Processes powered by the OPUS Platform and OPUS Agents. They bring deep domain and product fluency to every customer interaction, build credible technical relationships with stakeholders across supply chain, operations, and IT, and support disciplined sales processes with clear, defensible solution designs and accurate scoping. They understand the customer's business to consider expansion opportunities across both Supply Chain and Track & Trace. By combining strong technical expertise with consultative rigor, they collaborate seamlessly across sales, product, and delivery to maximize long-term customer value across both commercialization journeys while enabling predictable business results.


TraceLink Mission / Vision / Values

Mission

TraceLink empowers every business to rapidly and affordably transform its supply chain into an intelligent orchestration network powered by a breakthrough integrate-once platform.

Intelligent Business Networks for the Greater Good of Humanity.

Values

jobs.description:
Project Manager

Program Management | Full-Time, Salaried | Reports to the Co-CEOs

Company Seeking.com (Reflex Media)

Location Remote, anywhere in the USA.

Compensation $75,000 to $105,000 base.

Travel Occasional travel to Las Vegas for quarterly planning and major project kickoffs.

About the Role

Seeking.com is the world's largest premium dating platform, founded and led by an MIT alumnus and headquartered in Las Vegas.

We are hiring a Project Manager to join our Program Management team, reporting directly to the Co-CEOs. You will work side by side with our Director of Program Management, the senior member of the team, and take full ownership of a slate of live projects across engineering, product, AI, and marketing.

Your job is delivery. You take each project from intake to closeout: scope, plan, schedule, risks, dependencies, status, and the retrospective at the end. On any project you own, leadership always knows where it stands and the team always knows what happens next.

Technical work runs in Jira. Marketing work runs in Monday. Documentation lives in Confluence. You work fluently across all three.

Who Should Apply

We are especially open to candidates from these backgrounds:

  • Project Managers at software, digital, or product companies who have run several concurrent projects and can show the numbers they moved
  • Technical Project Managers who have delivered engineering work and are comfortable coordinating with marketing
  • Agency or professional services Project Managers who have owned SOWs, scope changes, and client reporting and want to go in-house
  • Marketing or Growth Operations professionals who have grown into full-lifecycle project ownership

Titles vary. A track record of shipping on time is the bar.

What You'll Find on Day One

  • Operations and technical teams actively running their work in Jira, with sprints, boards, and owners in place
  • A backlog of legacy epics from projects abandoned as far back as seven years ago, ready to be reviewed and cleaned up
  • Marketing projects running in Monday, with hand-offs to engineering that need a clear owner
  • A draft intake and governance framework that needs to be tested on real projects
  • A Director of Program Management as your senior teammate, and Co-CEOs who read project status every week
  • Permission to fix what you find. If a workflow is slowing delivery, you change it.

What You'll Own

Project Delivery, End to End

  • Own a slate of concurrent projects from intake through closeout. Write the project charter for each: objective, success metric, sponsor, scope, milestones, and budget where one applies.
  • Break scope into a work breakdown, a realistic schedule, and a critical path. Keep baselines honest as the work evolves.
  • Choose the delivery approach that fits the work: predictive, Agile, or hybrid.
  • Run kickoffs, working sessions, and project standups for the projects you own. Facilitate sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives where a team needs them.
  • Close every project with a retrospective and a lessons-learned entry in Confluence.

Scope, Change, and Risk Control

  • Guard scope. Every change request gets a written impact on timeline, cost, and resources, and a named decision-maker.
  • Maintain a RAID log (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies) for every project. Surface each risk early with a proposed mitigation.
  • Map dependencies between engineering and marketing and resolve them before they become blockers.
  • Manage vendor and contractor deliverables against their statements of work.

Status, Reporting, and Stakeholder Communication

  • Publish a weekly status for each project: health, progress against milestones, risks, and decisions needed. Short, specific, and read once.
  • Feed accurate project-level data into the portfolio view the Director of Program Management presents to the Co-CEOs.
  • Tailor communication to the audience. An engineer, a marketer, and a Co-CEO each get the level of detail they need.
  • Escalate early when a project is at risk. Bring the problem, the options, and your recommendation.

Tool Hygiene and Process Improvement

  • Keep every project you own clean in Jira and Monday: named owners, due dates, current status, and a definition of done.
  • Lead the cleanup of legacy epics from abandoned projects. Confirm status with the original teams, archive or close what is finished or dead, and re-plan anything that still matters.
  • Apply the draft intake and governance framework on live projects and report back on what works and what needs to change.
  • Build templates, checklists, and runbooks so each new project starts faster than the last.

Supporting the OKR Cadence

  • Link each of your projects to the Key Result it serves, so every project has a clear line to a company objective.
  • Support the Director of Program Management in running quarterly OKR planning and weekly check-ins in Monday: prepare the data, collect updates, and track follow-ups to closure.

Required Qualifications

  • Three or more years of hands-on project management experience delivering software, digital, or marketing projects, with several projects running at once.
  • A delivery record you can quantify. On-time rates, cycle times, defect rates, or budget performance you improved, and by how much.
  • Command of core project management practice: charters, schedules, critical path, RAID logs, change control, and stakeholder management.
  • Comfortable running Agile, predictive, and hybrid delivery, and choosing the right approach for the work.
  • Hands-on experience with Jira and a work management platform such as Monday or Asana. You will operate fluently in Jira, Monday, and Confluence within your first 60 days.
  • Accountability with warmth. You hold engineers, marketers, and leaders to their commitments, and they come away feeling helped. References on this will be checked.
  • Clear, concise writing. Your status updates and meeting notes stand on their own.
  • Business acumen. You understand why each project matters to the company and you manage toward that outcome.

Ready to join a mission that matters? The future of cybersecurity starts with you.


About the Role:
CrowdStrike's engineering organization is scaling its use of agentic AI across the software development lifecycle — from code generation to review to testing and release. As an AI SDLC Engineer, you'll help drive that transformation: building the platforms and workflows that let engineers ship faster, offload well-scoped work to AI agents with confidence, and spend more of their time on the hardest problems. You'll partner closely with engineering teams to identify friction points across the dev lifecycle and turn them into automated, agent-driven capabilities — with an eye toward efficient use of compute and model spend along the way.


What You'll Do:


  • Design and build agentic workflows that let engineers automate more of the SDLC — from code generation and review to testing and release — with confidence in the output.
  • Improve context-grounding systems so agents resolve the right information on the first try, cutting slow, error-prone multi-turn search out of the workflow.
  • Tune model-routing so each task runs on the model best suited to it — matching capability to the job at hand, with cost efficiency as one input among several.
  • Build observability and quality tooling — dashboards, usage insights, benchmark suites — that give engineers confidence in what agents are doing and how well they're doing it.
  • Establish internal benchmarks graded against real-world tasks (bug detection, review quality, latency) to validate improvements empirically rather than by intuition.
  • Partner closely with engineering teams to identify high-friction points in their workflows and turn them into automated, agent-driven capabilities.
  • Contribute to the broader engineering culture of responsible, effective AI adoption across the organization.

  • Hands-on experience building or operating LLM-agent infrastructure — harnesses, tool-integration protocols, subagent orchestration, or similar.
  • Strong understanding of LLM application mechanics: context windows, prompt design, caching, and reasoning/latency tradeoffs.
  • Proven experience utilizing AI technologies to enhance decision-making, streamline workflows and processes, improve efficiency and drive business outcomes.
  • Comfort working from ambiguous, evolving specs.
  • Go and/or Python proficiency.
  • Experience building internal developer platforms, observability tooling, or cost/governance dashboards.

Bonus Points:


  • Experience with modern AI coding agent frameworks or SDKs.
  • Familiarity with graph-based context systems (knowledge graphs, entity resolution) feeding LLM applications.
  • Background instrumenting or optimizing large-scale event pipelines.
  • Prior experience running a benchmark-driven optimization program (A/B testing, Pareto-frontier tracking) for a production system.

jobs.title: Senior Support Analyst, PowerFAIDS
jobs.excerpt: Senior Support Analyst, PowerFAIDS College Board - HMA Location:• This is a remote role.
jobs.description:
Senior Support Analyst, PowerFAIDS


College Board - HMA

Location:

  • This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type:

  • This is a full-time position

About the Team

The Financial Aid Programs and Services team at the College Board is a close knit, dedicated team of 27 people with a passion for higher education. The team is committed to providing exceptional tools and customer support to facilitate awarding over $10 billion in financial aid each year. In this position, you will work with a team of 7 responsible for PowerFAIDS onboarding, support, and training.


About the Opportunity

As a Senior Support Analyst, you ensure that users can effectively resolve issues and get the most out of PowerFAIDS, the leading standalone financial aid management system. You will play a key role in the direct support experience users have with the product, including troubleshooting complex issues, identifying root causes, and guiding customers to resolution. In this role you will diagnose and debug user-reported problems without predefined steps to follow, build strong relationships that drive customer retention, and contribute to training, documentation, and testing efforts that improve the product and user experience over time. Success in this role requires deep knowledge of PowerFAIDS, a robust understanding of financial aid administration, and the judgment to work through problems thoughtfully, escalating issues to the team when necessary.


In this role, you will:


Customer Support (70%)

  • Provide support services to PowerFAIDS users, maintaining our high standards for response and resolution times and high customer satisfaction.
  • Debug complex user problems by replicating and documenting client errors in-house, researching and identifying corrective actions, and reporting software anomalies to development.
  • Escalate issues where a resolution can't be reached, providing clear documentation of steps already taken so escalations move quickly.
  • Communicate clearly with customers throughout the resolution process, setting appropriate expectations on timing and next steps.
  • Build relationships with customers that help maintain high customer retention.

Software Testing, Training, & Documentation (20%)

  • Participate in software testing to ensure quality releases.
  • Participate in the design and delivery of customer-facing training materials, drawing on common support trends to identify training gaps.
  • Review release documentation for accuracy and clarity from a user's perspective.
  • Contribute to internal knowledge base articles and troubleshooting guides based on cases you've resolved.
  • Identify recurring or systemic issues and recommend product or documentation improvements to reduce future support volume.

Additional Responsibilities (10%)

  • Provide backup coverage for tasks owned by other support analysts when they are out.
  • Assist with the delivery of the annual PowerFAIDS User Group conference.
  • Stay current on Title IV regulatory changes and how they affect PowerFAIDS functionality and customer workflows.

About You

To qualify for this role, you must have:

  • A minimum of 4 years of experience in financial aid administration.
  • At least 2 years of experience working with PowerFAIDS.
  • A successful track record of hands-on troubleshooting and problem-solving experience, often reaching resolutions without having predefined steps to follow.
  • Strong customer service skills, including the ability to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Deep working knowledge of Title IV regulations and financial aid processes and how they play out operationally in PowerFAIDS.
  • Experience serving as a go-to resource for colleagues (e.g., being the person others in the office turn to when they need help in PowerFAIDS).
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain a fix or workaround to someone who is non-technical.
  • Ability to diagnose root cause rather than just symptoms (e.g., distinguishing "the software is behaving unexpectedly" from "this is actually how the software is expected to work").
  • Comfort managing multiple open issues at once and prioritizing based on urgency.
  • Comfort working independently and exercising sound judgment, without a script or predefined process to fall back on.

Differentiators (not required):

  • Experience with SQL, particularly writing queries.
  • Experience training or onboarding colleagues on PowerFAIDS or financial aid processes.
  • Experience contributing to or maintaining internal documentation, process guides, or training materials.

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise such as live coding, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.


A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $56,000 - $95,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • This role is non-exempt, which means it is eligible to receive overtime pay for hours worked over 40 per week.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

jobs.excerpt: Imaginez-vous…• Réaliser un travail porteur de sens qui a un impact concret au quotidien sur le monde qui vous entoure.
jobs.description:
Imaginez-vous…

  • Réaliser un travail porteur de sens qui a un impact concret au quotidien sur le monde qui vous entoure.
  • Développer votre expertise et enrichir vos compétences à chaque projet.
  • S'épanouir au sein d'une équipe bienveillante et collaborative, qui vous encourage à viser l'excellence.

C’est possible avec un poste chez Linx Printing Technologies.

Linx, entreprise du groupe Veralto, est un leader mondial dans les solutions de codage et de marquage (dates et lots) pour les produits et emballages dans de nombreux secteurs industriels. En rejoignant Linx et le réseau Veralto, vous travaillerez sur des produits qui ont un impact direct sur l’alimentation, la santé et les biens essentiels du quotidien. Vous aurez l’opportunité de laisser votre empreinte et de concrétiser vos ambitions grâce à de réelles perspectives d’évolution.

Chez Linx, nous sommes convaincus que l’innovation et la créativité reposent sur la diversité et l’inclusion. Nous encourageons les candidatures de tous horizons.

Nous aspirons à agir avec empathie, comprendre concrètement les situations sur le terrain et prendre des décisions courageuses, guidées par l’intégrité. Ces valeurs guident notre manière d’attirer, d’accompagner et de fidéliser les talents, afin que chacun puisse s’épanouir et donner le meilleur de lui-même dans un environnement inclusif et tourné vers l’avenir.

Nos valeurs sont l’affaire de tous : nous les incarnons chaque jour, dans nos actions et nos décisions.

Faites connaissance avec votre manager: Sven Feldmann

En tant qu'Area Sales Manager – Champagne Bourgogne, vous serez responsable du développement des ventes d’équipements et de la fidélisation de vos clients, dans des secteurs variés. Vous pourrez, par exemple, échanger un jour avec le dirigeant d’un domaine viticole, et le lendemain présenter nos technologies dans une usine agroalimentaire. Chaque journée est différente.

Nous vous proposerons une formation approfondie pour maîtriser nos produits et notre marché : imprimantes jet d’encre industrielles petits caractères, impression haute résolution sur cartons et solutions laser. En complément de la vente d’équipements, vous proposerez également des solutions de financement et des contrats de service.

Il s’agit d’un poste entélétravail, couvrant la région Champagne Bourgogne, idéalement basé(e) à proximité de Reims,Troyes, Auxerre ou Dijon.

À quoi ressemble une journée type ?

  • Développer l’activité et accroître les ventes d’équipements en collaboration avec nos clients et prospects
  • Construire des relations à tous les niveaux, jusqu’aux équipes dirigeantes
  • Organiser et prioriser votre emploi du temps (2 sessions de prospection de 2h + 9 visites clients par semaine)
  • Piloter votre performance via des KPI et notre CRM (Salesforce)
  • Participer à des salons professionnels et à des démonstrations chez les clients

Profil recherché

  • Disponibilité pour des déplacements jusqu’à 4 jours par semaine (avec nuitées si nécessaire)
  • Expérience confirmée en gestion de comptes avec résultats de croissance durable
  • Expérience en vente de solutions / équipements industriels
  • Capacité à gérer un portefeuille clients étendu en toute autonomie
  • Rigueur et sens du détail
  • Connaissance d’un CRM (idéalement Salesforce)

Atouts supplémentaires

  • Expérience dans un environnement industriel ou de production
  • Appétence pour les produits technologiques
  • Formation ou expérience en électrotechnique ou mécanique

Linx est fière d’être une entreprise du segment Product Quality & Innovation au sein de Veralto (NYSE : VLTO). Imaginez un monde où chacun a accès à une eau potable sûre, à des aliments et des médicaments de qualité, et à des biens essentiels fiables : c’est le monde que Veralto construit dès aujourd’hui.
Veralto est un leader mondial des solutions technologiques essentielles, avec un chiffre d’affaires de 5 milliards de dollars et plus de 16 000 collaborateurs à travers le monde, répartis entre deux grands domaines : la qualité de l’eau et l’identification des produits, tous sont unis par une mission forte : Protéger les ressources les plus vitales de notre planète.

Great Place to Work®

Nous sommes certifiés Great Place to Work®, une reconnaissance de notre culture d’entreprise centrée sur l’humain, où chacun se sent valorisé, soutenu et encouragé à donner le meilleur de lui-même.

Diversité & Inclusion

Chez Linx, l’équité et l’inclusion ne sont pas des slogans : elles sont au cœur de nos actions. Nous sommes un employeur qui promeut l’égalité des chances. Soyez audacieux. Soyez vous-même. Épanouissez-vous chez nous.

Construisons l’avenir ensemble

Postulez dès maintenant pour rejoindre une équipe où votre contribution fait la différence et où votre voix compte.

Notre offre

Chez Linx, nous croyons au développement des talents et vous donnons les moyens de construire une carrière à la hauteur de vos ambitions. Nous recherchons des personnalités engagées, passionnées et tournées vers l’innovation, prêtes à saisir chaque opportunité de croissance.

Rejoindre Linx, c’est intégrer un environnement stimulant qui vous pousse à vous dépasser, relever des défis et accélérer votre évolution professionnelle.
Aux côtés de collègues talentueux et animés par les mêmes exigences, vous bénéficierez du soutien et des ressources nécessaires pour exprimer pleinement votre potentiel et faire progresser votre carrière.

Imagine yourself…

  • Doing meaningful work that makes an everyday impact on the world around you.
  • Growing your expertise and expanding your skillset with every project.
  • Thriving in a supportive team environment that inspires you to strive for excellence.

It’s possible with a role at Linx Printing Technologies (www.linxglobal.com).

Linx, a Veralto company, is a leading global provider of coding and marking solutions for date and batch coding of products and packaging across manufacturing industries. As part of the Linx team and the broader Veralto network, you’ll work with products that make an everyday impact on the food, medicine, and essentials we all rely on—and along the way, you’ll have the chance to make your mark and own your ambition with valuable career growth opportunities.

At Linx, we know that innovation and ingenuity start with prioritizing a diverse workforce and a deeply inclusive workplace. We encourage people from all backgrounds to apply to our positions. 

We aspire to lead with empathy, seek firsthand understanding through direct engagement with the work, and make courageous, integrity-driven decisions. These values shape the way we attract, support and retain talent, ensuring that everyone at Linx is empowered to contribute their best and grow in a purpose-led, inclusive and forward-thinking organisation.

Our values are everyone’s responsibility, we live them, lead with them, and bring them to life every day.

Meet Your Manager -

As the Area Sales Manager – Champagne Bourgogne you will be responsible for driving customer retention and equipment sales growth working closely with your existing customers across a broad range of industries. You could be talking to the CEO of a small winery one day and discussing our technology at a food factory the next. No two days are the same.

We will provide you with in-depth training to learn our products and industry to enable you to sell a range of Linx coding and marking equipment. This includes industrial small character inkjet, high resolution case printing and Laser solutions. In addition to selling hardware, you will promote a variety of finance and service agreements to our customers.

As this territory covers the Champagne Bourgogne area, and is a fully remote role, it would be ideal if you were located near to one of the large cities on your territory such as Reims, Troyes, Auxerre or Dijon.

In this role, a typical day will look like:

  • Business development and expansion of our equipment sales through partnering with existing and new customers.
  • Developing relationships at all levels up to and including the senior leadership.
  • Planning and prioritising your own diary to work on both long term and short term projects (2 x 2-hours lead generation sessions + 9 customer visits per week)
  • Managing sales activity through KPI’s and using our corporate CRM (SalesForce.com).
  • Participate in regional/national trade shows and onsite equipment demonstrations at customers’ sites.

The essential requirements of the job include:

  • Willingness to travel up to 4 days per week (nights away from home when required)
  • A proven track record in Account Management and evidence of sustained growth
  • Solution selling of capital equipment
  • Ability to take ownership over a broad portfolio of customers
  • Excellent attention to detail
  • Knowledge of a CRM (preferably SFDC) would be advantageous

It would be preferable if you also had:

  • Experience of solution selling into a manufacturing or production environment
  • An interest in technology
  • A background in electrical or mechanical engineering

Linx is proud to be a Product Quality & Innovation company in Veralto (NYSE: VLTO).  Imagine a world where everyone has access to clean water, safe food and medicine, and trusted essential goods. That is the tomorrow Veralto is creating today.  Veralto is a $5B global leader in essential technology solutions made up of over 16,000 associates across our Water Quality and Product Identification segments all united by a powerful purpose: Safeguarding the World’s Most Vital Resources. 

Great Place to Work® Certified
We’re certified as a Great Place to Work, a recognition that celebrates a culture we’ve built together where people come first, always. This certification reflects our commitment to creating a workplace where everyone feels valued, empowered, and inspired to do their best work.

Diversity Isn’t Just a Buzzword
At Linx, fairness and inclusion are the foundation of everything we do. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity workplace that welcomes people from every walk of life. Be bold. Be you. Thrive here.

Let’s Build the Future Together
Apply now to join a team where your contributions spark a change and your voice is heard. Let’s make some magic together.

Our offer

We grow talent; we give you the opportunity to develop your career based on your strengths. Linx is a career destination for engaged, passionate and talented people who are driven to seek innovation, growth and opportunity.

A career with Linx will push you and challenge you, providing growth opportunities and the prospects to advance your career.

As a driven high achiever, you will work with committed, like-minded people, giving you the support to reach your full potential.

At Veralto, we value diversity and the existence of similarities and differences, both visible and not, found in our workforce, workplace and throughout the markets we serve.Our associates, customers and shareholders contribute unique and different perspectives as a result of these diverse attributes.

Unsolicited Assistance

We do not accept unsolicited assistance from any headhunters or recruitment firms for any of our job openings. All resumes or profiles submitted by search firms to any employee at any of the Veralto companies, in any form without a valid, signed search agreement in place for the specific position, approved by Talent Acquisition, will be deemed the sole property of Veralto and its companies. No fee will be paid in the event the candidate is hired by Veralto and its companies because of the unsolicited referral.

👉 Apply now and help shape North Star Network’s content strategy across Eastern Europe.

jobs.title: Junior Funds Paralegal
jobs.excerpt: Join Scissero – Legal tech with lawyers built in.
jobs.description:
Join Scissero – Legal tech with lawyers built in.

About Us

Scissero is an AI-enhanced legal services company built for financial institutions. We combine expert legal support with intelligent automation, transforming how transactional law is delivered.

We’re not a traditional law firm. We are a diverse and globally distributed team of lawyers, engineers, and innovators working across the U.S., EMEA, and APAC. We believe technology augments, not replaces, legal expertise. Our culture values collaboration, inclusivity, and flexibility.

We are looking for a Junior Funds Paralegal to join our legal operations, fund formation structure charts team remotely from South Africa. In this role, you will work under the Senior Funds Lawyer to manage and maintain structure charts for clients in the private equity and corporate M&A space across our APAC and US jurisdictions. You will review and verify corporate formation documents, investor agreements, and ownership records to ensure our charts and documentation accurately reflect current corporate structures and comply with applicable regulatory requirements.

You will also work closely with Scissero's Product team, who are responsible for automating standard fund-formation and structure-chart processes using AI tools. You will help test, refine, and roll out these tools within the structure chart workstream, applying your own hands-on experience of the documentation to make automation genuinely useful in practice.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to a pioneering company that is transforming legal services through the intelligent integration of human expertise and cutting-edge AI.

Location: Johannesburg/Cape Town (Remote)

Time: 9-6 pm BST

Key Responsibilities

  • Structure Chart Drafting & Maintenance: Design, build, and maintain precise corporate structure charts for private equity and corporate M&A clients across APAC and US jurisdictions, ensuring they accurately represent current ownership and corporate linkages.

  • Document Verification and Analysis: Analyse and verify corporate formation documents and shareholder registers to establish ownership across various legal entities.

  • Investor & Transaction Documentation: Review and verify information in investor agreements and related transaction documentation to support private equity funds' compliance with applicable securities laws.

  • Client and Team Coordination: Collaborate with clients and the Fund Formation & Structure Chart team, including colleagues across APAC and US time zones, to compile essential data for the creation and ongoing updates of structure charts.

  • Product & AI Tooling Collaboration: Partner with Scissero's Product team to test, provide feedback on, and help refine the AI-enabled tools used to automate structure chart preparation and other standard fund-formation processes. Identify repetitive or manual tasks in the structure chart workflow that are good candidates for automation, and support the rollout of new tools once built.

  • Management Collaboration: Partner with the Senior Funds Lawyer and wider management to keep all diagrams current and in compliance with the latest legal standards.

  • Project Monitoring and Reporting: Monitor project timelines, maintain trackers and weekly progress reports, and communicate updates to clients and the Senior Funds Lawyer.

  • Legal Documentation Support: Support the drafting, reviewing, and management of legal documentation for corporate transactions. Handle the preparation, filing, and management of business entity documents with the relevant jurisdictional authorities for corporations, LLCs, and partnerships.

  • Compliance and Efficiency: Ensure strict adherence to legal compliance and regulations across the jurisdictions you support. Use legal software and AI-enabled tools to improve the efficiency and precision of chart preparation.

Skills and Qualifications Required:

  • No specific legal qualification or funds experience is required; a law degree, paralegal qualification, or background in company secretarial, fund administration, KYC, or governance support work is helpful but not essential.

  • Willingness and ability to learn corporate structures, entity documentation, and fund-formation processes on the job.

  • Robust knowledge of corporate structures, legal entities, and their interconnections across multiple jurisdictions.

  • Exceptionally organised, with an impeccable eye for detail and pride in producing accurate, well-structured documentation.

  • Genuinely enjoys putting documentation together and is comfortable with the repetitive, iterative nature of structure chart and document maintenance work.

  • A real interest in how AI tools can make legal documentation processes more efficient and enthusiasm for helping test and adopt new tools as they're developed.

  • High proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint, along with familiarity with legal management software.

  • Strong analytical skills and problem-solving acumen.

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills and comfortable liaising with colleagues and clients across different jurisdictions and time zones.

  • Ability to function both autonomously and collaboratively within a distributed, global team.

  • Dedicated to upholding strict confidentiality in all legal and client dealings.

  • Prior experience with investment funds operations and structures, ownership-structure review, or M&A due diligence is not necessary but would be highly valuable in this role.

Why Join Us?

  • Gain valuable experience at the forefront of AI-enhanced legal services.

  • Work with a diverse and innovative global client base, including leading financial institutions.

  • Opportunity for professional growth and development in a tech-enabled environment.

  • Join a dynamic, enthusiastic, and diverse team committed to collaboration and excellence.

  • Learn from experienced professionals across multiple disciplines and jurisdictions.

Global Benefits

  • Hybrid and remote working options, with the ability to request to work from other countries (upon request)

  • Paid Sick Leave: 7 days per year to recover or care for family.

  • Confidential Support: Employee Assistance Programme (EAP) offering mental health and wellbeing support.

  • Professional Development: 7 days per year of paid study leave annually for exams and structured learning.

  • Annual Bonus: Discretionary and performance-based.

  • Generous Paid Time Off: 20 days of annual leave, plus public holidays.

At Scissero, you’ll be part of a scale-up blending law and technology to create meaningful impact. If you’re excited about redefining the future of legal services with AI, apply now to join our team.

Inclusivity

At Scissero, we value diversity in all its forms and believe that varied perspectives make us stronger. We welcome applications from candidates of all backgrounds, identities, and experiences and are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive.

jobs.description:
Expression of Interest · Inquire First

We are meeting senior leaders for this planned function as we fundraise. This is an exploratory conversation, not an immediately funded salaried vacancy or a guaranteed start date. No cash salary is available today; any equity arrangement must be agreed separately. You are not being asked to begin work by expressing interest.

Use the Apply form below to introduce yourself and indicate your interest. We can discuss mutual fit, scope, funding, compensation, and timing before either side makes a commitment.

Remote · United States · Full time · Functional leadership

Build the product through which companies turn questions into experiments and evidence into decisions. Lead product engineering from architecture and customer workflows through reliable delivery and a growing team.

Why Subconscious

Subconscious is building the intelligence to run the economy. We start with a simulator for business decisions, using causal experiments on simulated markets to test products, pricing, messaging, and go-to-market choices before capital is committed. The long-term ambition is to help businesses discover unmet demand and build around what people actually need.

The function you will build

Own product engineering architecture, delivery standards, technical prioritization, and the product engineering hiring plan. Partner with design on usability, simulation engineering on experimental capabilities, and infrastructure on production operations.

This is a hands-on leadership role. Set the functional roadmap and propose staffing and spending priorities with the founding team. Hiring and budget commitments depend on approved resources; an established team or funded budget is not assumed.

Proposed first 90 days after joining

Use these as an initial agenda, refined with the founders against the product, customer needs, and resources at your start.

  • Trace a customer workflow end to end and identify the largest obstacles to completing a useful study.

  • Ship a focused improvement that connects interface, API, data model, and experimental execution, with observable behavior and clear failure states.

  • Establish engineering practices for tenant boundaries, data handling, testing, rollout, and recovery appropriate to enterprise use.

  • Build a roadmap that balances customer needs, maintainability, and research integration, with explicit staffing and budget proposals.

How we will judge progress

Customers complete workflows reliably and new capabilities reach them with fewer manual handoffs. Measure task completion, production defects, delivery lead time, and support burden. Keep critical product behavior understandable and maintainable as the team grows.

What you bring

  • You have led engineering for a production enterprise or technical product and can show architecture and delivery decisions you personally owned.

  • You can work across frontend, backend, APIs, and data systems while giving engineers clear direction and useful code review.

  • You can build a team, collaborate with designers and researchers, and stay hands-on when an important customer problem requires it.

We are looking for evidence of judgment, execution, and leadership. A particular company pedigree or previous executive title is not a substitute for that evidence.

Compensation and funding

We are actively fundraising. Only equity-based compensation is currently available; no cash salary is available today. The equity grant and its terms have not been set for this role and must be agreed before joining. Any future salary, incentive plan, benefits, hiring budget, or paid start date depends on financing and written agreement. Funding and its timing are not guaranteed.

Before deciding to join, discuss the grant structure, fully diluted ownership basis, vesting, dilution, applicable exercise terms, company funding position, and working arrangement. A company valuation is not the cash value of an equity grant.

How we work

Remote · United States. The planned role is full time; timing is to be agreed.
