At Fusion Connect, we’re not just offering jobs — we’re building careers that empower, inspire, and grow with you.

If you're passionate about making an impact, collaborating with forward-thinking teams, and being part of a company that values your voice, you’re in the right place.

We’re thrilled you’re exploring this opportunity with us — take a look, imagine the possibilities, and let’s shape the future of connectivity together.

Job Description Summary:

The Business Development Representative will be responsible for driving lead generation, appointment setting, lead qualification, and event recruitment support to the Sales team. This position requires heavy outbound phone calling, lead qualification, consultative selling skills, and collaboration with the Marketing and Sales teams.

The Business Development Representative will be expected to build a pipeline, report on qualification and call activity, and stay informed on Fusion Connect products, services, and the telecommunications competitive landscape. This position will also support and follow up on regional and national events and campaigns.

Job Description:

Essential Duties and Responsibilities include the following: (Other duties may be assigned.)

  • Generate new business opportunities to drive pipeline growth.

  • Outbound prospecting Mid to Enterprise companies via cold calling, email, and other marketing campaigns

  • Work closely with Sales Operations, Marketing, and Enterprise Account Executives to develop call strategies, and messaging to drive opportunities for new business.

  • Research and build new accounts (i.e. identify and qualify contacts, sending regular emails, appointment setting, developing initial interest)

  • Conduct high-level conversations with Senior Executives in Target Accounts

  • Achieve or exceed monthly quotas of Qualified Opportunities/Sales meetings.

  • Manage, track, and report on all sales activities and results using Salesforce.com.

  • Uncover prospect’s business challenges and identify relevant new business opportunities.

  • Learn and maintain in-depth knowledge of Fusion products, industry trends, and competition.

  • Successfully manage and overcome prospect objections.

  • Provide closed-loop feedback to ensure continuous process optimization.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Requirements:

  • Knowledge of the high tech, telecommunications industry and/or an ability to learn rapidly.

  • Excellent written skills and highly articulate

  • Cold calling and active listening skills; ability to navigate complex organizations to identify key contact(s).

  • Ability to follow a prescribed contact strategy, multi-task, prioritize, and manage time effectively.

  • Proficient in using Salesforce.com, LinkedIn, and/or related platforms.

  • Highly motivated, driven, and self-starting individual

  • Experience in call structure and control

  • In-depth appreciation for the Sales process but also creativity in driving new contacts/ opportunities.

Education and/or Experience Preferred:

  • Bachelor’s Degree preferred

  • 2-5 years of experience in Sales Development, Lead Generation, Sales, and/or Marketing preferred (SaaS experience a plus, but not required)

  • Proven track record of exceeding high-volume sales targets and experience succeeding in a goal-driven environment preferred.

Experience (Minimum Required):

Physical Demands / Work Environment:

jobs.title: YouTube Content Strategist | Growth & Long-Form Content
jobs.excerpt: YouTube Content Strategist | Long-Form & GrowthSobre la oportunidadBuscamos un YouTube Content Strategist con experiencia comprobable en el crecimiento de canales de YouTube mediante estrategias de contenido long-form.
jobs.description:
YouTube Content Strategist | Long-Form & Growth

Sobre la oportunidad

Buscamos un YouTube Content Strategist con experiencia comprobable en el crecimiento de canales de YouTube mediante estrategias de contenido long-form. Este rol será responsable de diseñar la estrategia editorial del canal, desarrollar contenido de alto impacto y optimizar continuamente el rendimiento a través del análisis de métricas.

No buscamos únicamente a un guionista o channel manager. Queremos a una persona con visión estratégica, pensamiento analítico y criterio creativo, capaz de convertir ideas en contenido que genere crecimiento orgánico y resultados de negocio.

Responsabilidades

  • Diseñar la estrategia de contenido del canal de YouTube.

  • Investigar tendencias, audiencias y oportunidades de contenido.

  • Desarrollar guiones para videos long-form, podcasts y entrevistas.

  • Crear títulos, thumbnails y estrategias de packaging orientadas a mejorar el CTR.

  • Analizar métricas como CTR, retención, watch time y rendimiento del canal para proponer mejoras continuas.

  • Colaborar con editores y diseñadores brindando feedback estratégico sobre narrativa y edición.

  • Liderar la planificación editorial y contribuir al crecimiento sostenido del canal.

Requisitos

  • Experiencia comprobable en estrategia o crecimiento de canales de YouTube.

  • Dominio de storytelling, guionización y contenido long-form.

  • Conocimiento sólido de YouTube Analytics, CTR, retención y watch time.

  • Experiencia desarrollando títulos, miniaturas y estrategias de packaging.

  • Manejo de herramientas como YouTube Studio, vidIQ, TubeBuddy, Google Trends y herramientas de IA (ChatGPT, Claude o Perplexity).

  • Inglés avanzado (C1–C2).

  • Excelente redacción en español y capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma.

Perfil ideal

Buscamos una persona apasionada por YouTube, con alto nivel de ownership, pensamiento estratégico y enfoque en resultados. Alguien capaz de identificar oportunidades de crecimiento, construir formatos escalables y tomar decisiones basadas en datos para maximizar el impacto del contenido.

Para postularte

Será indispensable compartir:

  • Portafolio o enlaces a canales de YouTube en los que hayas participado.

  • Casos donde puedas explicar tu contribución al crecimiento del canal.

  • Ejemplos de videos o guiones desarrollados por ti y, de ser posible, métricas de desempeño obtenidas.

Please note: Company Policy states that all interviews be conducted either in person or Microsoft Teams VIDEO interview with no AI generated backgrounds or blurred backgrounds.

Harbor IT | Remote with Travel | Reports to CRO

Harbor IT is building a dedicated Life Sciences practice and is looking for a Practice Lead who can help us earn trust, open doors, and create revenue in the biotech and life sciences market.

This is a commercial role. The person in this seat will be expected to use their network to create meetings, shape the go-to-market motion, and perform against a quota for net new ARR.

What You'll Do

  • Activate your network to create meetings and warm introductions across the biotech and life sciences ecosystem
  • Carry and perform against a quota for net new ARR within the Life Sciences vertical
  • Help Harbor get in front of the right companies, especially biotech organizations with lab operations and growing security, compliance, and infrastructure needs
  • Translate what you are hearing in the market into a sharper vertical strategy and clearer messaging
  • Help position Harbor around the problems these companies actually have as they scale
  • Represent Harbor at the right events, peer groups, founder communities, and ecosystem gatherings

Who You Are

  • Deeply connected in biotech and life sciences companies from early stage to pre-commercial
  • Strongest in companies with real lab environments and meaningful operational maturity
  • Respected enough that people take your call and ask for your advice
  • Understand how technology, security, compliance, and lab operations become more important as biotech companies scale
  • Commercial enough to turn trust and relationships into meetings, pipeline, and net new ARR

Why Harbor

Harbor IT is a managed services and cybersecurity provider focused on helping growing companies operate in secure, reliable, well-run technology environments.

In Life Sciences, we believe there is a real opportunity to help companies that are outgrowing scrappy early-stage infrastructure but are not yet being served well by large, generic providers.

● Exceptional analytical and problem-solving abilities.

● Excellent attention to detail and communication skills.

● Strong understanding of trade lifecycles and settlement processes.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

jobs.description:
As a Sales Executive, you play a crucial role in Payter’s growth by generating new business opportunities across the UK or the Netherlands. In this high-energy role, you are the point of contact for outbound prospecting and building relationships to uncover where our technology adds value. While previous experience is beneficial, it’s not required, what matters most is your motivation, curiosity, and a strong drive to succeed. Working within our close-knit team, you will take ownership of your territory and ensure your impact is visible across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • You identify and uncover new business opportunities across our targeted verticals, acting as a strategic scout for Payter’s growth.

  • You take ownership of outbound outreach—via email, phone, and social—to build and safeguard a strong, high-quality pipeline.

  • You dive deep into Payter’s payment solutions, developing the intellectual curiosity needed to translate our technology into compelling value propositions.

  • You conduct discovery calls to investigate prospective customers' challenges and uncover the "true meaning" of how our solutions can help them.

  • You collaborate closely with Sales Managers to progress deals, ensuring a seamless transition and a unified approach to closing new business.

  • You maintain accurate records within our CRM, making your progress and impact visible to the entire organization.

  • You support and amplify marketing campaigns with targeted outbound activity, bridging the gap between our brand message and the market.

  • You represent Payter with professionalism, enthusiasm, and integrity, acting as a guardian of our reputation in every interaction.

About Payter

At Payter, we are the pioneers and global leaders in the rapidly evolving world of unattended and cashless payment technology. Since 2007, we have been driving impact by redefining how vendors connect with their customers. Position Description:

Would you like to have a career with a collaborative, diverse, and dynamic mining company? We have an exciting opportunity for you!

Our vision is to be the world’s most valued gold mining business by finding, developing, and operating the best assets with the best people. Our Exploration division is growing, and we are looking for a Remote Sensing Lead to join our team! The Remote Sensing Lead is responsible for designing, implementing, and advancing the use of satellite, airborne, and handheld hyperspectral data with geospatial information to support the discovery and evaluation of gold and copper deposits. This role provides technical leadership in acquisition, processing, interpretation, and integration of remote sensing datasets to identify prospective targets, reduce exploration risk, and enhance decision-making across exploration programs. Working closely with geology, geochemistry, geophysics, and field teams, the Remote Sensing Lead ensures that remote sensing insights are translated into actionable exploration decisions and strategies that accelerate target generation, optimize field campaigns, and support sustainable, cost-effective mineral exploration.

At Barrick, our vision is to be the world’s most valued gold mining business by finding, developing, and operating the best assets with the best people. We are committed to a safe work environment sending every person home safe and healthy every day and leaving a sustainable legacy on our host communities.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the strategy, selection, and application of remote sensing/hyperspectral technologies to support gold and copper exploration programs across the North American Region with a focus on gold and copper opportunities.

As Principal Data Engineer, you will serve as Ensemble’s senior technical authority on data architecture — a high‑level individual contributor, not a people manager. You will assess data engineering practices across the organization, architect solutions that scale across teams, and establish a strong foundation for AI‑driven capabilities across the organization.

You will architect and design a cloud‑native data platform built on Azure and Databricks, enabling trusted, governed, and reusable data products that accelerate insight generation, operational automation, and emerging AI use cases. You will also own the organization’s data engineering technology roadmap, staying ahead of emerging tools and techniques and recommending what we should evaluate or adopt next.

Job Competencies:

Technical Decision Making - Makes sound architectural and technical decisions by gathering and weighing information from multiple sources, evaluating trade-offs against reliability, cost, and scalability; clearly communicates decisions and rationale to technical and non-technical stakeholders; drives results through the strength of the recommendation, not positional authority.

Technical Mentorship - Elevates the capability of senior and staff engineers by sharing architectural thinking, providing design-review feedback, and modeling sound engineering judgment; develops others through example and coaching rather than formal supervision, without holding management responsibility for their performance or career progression.

Influencing Without Authority - Drives adoption of architectural standards and technical direction across teams through credibility, clear reasoning, and relationship-building rather than reporting lines; earns buy-in from engineering, product, and leadership stakeholders who do not report to this role.

Cross-Functional Collaboration - Builds productive working relationships across data engineering, analytics, data science, product, and platform teams to align architectural decisions with business goals, without formal authority over those teams.

Technical & Executive Communication - Clearly and succinctly conveys complex architectural and technical concepts to both engineering peers and executive stakeholders; communicates in a focused and compelling way that captures and holds others’ attention (appropriate, impactful, and clear).

Technical Program Ownership - Demonstrates high accountability for architectural initiatives and proofs of concept from inception through adoption; considers cost and resourcing impact to ensure maximized output, reduced waste, and exceptional results.

Innovation & Continuous Learning - Stays ahead of the industry by continuously evaluating emerging tools, frameworks, and techniques for genuine fit within the organization; runs proofs of concept to validate new approaches before recommending broader adoption, rather than chasing trends for their own sake.

Job Functions:

Customer Obsession: Consistently provide exceptional experiences for our clients, patients, and colleagues by understanding their needs and exceeding their expectations.

Embracing New Ideas: Continuously innovate by embracing emerging technology and fostering a culture of creativity and experimentation.

Striving for Excellence: Execute at a high level by demonstrating our “Best in KLAS” Ensemble Difference Principles and consistently delivering outstanding results.

Technical Assessment & Architecture

  • Architect scalable, secure, and cost-efficient data solutions that span multiple teams and business domains, built on Databricks and Azure.
  • Act as a technical escalation point for the organization’s hardest data engineering problems, diagnosing recurring or systemic reliability issues in tier-1 pipelines and datasets.
  • Define and evolve data engineering standards, patterns, and architectural guardrails used across engineering teams, balancing standardization with the flexibility teams need to move quickly.

AI & Advanced Analytics Enablement

  • Establish and evolve a data platform architecture that enables AI, machine learning, and advanced analytics workloads, including feature readiness, training data quality, lineage, and observability.
  • Partner with Data Science, Analytics, Product, and Cloud teams to ensure data platforms support model development, deployment, and monitoring without creating operational or governance risk.
  • Define and enforce AI-ready data standards, including data quality thresholds, metadata completeness, schema stability, and data timeliness required to support advanced analytics and AI workloads.

Technology Roadmap & Innovation

  • Stay ahead of the industry by continuously evaluating emerging tools, frameworks, and techniques in the data and AI space for genuine fit within Ensemble’s environment, rather than chasing trends for their own sake.
  • Run proofs of concept and technical spikes to validate new approaches before recommending broader adoption.
  • Author and maintain a data engineering technology roadmap aligned to business priorities, with clear reasoning on trade-offs, cost, and adoption sequencing.
  • Present roadmap recommendations and their business impact to both technical and executive stakeholders, translating deep technical trade-offs into clear strategic choices.

Platform Standards, Governance & Cost Optimization

  • Treat enterprise datasets as data products, with clear ownership, quality guarantees, documentation, and usage metrics.
  • Establish platform standards and architectural guardrails to optimize compute efficiency, storage utilization, query performance, and pipeline reliability.
  • Partner with Finance, Cloud, and Engineering leaders to implement cost transparency (FinOps) across Databricks and Azure, including budgets, usage monitoring, and proactive optimization.
  • Drive platform decisions using clear metrics such as cost-to-serve, workload efficiency, platform SLAs, and utilization trends.
  • Ensure platform-level observability, including workload performance, cost drivers, usage patterns, and capacity forecasting.

Cross-Functional Influence & Mentorship

  • Mentor senior and staff engineers on architecture and design thinking, elevating their capability without holding formal management responsibility for their performance.
  • Influence technical direction across teams through credibility, clear communication, and sound technical judgment rather than positional authority.
  • Partner with data engineering, analytics, data science, and platform/infrastructure teams to ensure architectural decisions stay aligned with business goals.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

  • 10+ years of relevant job experience
  • Deep experience designing and reviewing SQL‑based data models and transformations at enterprise scale.
  • 3+ years working with big data technologies including but not limited to Databricks, SPARK, Azure, with a willingness and ability to learn new ones
  • Excellent understanding of engineering fundamentals: testing automation, code reviews, telemetry, iterative delivery and DevOps
  • Experience with polyglot storage architectures including relational, columnar, key-value, graph or equivalent
  • Demonstrated ability to communicate effectively to both technical and non-technical, globally distributed audiences
  • Solid foundations in formal architecture, design patterns and best practices
  • Experience designing data platforms that support AI/ML, advanced analytics, or intelligent automation workloads.
  • Deep experience with Azure cloud services and Databricks, including Spark‑based data engineering patterns.
  • Proven ability to translate business needs into scalable data solutions.
  • Experience owning or operating large‑scale cloud data platforms, including responsibility for cost optimization, performance tuning, and platform reliability.
  • Demonstrated ability to scale data engineering through enablement, standards, and platforms, not just direct delivery.
  • Strong understanding of Databricks pricing models, workload optimization, and Azure cloud cost drivers preferred.
  • Demonstrated experience assessing data engineering practices across multiple teams or business units and translating findings into a concrete architectural or technology roadmap.
  • Track record of evaluating emerging tools and technologies for real fit within an organization, and driving adoption decisions through credibility and clear communication rather than formal authority.

jobs.description:
IT-Spezialist / Softwareentwickler (m/w/d)

Teil- oder Vollzeit · 30 bis 40 Stunden pro Woche · Remote / Homeoffice

Du möchtest nicht einfach nur bestehende Systeme verwalten, sondern aktiv an neuen digitalen Lösungen arbeiten?

Du begeisterst Dich für Softwareentwicklung, Automatisierungen und künstliche Intelligenz und möchtest Deine Ideen in einem wachsenden Unternehmen direkt in die Praxis umsetzen?

Dann werde Teil unseres IT-Teams.

Bei Tunymedia übernimmst Du eine zentrale Rolle bei der Weiterentwicklung unserer internen Software, digitalen Prozesse und technischen Infrastruktur. Du entwickelst Automatisierungen, begleitest IT-Projekte und arbeitest gemeinsam mit uns daran, neue KI-Lösungen und digitale Produkte aufzubauen. Dabei bist Du nicht nur Ansprechpartner für technische Fragen, sondern vor allem Mitgestalter unserer zukünftigen Systeme und Prozesse.

Das erwartet Dich bei uns:

➡️ Du entwickelst unsere Software aktiv weiter:
Du arbeitest an bestehenden Anwendungen und entwickelst gemeinsam mit uns neue Funktionen, Systeme und digitale Lösungen.

➡️ Du automatisierst Prozesse:
Du erkennst wiederkehrende und ineffiziente Abläufe und entwickelst technische Lösungen, mit denen wir Prozesse schneller, einfacher und skalierbarer gestalten.

➡️ Du arbeitest an innovativen KI-Projekten:
Du beschäftigst Dich mit aktuellen KI-Technologien und prüfst, wie wir künstliche Intelligenz sinnvoll in unsere Software, Prozesse und Dienstleistungen integrieren können.

➡️ Du übernimmst Verantwortung für IT-Projekte:
Du planst und koordinierst technische Projekte, behältst Aufgaben und Abhängigkeiten im Blick und sorgst dafür, dass Lösungen zuverlässig umgesetzt werden.

➡️ Du bist technischer Sparringspartner für unser Team:
Bei internen IT-Fragen unterstützt Du Deine Kolleginnen und Kollegen lösungsorientiert und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Systeme im Arbeitsalltag zuverlässig funktionieren.

➡️ Du arbeitest eigenverantwortlich und mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen:
Bei uns musst Du nicht auf lange Freigabeprozesse warten. Gute Ideen können schnell besprochen, getestet und umgesetzt werden.

Deine Aufgaben:

  • Entwicklung und Weiterentwicklung interner Softwarelösungen

  • Entwicklung und Wartung von Software-Automatisierungen

  • Analyse und Optimierung bestehender digitaler Prozesse

  • Konzeption und Umsetzung neuer KI-Projekte

  • Planung, Koordination und Management von IT-Projekten

  • Wartung und Support bestehender Softwareprojekte

  • Technische Unterstützung bei internen IT-Fragen

  • Bewertung und Einführung neuer Tools, Technologien und Systeme

  • Dokumentation von Anwendungen, Prozessen und technischen Lösungen

  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit der Geschäftsführung und den verschiedenen Fachbereichen

Freue dich auf:

Klarer Einschulungsprozess: Du erhältst einen strukturierten und effizienten Einschulungsplan sowie eine persönliche Begleitung. So lernst Du unsere Systeme, Prozesse und Anforderungen schnell kennen und kannst früh Verantwortung übernehmen.

Klare Arbeitsabläufe: Durch verständliche Anleitungen, Dokumentationen und definierte Prozesse weißt Du, woran Du arbeitest und welche Ziele erreicht werden sollen. Gleichzeitig hast Du den Freiraum, bestehende Abläufe zu hinterfragen und technisch zu verbessern.

Echte Gestaltungsmöglichkeiten: Deine Arbeit hat direkten Einfluss auf die Entwicklung unseres Unternehmens. Du kannst eigene Ideen einbringen, technische Entscheidungen mitgestalten und Lösungen entwickeln, die von unserem gesamten Team genutzt werden.

Eigenverantwortliches Arbeiten: Du erhältst eigene Verantwortungsbereiche und die Möglichkeit, Projekte selbstständig voranzutreiben. Dabei arbeitest Du eng mit den relevanten Ansprechpartnern im Unternehmen zusammen.

Kurze Entscheidungswege: Wir arbeiten pragmatisch und lösungsorientiert. Entscheidungen können schnell getroffen und neue Ideen zeitnah getestet werden.

Langfristige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Mit dem Wachstum unseres Unternehmens entwickeln sich auch Deine Aufgaben und Verantwortungsbereiche weiter. Du hast die Möglichkeit, Dich fachlich und persönlich weiterzuentwickeln und langfristig eine zentrale Rolle in unserem IT-Bereich einzunehmen.

Sicherer Arbeitsplatz: Die Nachfrage nach digitalen Lösungen, Automatisierungen und KI-Anwendungen wächst kontinuierlich. Als etablierte Digitalisierungsagentur bieten wir Dir einen langfristigen Arbeitsplatz in einem zukunftsorientierten Umfeld.

Zusammenhalt und Teamevents: Ein offener, ehrlicher und loyaler Umgang ist uns wichtig. Bei regelmäßigen Teamevents, beispielsweise Bowlingabenden oder unserer Weihnachtsfeier, verbringen wir auch außerhalb des Arbeitsalltags gemeinsam Zeit.

Umfangreiches Gesundheitsprogramm: Dazu gehören unter anderem Bikeleasing, ergonomische Arbeitsplätze (z.B. mit höhenverstellbaren Schreibtischen) im Office und regelmäßige Gesundheitsangebote.

Faire Vergütung: Wir wissen dich, deine Erfahrung und deinen Einsatz zu schätzen. Deine Erfahrung, sowie deine Leistung, fließen direkt in deine Vergütung mit ein.

Über uns

Die Tunymedia GmbH zählt mit über 350 Kunden zu den bekanntesten Digitalisierungsagenturen für die Handwerks- und Möbelbranche im gesamten D-A-CH-Raum.

Mit einem Team von über 25 Mitarbeiterinnen und Mitarbeitern unterstützen wir kleine, mittelständische und große Unternehmen dabei, durch Digitalisierung neue Fachkräfte zu gewinnen, mehr Kundenanfragen zu generieren und ihre internen Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten. Zu unseren Kunden zählen zahlreiche Klein- und Mittelbetriebe sowie bekannte Unternehmen wie Schaffrath, Flamme Möbel, WEKO, DAN Küchen, HELLA Sonnenschutz und McDonald’s.

Wir entwickeln uns kontinuierlich weiter und investieren verstärkt in eigene Softwarelösungen, Automatisierungen und künstliche Intelligenz. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die nicht nur bestehende Systeme bedienen, sondern gemeinsam mit uns neue Lösungen entwickeln möchten.

Du möchtest Software nicht nur nutzen, sondern gemeinsam mit uns entwickeln?

Dann bewirb Dich jetzt und gestalte mit uns die digitale Zukunft von Tunymedia.

Requirements

Dein Profil:

  • Abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung, beispielsweise ein Studium im Bereich Informatik, eine HTL, eine Lehre oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

  • Praktische Kenntnisse in der Softwareentwicklung

  • Großes Interesse an Automatisierungen, künstlicher Intelligenz und neuen Technologien

  • Fähigkeit, technische Anforderungen zu verstehen und in funktionierende Lösungen zu übersetzen

  • Strukturierte, lösungsorientierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise

  • Bereitschaft, Dich schnell in neue Systeme, Technologien und Themen einzuarbeiten

  • Freude daran, eigene Ideen einzubringen und Verantwortung für deren Umsetzung zu übernehmen

  • Gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit und die Bereitschaft, technische Themen auch für Nicht-Techniker verständlich zu erklären

Berufserfahrung ist von Vorteil. Entscheidend ist für uns jedoch vor allem, dass Du bereits praktische Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mitbringst, technisch schnell verstehst und Dich kontinuierlich weiterentwickeln möchtest.

Deine Bewerbung:

Du kannst Dich direkt über unsere Karriereseite in weniger als zwei Minuten bewerben.

Ein klassisches Anschreiben ist nicht notwendig. Wir möchten vor allem erfahren, welche Erfahrungen Du in der Softwareentwicklung mitbringst, an welchen Projekten Du bereits gearbeitet hast und welche technischen Themen Dich besonders interessieren.

Aus Effizienzgründen nehmen wir ausschließlich Onlinebewerbungen über unsere Karriereseite entgegen. Bewerbungen per Post, E-Mail oder Telefon können nicht berücksichtigt werden.

Wenn du lieber vor Ort arbeiten möchtest, ist dies ebenfalls möglich.

Requisition Number: 105241

Solution Principal Sr

Location:

You will have the flexibility to work fully remote.

Insight at a Glance

  • 14,000+ engaged teammates globally
  • $8.2 billion in revenue in 2025
  • Certified as a Great Place to work in 9 Countries in 2025
  • Fortune 500 Company (No. 447) in 2025
  • Received 25+ industry and partner awards in the past year
  • $1.4M+ total charitable contributions in 2024 by Insight globally

Now is the time to expand your knowledge and drive business solutions with Insight. We are not just a tech company; we are a people-first company. We believe that by unlocking the power of people and technology, we can accelerate transformation and achieve extraordinary results. As a Fortune 500 Solutions Integrator with deep expertise in Digital Enablement, Cloud, Data, AI, Innovative Apps, Cybersecurity, and Intelligent Edge, we guide organizations through their complex digital journey.

About the role

As a Sr. Solution Principal – Microsoft AI & Innovation, you will be a key presales leader responsible for shaping and selling AI-led professional services across the Microsoft ecosystem. You will consult with clients, assess their AI readiness and Microsoft estate, define pragmatic AI adoption roadmaps, and translate them into clearly scoped professional services Statements of Work (SOWs). Your remit spans the full Microsoft surface area — Modern Work (Microsoft 365, Copilot, Teams), Capability (Azure platform, infrastructure, and security foundations), Application Development (Azure AI, Copilot Studio, custom agents), and Data & AI (Microsoft Fabric, Azure AI Foundry) — with a heavy focus on Microsoft Agent 365 and enterprise AI strategy.

As agentic AI moves from experimentation to enterprise-scale operation, clients need a trusted advisor who can connect AI ambition to a governed, secure, and value-driven adoption path. You will be that advisor — shaping how organizations deploy, govern, and scale AI agents responsibly on Microsoft.

You will need a balance of:

  • Strategic presales acumen across the Microsoft AI portfolio
  • Deep understanding of AI adoption, Agent 365 governance, and the Microsoft Cloud
  • Business consulting and AI strategy skills
  • Strong SOW and deal-structuring experience

You will partner closely with account teams, solution architects, and delivery leaders to design AI-driven solutions that achieve measurable client outcomes.

In this role, you will:

Client consulting & discovery

  • Align into top accounts to build relationships with senior IT and business stakeholders (CIO, CDO, CTO, CISO, Head of Modern Work, and Line-of-Business leaders).
  • Lead AI discovery and readiness workshops to understand current-state Microsoft estate, workplace productivity patterns, data landscape, governance maturity, and agent adoption readiness.
  • Assess the client’s Microsoft footprint — Microsoft 365 and Copilot adoption, Azure platform maturity, identity and security posture (Entra, Purview, Defender), and data estate (Fabric, Azure data services) — to identify pain points and AI opportunities.
  • Translate business objectives into prioritized AI use cases and adoption roadmaps spanning Copilot rollout, custom agent development, Agent 365 governance, and modern data foundations.

AI strategy & solution architecture

  • Define future-state Microsoft AI architectures that span Modern Work, Capability, Application Development, and Data & AI — anchored on Copilot, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Fabric, and Microsoft Agent 365.
  • Shape enterprise AI strategy: help clients move from ad hoc agent experimentation to a governed operating model, defining how agents are identified, owned, secured, and scaled.
  • Position Microsoft Agent 365 as the control plane for AI agents — covering agent identity (Microsoft Entra Agent ID), observability, governance, security, and lifecycle management across first-party, custom, and third-party agents.
  • Recommend responsible-AI and Zero Trust patterns that align agent access with least-privilege, Conditional Access, data protection (Purview), and threat protection (Defender).
  • Craft outcome-focused solution narratives that connect AI investments to business value (productivity gains, faster time-to-insight, reduced manual effort, trusted and governed automation).
  • Collaborate with technical SMEs (AI engineers, data engineers, app developers, cloud and security architects) to validate feasibility, sizing, and delivery approach.

SOW creation & deal structuring

  • Lead the creation of professional services proposals and SOWs across the Microsoft AI portfolio (AI readiness assessments, Copilot adoption, agent development, Agent 365 governance enablement, data modernization, and app modernization for AI).
  • Define scope, deliverables, assumptions, and client responsibilities with enough detail to enable predictable delivery.
  • Design deal structures that meet internal margin targets, align with preferred delivery models (fixed-fee, T&M, multi-phase roadmaps), and match client expectations and risk tolerance.
  • Work with resource management and delivery leaders to develop realistic staffing and ramp plans based on skills, availability, and project timelines.
  • Ensure SOWs adhere to Insight’s standards, legal/commercial guidelines, and risk controls.

Sales collaboration & pipeline support

  • Engage with sellers to refine understanding of client needs during qualification and shape win strategies for Microsoft AI opportunities.
  • Support account teams in early-stage opportunity shaping, including ideation of AI engagements (assessments, PoCs, Copilot pilots, agent programs, multi-phase transformations).
  • Represent client needs across all Insight capabilities, with a focus on expanding AI deal size and attaching services to Microsoft platform and licensing investments.
  • Support sellers in executive presentations, proposal walkthroughs, and orals — clearly articulating our Microsoft AI value proposition and differentiation.
  • Participate in internal deal reviews with Insight leadership, presenting solution approach, delivery risks, and financials.

Partner engagement & offerings

  • Develop strong working relationships with Microsoft field and product teams and incorporate the latest Microsoft AI capabilities (Copilot, Agent 365, Azure AI Foundry, Fabric) into client solutions.
  • Leverage Microsoft partner incentives and funding (PoCs, pilots, workshops, assessments, FastTrack) to accelerate AI opportunities.
  • Provide feedback into Insight’s Microsoft AI offerings and accelerators based on client demand and field experience.

Governance, quality & reporting

  • Own solutions for assigned opportunities end-to-end, ensuring consistency between presales design and delivery handoff.
  • Actively track Microsoft AI opportunities being worked, providing leadership with regular reporting on pipeline, revenue, and gross profit.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of presales artifacts (templates, reference architectures, SOW standards, estimators).

What we’re looking for

Experience

  • Minimum of 10 years in technology roles such as Solution Architect, AI/Cloud Architect, Modern Work Architect, App Development Lead, or Data & AI Architect, including client-facing responsibilities.
  • Demonstrated presales or sales engineering experience for professional services, including discovery, solution shaping, and SOW creation.
  • Proven track record designing and/or delivering solutions on the Microsoft Cloud — Microsoft 365 and Copilot, Azure, Azure AI, Microsoft Fabric, and identity/security (Entra, Purview, Defender).
  • Hands-on familiarity with agentic AI and the emerging Microsoft agent stack — Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, and Microsoft Agent 365 / Microsoft Entra Agent ID.
  • Experience positioning AI responsibly, including governance, security, and compliance considerations for enterprise AI adoption.

Core skills

Strong understanding of the Microsoft AI landscape across four pillars:

  • Modern Work — Microsoft 365, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Teams, adoption and change management.
  • Capability — Azure platform, infrastructure, identity, and Zero Trust security foundations.
  • Application Development — Azure AI Foundry, Copilot Studio, custom and autonomous agent development, MCP-connected services.
  • Data & AI — Microsoft Fabric, Azure data services, and the data foundations required to enable trusted AI and agents.

Depth in enterprise AI governance and Agent 365, including:

  • Agent identity and lifecycle (Microsoft Entra Agent ID: identity, ownership/sponsorship, least-privilege, Conditional Access).
  • Agent observability, discovery/registry, and centralized policy-driven governance.
  • Security and compliance for agents via Microsoft Defender and Microsoft Purview.
  • Ability to assess a client’s AI maturity and propose pragmatic, phased roadmaps (assess → foundation → use-case enablement → govern & scale).
  • Strong understanding of clients’ IT and business decision-making process, especially for AI, productivity, and platform investments.
  • Demonstrated ability to solution across multiple business units and offerings, integrating Modern Work, Cloud, Data, AI, Apps, and Managed Services where appropriate.
  • Financial acumen: understanding of pricing, deal economics, business case development, and ROI in the context of AI programs.

Excellent communication skills:

  • Ability to present complex AI concepts in business-friendly language to executives.
  • Ability to go deep technically with architects, engineers, and data scientists.
  • Strong written skills for proposal and SOW development.

Desirable

  • Experience with consultative frameworks for AI (AI strategy assessments, operating-model design, AI readiness and responsible-AI assessments).
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Semantic Kernel, MCP, and the broader agent developer ecosystem.
  • Relevant Microsoft certifications (e.g., Azure AI Engineer, Azure Solutions Architect, Microsoft 365 / Copilot).
  • Industry-specific experience (e.g., financial services, healthcare, manufacturing, retail) is a plus.

Soft skills

  • Executive presence with the ability to earn trust quickly in C-level conversations.
  • Strong facilitation skills for workshops and multi-stakeholder sessions.
  • Root cause analysis, structured problem solving, and the ability to simplify complexity.
  • Collaborative working style with sales, delivery, and partner teams.
  • Comfort with ambiguity and the ability to structure opportunities and deals from early concept to well-defined scope.

What you can expect

We’re legendary for taking care of you, your family, and helping you engage with your local community. We want you to enjoy a full, meaningful life and own your career at Insight. Some of our benefits include:

  • Full medical, dental, and vision benefits
  • Bonus incentives
  • Company 401(k) match
  • Freedom to work from another location—even an international destination—for up to 30 consecutive calendar days per year

But what really sets us apart are our core values of Hunger, Heart, and Harmony, which guide everything we do, from building relationships with teammates, partners, and clients to making a positive impact in our communities. Join us today—your ambITious journey starts here.

Responsibilities:

Plays a key role in ensuring that projects and initiatives reach their full potential by ensuring all impacted business, financial, operational and other stakeholders are prepared for and embrace change. Focuses on the people side of change, including not only the change initiative itself, but also changes to business processes, systems and technology, job roles and organization structures. Designs, develops and executes change management strategies and plans that minimize resistance and maximize engagement to ensure that users are engaged, prepared to transition to the initiative and reinforce sustainable change. Works with and coaches project stakeholders, leaders and teams to develop strategies to maximize buy-in and minimize resistance and are able to leverage the change management framework and standards. Ensures that all documentation coming out of the program is in line with the ultimate change management strategy and plan.

ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS

  • Plays a key role in business process workshops to understand the current and future state business processes. Assesses the change impacts on the organization and roles and leads or partners with a Communications lead to ensure targeted messaging accurately describes the change to appropriate audiences. Partners with training experts to develop a training program that ensures end users are engaged, knowledgeable, and able to adopt change during the implementation phase. Leads the effort to identify measurement methodologies to track adoption, utilization, and proficiency of individual changes, and adjusts change management strategies and tactics as necessary. Issues regular reports to project leadership, escalating risks that may lead to an unsuccessful launch of projects and puts forward a plan to mitigate.
  • Develops and executes against a comprehensive, actionable, and targeted change management plan surrounding change to people, processes, workflows, and systems. Applies a structured approach and methodology for the five change management domains related to the people-side of change, including stakeholder analysis, coaching plans, communications, training, and resistance management plans. Develops and conducts readiness assessments, analyzes results, and presents findings in a logical and easy-to-understand manner to sponsors and stakeholders.
  • Collaborates with Project Manager to integrate change management plans/activities into overall project plan. Works as a member of project leadership team, ensuring change management strategy is at the forefront of project activities and impact to the stakeholders is continually evaluated and acted upon to minimize stakeholder resistance. Ensures assigned projects meets business, schedule, and budget objectives for change management activities.
  • Provides subject matter expertise and guidance on the management of changes by advising/coaching stakeholders, leaders, and managers on the execution of established change management activities, including communications, change sponsorship, education and training, and ongoing support. Leads or coaches the team to identify potential people-side risks, analyze KPIs and anticipated points of resistance, and recommends and/or develops mitigation plans with Project Manager and Executive Sponsor to address the concerns commensurate with the project scope/engagement level. Builds and leads a sponsorship coalition, including the executive sponsor, leaders/managers, designated project champions, and stakeholders who will be key champions of change, reinforcing awareness within the organization. Partners with the executive sponsor throughout the change process to actively and visibly participate, establish an organizational understanding, and sense of urgency to prioritize the change.
  • Provides organizational change consultations and/or training to project teams/sponsors for assigned engagements. Develops and/or coaches team on conducting assessments, analyzes results, and presents findings in a logical and easy-to-understand manner to sponsors and stakeholders. Provides strategy/activity recommendations for project team execution with respect to Communications and Training.

Develops and maintains a broad knowledge of related industry standards, best practices, regulations, and related technologies. jobs.excerpt: About Citylogix Citylogix is redefining how cities manage infrastructure.
jobs.description:
About Citylogix

Citylogix is redefining how cities manage infrastructure.

We are an AI-driven platform built for public works teams who need to do more with less. Backed by CRH Ventures, the investment arm of the world’s largest road builder, we already serve 450+ municipalities across the U.S. and Canada... and we’re just getting started. Most asset management systems store data. Citylogix turns it into decisions.

Our platform continuously monitors, analyzes, and prioritizes infrastructure across the entire right-of-way... roads, sidewalks, ADA ramps, signs, pavement markings, and more. Instead of outdated snapshots, cities get a living, real-time understanding of their network and what to fix next. That starts with how data is collected.

Our LiDAR scanning captures high-resolution condition data across entire road networks. With Patrol, our AI-powered mobile app, cities extend that coverage daily... passively collecting intelligence from vehicles already on the road. The result is a system that gets smarter over time, not obsolete the moment it’s delivered. That intelligence doesn’t sit in a dashboard.

It flows directly into capital planning and work order execution... connecting AI-detected issues to budget justification to field crews doing the work. No spreadsheets. No silos. One platform, end-to-end.

No one else owns this full workflow.

We do.

Why this matters for you

We’re not selling another piece of software... we’re helping cities shift from reactive spending to proactive infrastructure management. That’s a massive, underserved market with long-term contracts, real budgets, and clear ROI.

You’ll be selling:

  • A product that solves a visible, everyday problem (every city has bad roads)
  • Into a defined buyer (public works, engineering, DOT)
  • With real differentiation (not just another scanner or dashboard)

And you’ll be doing it at a company that is early enough to matter... but established enough to win!

About the role

Illinois has over 1,200 municipalities and thousands of miles of aging infrastructure. Most are under-resourced, over-budgeted, and in need of smarter asset management solutions. This is a greenfield territory with significant upside and you will be the face of Citylogix in the Prairie State.

But this role is not just about new logos. Citylogix’s strategic direction is full Enterprise Asset Management, so expanding accounts from pavement-only into sidewalks, ADA, signs, ROW assets, and multi-year platform agreements. The right candidate is as comfortable growing an existing account as closing a new one, and understands how to navigate a multi-stakeholder deal across a Public Works Director, City Engineer, and Finance Director.

What you'll do

Territory Ownership & Business Development

  • Identify, prospect, and close new municipal and government agency clients across your territory through outbound prospecting and relationship-building.
  • Develop and execute a territory sales strategy, including pipeline management, forecasting, and account planning.
  • Own the full account lifecycle: close new logos and expand them. From a pavement scan into sidewalks, ADA, EAM platform, and multi-year agreements.

Procurement & Market Navigation

  • Develop deep expertise in municipal procurement processes — RFP cycles, cooperative purchasing vehicles, and public-sector budget cycles.
  • Understand the political and operational dynamics within local government to position Citylogix effectively.

Product Expertise & Client Demos

  • Master the full Citylogix platform from LiDAR data collection and digital twin to EAM, capital planning, and work order management. Work with Sales Engineer to deliver tailored demos that speak to each stakeholder’s priorities: operational credibility for the Public Works Director, methodology for the City Engineer, and cost-avoidance ROI for Finance.
  • Translate complex technology into clear, ROI-driven value propositions for non-technical audiences.

Market Presence & Brand Representation

  • Attend Illinois municipal conferences (ILCMA, IAMMA, ICMA-IL), manage the company booth, and represent Citylogix as a thought leader in the infrastructure and govtech space.
  • Occasionally present or speak on topics relevant to Citylogix and smart city infrastructure.

CRM & Reporting

  • Maintain a clean and up-to-date Salesforce CRM database with accurate pipeline data.
  • Prepare regular sales forecasts and territory reports for leadership.

Team Collaboration

  • Share field intelligence and market feedback to support product and marketing decisions.
  • Contribute to a positive, collaborative team culture and mentor peers when opportunities arise.

Qualifications

Required

  • 5+ years of B2B sales experience in enterprise software or SaaS, with demonstrated ability to manage multi-stakeholder, multi-year deals, not just transactional sales.
  • Proven track record of hitting or exceeding quota and building a book of business from the ground up.
  • Strong understanding of the municipal public sector…how decisions are made, procurement processes, and stakeholder dynamics.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills… you can simplify complex technology for any audience.
  • Self-starter mentality with the ability to operate independently in a remote, field-based role.
  • Salesforce CRM proficiency.
  • Bachelor's degree in business, urban planning, engineering, or a related field or equivalent experience.

Preferred

  • Experience in GovTech, infrastructure technology, pavement management, utilities, GIS, or asset management.
  • Existing network within the Illinois municipal government community; Public Works Directors, City Engineers, City Managers, or DOT contacts.
  • Familiarity with cooperative purchasing programs (e.g., Sourcewell, OMNIA Partners).

Why Citylogix

Competitive Compensation

Base salary plus uncapped commission. Strong performers earn well above target…this is a real earning opportunity for closers.

Greenfield Territory

Your territory is yours to build. No inherited account list…just a large, underserved market and the freedom to develop it your way.

Category-Leading Product

Sell a product that genuinely works and that clients love. Citylogix wins on product quality, ease of use, and demonstrable outcomes.

Strategic Backing

In January 2026, CRH Ventures — the investment arm of CRH, the world’s largest building materials and road construction company — invested in Citylogix. This means the #1 player in the Global Asphalt market made a bet on Citylogix as the top company in the space...No competitor can replicate that claim.

Flexibility & Autonomy

Remote-first with field travel. We care about results, not how you structure your day.

Mission That Matters

Safe sidewalks. ADA-accessible ramps. Smarter roads. Your work helps cities make better decisions for real people every day.

How to Apply

If you are a driven sales professional who understands government and wants to sell technology that genuinely improves cities, we want to hear from you. Please apply directly to this job post.

About Triplemoon

Our Vision

We help families add years to their life—and life to their years.

Our Mission

Triplemoon exists to close the pediatric mental health gap. Founded in 2023, we partner with pediatricians and family medicine practices to deliver integrated, evidence-based behavioral health care that’s fully covered by insurance, including Medicaid. Our mission is simple: make high-quality mental health support accessible to every family—while helping providers reclaim time, improve outcomes, and build sustainable practices. By combining collaborative care, modern technology, and a whole-family approach, Triplemoon is transforming how—and where—children receive the behavioral health support they deserve.

Our Values

We look for clinicians who align with our values:

  • Whole Human – We treat the whole child and family
  • Evidence-Based – We rely on proven, data-driven care
  • Endlessly Curious – We are always learning and improving
  • Make It Happen – We take ownership and move quickly
  • Radically Candid – We communicate openly and honestly
  • Continuously Improving – We iterate and grow together
The Role

We’re hiring a bilingual (Spanish-speaking) Behavioral Health Care Manager (BHCM) to provide direct, patient-facing care to children, teens, and families within the Collaborative Care Model (CoCM). This is a fully remote role where you will:

  • Spend ~75% of your time working directly with patients and families
  • Deliver brief, evidence-based care designed to drive meaningful change in 6–12 months
  • Collaborate closely with pediatricians, psychiatrists, and a multidisciplinary care team

Why This Role is Different

As a BHCM at Triplemoon, you will:

  • Focus on impactful, structured care (not open-ended therapy)
  • Work within evidence-based clinical pathways designed to drive outcomes
  • Be part of a team-based model where you’re supported by:
    • Pediatricians
    • Psychiatric consultants
    • Care coordinators
  • Deliver care that integrates:
    • Behavioral health intervention
    • Care coordination (school, SDoH, therapies)
    • Family education and support

This role is ideal for clinicians who want to:

  • Spend more time helping patients and families directly
  • Work in a collaborative, coordinated system of care
  • See measurable progress in their patients over time

What You'll Do

Direct Patient Care (~75%)

  • Conduct intake assessments and ongoing follow-up sessions via telehealth
  • Deliver brief, evidence-based interventions:
    • CBT skills
    • Motivational interviewing
    • Behavioral activation
    • Parent coaching
  • Provide in-session education and actionable recommendations to families
  • Track patient progress using validated screening tools

Care Coordination & Clinical Collaboration

  • Support families with:
    • School accommodations
    • SDoH needs
    • Coordination with OT/PT/ST and other specialty services
  • Collaborate with pediatricians and psychiatric consultants
  • Participate in weekly registry review meetings to guide care decisions
  • Partner with board-certified pediatric psychiatrists who:
    • Provide medication recommendations
    • Oversee patient progress and care plans

Documentation & Operations

  • Document all care in our EHR (Healthie)
  • Track outcomes and progress using structured workflows
  • Manage scheduling, follow-ups, and patient engagement
  • Apply standardized protocols (no-shows, cancellations, safety)

What Success Looks Like

Accomplished BHCMs at Triplemoon:

  • Build strong relationships with children and families
  • Deliver structured, goal-oriented sessions
  • Use data and screening tools to guide care
  • Communicate clearly and proactively with their care team
  • Stay organized and follow through consistently
  • Balance clinical care with operational excellence

Requirements

  • Bilingual (fluency in Spanish is a requirement for this role).
  • Active, unrestricted clinical licensure as a licensed clinical social worker (LCSW), licensed professional counselor (LPC), and/or licensed therapist (LMFT).
  • Active licensure in one or more of the following states on or before start-date
    • California
    • Connecticut
    • Florida
    • Maryland
    • Tennessee
    • Texas
    • Virginia
  • Experience working with children, adolescents, and families
  • 3+ years of experience OR a minimum of 3,000 supervised hours

Send your CV, salary expectations and a short video on why this role caught your eye through our recruitment portal no later than August 15th. If you want to show off a great cold email or call opener, we won’t complain.

At RayzeBio, every day is an opportunity to ignite meaningful change. Our mission is to develop transformative radiopharmaceutical therapies that offer new hope for patients living with cancer. From day one, expect to make an immediate impact—on our science, on our teams, and most importantly, on patients. Learn more about RayzeBio:

RayzeBio, a Bristol Myers Squibb company, is a dynamic biotechnology company headquartered in San Diego, CA. The company is focused on improving survival of people with cancer by harnessing the power of targeted radioisotopes. RayzeBio is developing innovative drugs against targets of solid tumors. Led by a successful and experienced entrepreneurial team, RayzeBio aims to be the global leader in radiopharmaceuticals

Through these interactions, the RPT-MSL will begin to generate and communicate valuable insights to inform clinical strategy, evidence generation, and launch readiness. Led by a successful and experienced team, RayzeBio aims to be the global leader in radiopharmaceuticals.

Our client is building the infrastructure that enables humanitarian organizations to use stablecoins without requiring blockchain expertise.

The initial engagement is deliverables-based, with clearly defined objectives and timelines. Upon successful completion of the pilot and continued platform growth, there is a strong opportunity to transition into a long-term full-time engineering role.

Already Live

jobs.description:
ICF is seeking experienced emergency management professionals to join our Disaster Response Finance/Administration Section Reservist Cadre. This is an On-Call position supporting disaster preparedness, response, recovery, and resilience missions across the United States. Assignments are activated based on project and disaster operational needs and may involve deployments to Emergency Operations Centers (EOCs), Joint Field Offices (JFOs), Disaster Recovery Centers (DRCs), client sites, field locations, or remote environments. Deployment opportunities are not guaranteed and may vary in duration, location, and frequency.

Reservists are typically activated for disaster events, emergency exercises, planning projects, and surge support requirements. Candidates should be prepared to deploy with limited notice, work flexible schedules that may include evenings, weekends, and holidays, and support incident operations in dynamic and fast-paced environments.

About On-Call Employment with ICF
Due to the seasonal or project-specific nature of our disaster and emergency management work, ICF hires professionals as "On-Call" employees. On-Call employees are scheduled for work as it becomes available, with the freedom to accept or decline assignments. Individuals may work on concurrent projects outside of their ICF assignments, provided there is no conflict of interest.

Key Responsibilities – What You Will Be Doing
• Support financial management activities including budgeting, cost tracking, expenditure monitoring, forecasting, analysis, and financial reporting for emergency management and disaster recovery operations.
• Assist with disaster recovery grants, reimbursement programs, funding eligibility reviews, cost documentation, compliance monitoring, and program implementation activities.
• Provide procurement, purchasing, contracting, vendor coordination, resource acquisition, and contract administration support while maintaining financial accountability and compliance documentation.
• Perform administrative functions including personnel tracking, timekeeping, travel coordination, deployment administration, records management, reporting, and program documentation.
• Maintain accurate financial, operational, and program records to support audits, reimbursement requests, compliance reviews, and organizational accountability requirements.
• Coordinate with finance, logistics, planning, and operational teams to support emergency response, disaster recovery, preparedness, continuity, and resilience initiatives.
• Support compliance with federal, state, local, organizational, contractual, and grant requirements while identifying and escalating documentation or compliance concerns.

Please attach a reverse chronological, bullet-point concise resume (1 to 3 pages) addressing minimum and preferred qualifications, including job title, employer, dates of employment. Separate list of completed coursework/trainings and deployments may be requested.

Minimum Qualifications –
Candidates must possess qualifications commonly applicable across FEMA Finance/Administration Section Chief and Unit Leader positions.
• 3+ years of professional experience supporting financial management, budgeting, cost tracking, forecasting, financial reporting and expenditure monitoring activities.
• 2+ years of professional experience in grants management, disaster recovery funding programs, reimbursement processes inclusive of regulatory compliance requirements.
• 2+ years of professional experience supporting procurement, purchasing, contracting, or vendor coordination.
• 2+ years of professional experience working with personnel tracking, timekeeping, travel coordination and records management to maintain accurate financial, operational and program records in support of audits, compliance reviews and accountability requirements.
• Completion of FEMA/NIMS ICS courses: 100, 200, 700, 800.
• Must have a valid U.S. driver’s license and successfully pass a Motor Vehicle Records (MVR) check.
• Must be willing and able to travel, both flight and vehicle, with short notice; inclusive of deployment nationally, hours including evenings and weekends in rapidly changing operational environments.

Preferred Qualifications (these will set candidates apart)
• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Public Administration, Economics, Emergency Management, or a related field; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
• Experience working within an Emergency Operations Center or similar environment.
• Experience in supporting finance, timekeeping, purchasing, and similar in a government setting.
• Experience working with federal, state, tribal territorial or local government partners.
• Completion of FEMA/NIMS ICS courses: 300, 400.
• Finance/Administration Section Chief level role: Deployment experience in the FSC role and ICS Training, including ICS 400, E/G/L 0191 and E/L 0973, Type 1-3 experience.

Professional Qualifications (bring these with you day one)
• Excellent time management and prioritization skills, with the ability to balance multiple concurrent projects and short-turn deliverables.
• Proactive, collaborative, team-oriented approach; seeks input early and communicates risks/issues quickly.
• Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making capabilities.
• Proven track record of supporting a team and accomplishing successful business results.
• Strong written and verbal communication skills, emotional intelligence, critical thinking skills, and integrity and ethics.
• Team player with the demonstrated ability to build organizational capability, motivate teaming partners/staff to ensure high levels of engagement, and work in a dynamic, fast-paced environment.
• Strong proficiency with Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Project Management Software).

jobs.title: Principal Network Engineer
jobs.excerpt: About Montera At Montera, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure.
jobs.description:
About Montera

At Montera, we’re building the future of digital infrastructure. Founder-led with $1.5B backed by Stonepeak, Montera is driven by a future-focused vision: to develop and operate hyperscale data centers essential for tomorrow's technology. Our mission is to deliver strategically located, hyperscale data centers designed for speed, reliability, and scalability. Backed by decades of experience in design, construction, and operations, we don’t just build—we execute with purpose.

Our Values

  • Client First Alignment: We align every solution to our clients’ goals.
  • Speed with Certainty: Velocity matters. We deliver with urgency and precision.
  • Operational Excellence: Decades of experience drive our high standards.
  • Safety & Integrity: Safety is non-negotiable. We lead with integrity and transparency.
  • Ownership Mentality: We think like owners, because we are.

The Opportunity

Montera is seeking a Principal Network Engineer to owns the architecture, security, and governance of all Montera-operated networking — spanning corporate IT, critical-infrastructure OT (BMS, SCADA, DCIM, life-safety), administrative, guest, and Wi-Fi networks — and the secure demarcation to customer-managed fabrics. This role owns Montera’s public IP strategy: ARIN/RIR address application and justification, ASN and BGP strategy, IPAM, and the governance of all network allocations, firewalls, and security policy across the fleet.

The role works hand-in-glove with the Principal Controls Engineer. Controls defines the data — the points, tags, and exposure scope Montera surfaces to itself and to the customer; Network delivers the secure transport, segmentation, and demarcation that lets that data be consumed without compromising OT. Montera facilities are single-tenant — one customer per building or campus — so the customer data-access model (what the customer sees, how they reach it, and where the trust boundary sits) is defined with that single customer and governed jointly by these two roles. Neither can deliver it alone.

What You'll Do

Internal Network Architecture (IT / OT / Guest)

  • Own and standardize all Montera-operated networks: corporate IT, OT controls (BMS/SCADA/DCIM), life-safety interfaces, administrative, guest, and Wi-Fi.
  • Define segmentation, zoning, and isolation strategy across IT, OT, and customer domains (e.g., Purdue-model / IEC 62443 alignment for OT).
  • Establish redundancy and survivability standards for mission-critical internal services, monitoring transport, and management networks.

IP Strategy, Addressing & Allocation Governance

  • Own the public IP strategy: ARIN/RIR address-space application and justification, ASN acquisition, and BGP/peering/transit strategy for Montera-operated services.
  • Own IPAM and the governance of all address allocations across sites — internal, OT, shared services, and Montera-side customer handoff ranges.
  • Define addressing, routing, and DNS standards that scale cleanly across a multi-site portfolio.

Security, Firewalls & Critical Infrastructure Networking

  • Own firewall architecture and policy, secure remote-access patterns, role-based access control, micro-segmentation, and audit logging across IT and OT.
  • Design high-security architectures for OT and critical-infrastructure systems; partner with controls, cybersecurity, and operations on baseline hardening, monitoring, and incident-response workflows.
  • Lead risk reviews of exposure paths between customer, IT, and OT domains and drive mitigations through design and governance (supporting Montera’s ISO 27001 posture).

Customer Data Access & Demarcation

  • Executed jointly with the Principal Controls Engineer.
  • Translate the controls-defined data-exposure scope into the secure delivery path: DMZ/broker placement, read-only least-privilege boundaries, firewall policy, and the customer-facing network demarcation for OT/telemetry data.
  • Define demarcation models, handoff points, and clear IT/OT/customer responsibility boundaries between Montera-operated shared infrastructure and customer-managed fabrics.
  • Provision the secure network path for AI optimization platforms (e.g., Phaidra) consuming Montera telemetry — edge, on-prem, or cloud — in partnership with the Controls Engineer.
  • Support customer technical reviews and acceptance testing for data-access and connectivity commitments tied to leases and SLAs.

Customer AI & Compute Networking Enablement

  • Engage the customer directly to capture AI/compute networking requirements: fabric type, bandwidth, latency, scale, storage connectivity, and operational model.
  • Translate customer requirements into deployable designs within facility constraints (space, pathways, power/cooling, operational standards).
  • Define the demarcation between Montera-operated shared infrastructure and customer-managed compute/storage fabrics, with clear handoff and responsibility.

Delivery, Commissioning & Operations Readiness

  • Define configuration, documentation, and automation standards (IPAM, addressing, routing, access control) using Git-based / infrastructure-as-code workflows.
  • Support construction and commissioning milestones: testing, validation, and turnover readiness for internal and shared-service networks.
  • Establish observability standards and operational runbooks for troubleshooting and incident response.

Vendor Strategy & Standardization

  • Lead technical evaluation and selection of network OEMs, firewall/security, Wi-Fi/access, and cabling/optics partners for Montera-owned systems.
  • Drive standardization and cost-optimized BOM strategy aligned to availability, lead time, power, and operational risk.
  • Own technical change control and vendor issue resolution through deployment and lifecycle support.

Requirements

Who You Are:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Controls, Electrical, Mechanical, or Systems Engineering, or related field (Master’s preferred).
  • 10+ years of experience designing and operating data center networks for hyperscale, mission-critical, or regulated environments.
  • Direct experience with RIR/ARIN address application and justification, ASN/BGP, and enterprise IPAM at multi-site scale.
  • Deep firewall, segmentation, and secure-remote-access expertise across both IT and OT (BMS/SCADA/DCIM), with IT/OT segmentation and IEC 62443 / Purdue-model familiarity.
  • Proven experience defining single-tenant customer demarcation and data-access models in secure environments.
  • Strong customer-facing capability: translating requirements into implementable designs and clear demarcation models.
  • Network automation and configuration management (Git-based workflows, templating, infrastructure-as-code).

Benefits

Why Join Montera?

At Montera, you’ll shape the next generation of digital infrastructure while being supported by a team that values integrity, collaboration, and long-term partnership. We’re a remote-first company that empowers our people with flexibility, ownership, and meaningful rewards.

Compensation:

At Montera, we believe great work starts with investing in great people. That is why we offer a competitive and thoughtful total compensation package designed to recognize the value each team member brings.

Our compensation ranges are informed by market data and aligned to job level and role. When making hiring and compensation decisions, we consider a variety of factors, including skills, experience, education, training, competencies, and overall business needs.

The reasonable compensation range for this role is $160,000 - $220,000.

Our Benefits at a Glance:

  • Comprehensive Health Coverage: We pay 90% of health premiums for employees and their dependents.
  • Generous Time Off: Up to 8 weeks of paid time off per year, which includes holidays, PTO, and sick time.
  • Parental Leave: Up to 8 weeks of paid time off after 6 months of employment.
  • Financial Security: 401(k) plan with immediate eligibility, no vesting requirement, and employer match contributions up to 6%.
  • Learning & Development Reimbursement: Up to $3,500 reimbursed annually for approved courses, certifications, conferences and professional development opportunities.
  • Extra Support: Remote work stipend to help you stay connected.

At Montera, you’ll have the autonomy to do great work and the benefits to thrive personally and professionally.

  • We’ve been able to grow our revenues aggressively by combining a service and product offering to our customers. We now want to productise this offering as much as we can. We will need to bring new products to market, you will be at the forefront of this.
  1. Re-imagine and refactor our existing services and tooling into a new generation of capabilities
  • Our current toolset has helped us grow from 0 to 25 clients in the past 18 months. We are now finding that these services and tools will not scale far beyond this point in their current form. We need them to be re-imagined, in light of our learnings from our pathfinder clients, into robust capabilities that can match the growth of our business.
  1. Bridge our Machine Learning, Product and Platform Engineering capabilities
  • We have an extremely talented pool of full-stack machine learning and MLOps engineers and an exceptional platform engineering team. We need software ‘glue’ expertise and capability to bring these two things together optimally. With our other software engineers, you will be this glue.

Requirements

We need versatile people who are happy to get stuck into whatever needs doing, and are ready to learn and grow with the company.

For this particular role, we need a product-focused software engineer with deep technical expertise who takes ownership of problems from start to finish. You will be comfortable working across the stack and across disciplines, equally at home shaping a brand-new product and untangling and rebuilding existing systems. Communication is crucial, as you will work closely with colleagues across machine learning, product, and platform engineering to bring their work together into capabilities the whole team can build on.

  • Have experience bringing products to market - ideally taking a product from 0 to 1, or productising a service offering
  • Have experience re-imagining and refactoring systems and tooling so they scale reliably as a business grows
  • Use AI coding agents as a core part of how you work, with hands-on experience of agentic tools (e.g. Claude Code, Codex)
  • Are an advocate of strong software engineering practices, standards, and culture
  • Are still building hands-on and want to keep doing so for at least the next 12 months

It would be even better, but not essential, if you have:

  • Experience with workflow orchestration systems (e.g. Temporal)
