  • Comunicar progresso, resultados e prioridades para stakeholders executivos
  • Conduzir rituais e alinhamentos com liderança para garantir foco em entregas de alto impacto

Execução e Delivery

  • Liderar squads multidisciplinares (engenharia de dados, BI, analytics, arquitetura)
  • Garantir entregas com qualidade, governança e escalabilidade
  • Monitorar KPIs de produto (adoção, uso, impacto em decisão, ROI)
  • Promover melhoria contínua no ciclo de desenvolvimento e entrega de dados

Cultura Data-Driven

  • Fomentar o uso de dados na tomada de decisão em toda a organização
  • Garantir padronização e governança de indicadores e métricas
  • Atuar como evangelizador de analytics dentro da empresa

Requisitos

Obrigatórios

  • Experiência como Product Owner / Product Manager / Data Product Owner em ambientes de dados ou BI
  • Forte conhecimento em Business Intelligence, Data Analytics e métricas de negócio
  • Experiência com gestão de backlog, roadmap e priorização orientada a valor
  • Vivência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban)
  • Capacidade de traduzir problemas de negócio em soluções analíticas
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação com público técnico e executivo

Desejáveis (diferenciais fortes)

  • Experiência em empresas de bens de consumo (CPG/FMCG)
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas como Power BI, Tableau, Looker ou similares
  • Familiaridade com Data Lake, Data Warehouse e arquitetura moderna de dados
  • Experiência com analytics avançado, forecasting ou machine learning aplicado ao negócio

Indicadores de Sucesso

  • Aumento da adoção de dashboards e produtos de dados
  • Redução do tempo de tomada de decisão (time-to-insight)
  • Impacto direto em KPIs de negócio (receita, margem, eficiência operacional)
  • Nível de satisfação dos stakeholders com as soluções de BI

Perfil Comportamental

  • Mentalidade de dono (ownership)
  • Forte orientação a resultado e impacto
  • Pensamento analítico + visão estratégica
  • Capacidade de navegar em ambientes complexos e matriciais
  • Comunicação clara e influência executiva

Diferencial Estratégico da Posição

Essa posição não é apenas operacional — é um papel-chave para transformar BI em um ativo estratégico da companhia, saindo de dashboards descritivos para uma operação orientada a insights preditivos e decisões automatizadas.

26WD100188, Senior Principal AI/ML Developer

Position Overview

At GET (Growth Experience Technology), we fuel sustainable growth by rethinking how customers discover, buy, and use Autodesk. Our focus is creating a seamless, data-driven experience that feels simple, predictable, and tailored to customer needs—while also making it easier and more efficient for our teams to support them. To get there, we're building smarter digital experiences, strengthening our platforms, and making our sales and marketing efforts much more efficient and connected. While the product experience will play a key role, a real unlock will come from the technologies that power better customer insights, more personalized engagement, and faster sales cycles.

Our GET Applied AI org is looking for a seasoned Sr. Principal Scientist/Machine Learning Developer to drive data-informed decisions for Autodesk B2C business. You will play a critical role in helping Autodesk build the eCommerce platforms of the future. Data Scientists/MLE are both data/research scientists and software developers, who develop and implement machine learning models and algorithms. Unlike other companies that separate these roles, our Data Scientists work on projects from ideation to implementation. As a Senior Principal Data Scientist at Autodesk, you will be responsible for the development and training of cutting-edge machine learning models and algorithms that can effectively leverage our users’ platform activities and industry trends to create personalized recommendations that are delivered to our users at the optimal moment.

Responsibilities

  • Act as a champion for a data-driven culture, evangelizing best practices and shape the direction of key data science areas - segmentation, recommendation systems, forecasting, product analytics, churn prediction and insights

  • Identify, design, prototype, and build scalable end-to-end ML pipelines that enhance Autodesk’s eCommerce personalization at scale

  • Develop and implement robust experimentation frameworks to increase velocity while maintaining scientific rigor, enabling rapid iteration and deployment of personalization models

  • Craft compelling Stories and make logical recommendations based on insights of data and ML models

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to initiate, lead and drive to completion large-scale/complex strategic projects for teams, departments and the company

  • Act as a thought partner to senior cross-functional leaders to prioritize/scope projects, provide recommendations, and evangelize data-driven business decisions in support of strategic goals

  • Mentor and guide junior data scientists/MLE by helping with project planning, technical decisions, and code and document review

Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in data science, statistics, computer science, a related technical field

  • 10 years of experience leading technical project strategy, ML design, and optimizing industry-scale ML infrastructure (e.g., model deployment, model evaluation, data processing, debugging, fine tuning)

  • 10+ years of hands-on experience with data mining, and information retrieval

  • Experience in A/B testing and experimental design

  • Strong understanding of statistics, probability, and financial modeling

  • Ability to translate data insights into business impact

Preferred Qualifications

  • MS or PhD in a quantitative discipline: data science, statistics, computer science, a related technical field

  • 15+ years of hands-on experience in machine learning design, development and deployment, ideally in eCommerce domain

  • Hands-on experience with cloud machine learning platform (AWS, Azure) and MLOps best practices

26WD100188, Développeur principal senior en IA/ML

Aperçu du Poste

Chez GET (Growth Experience Technology), nous favorisons une croissance durable en repensant la manière dont les clients découvrent, achètent et utilisent les solutions Autodesk. Notre objectif est de créer une expérience fluide, axée sur les données, qui soit simple, prévisible et adaptée aux besoins des clients, tout en permettant à nos équipes de les accompagner plus facilement et plus efficacement. Pour y parvenir, nous développons des expériences numériques plus intelligentes, renforçons nos plateformes et rendons nos efforts de vente et de marketing bien plus efficaces et coordonnés. Si l’expérience produit jouera un rôle clé, c’est avant tout grâce aux technologies permettant une meilleure compréhension des clients, un engagement plus personnalisé et des cycles de vente plus rapides que nous parviendrons à nous démarquer véritablement.

Notre organisation GET Applied AI recherche un scientifique principal senior / développeur en apprentissage automatique expérimenté pour piloter les décisions fondées sur les données au sein de l’activité B2C d’Autodesk. Vous jouerez un rôle essentiel en aidant Autodesk à construire les plateformes de commerce électronique de demain. Les scientifiques des données / développeurs en apprentissage automatique (MLE) sont à la fois des scientifiques spécialisés dans les données et la recherche, et des développeurs logiciels, qui conçoivent et mettent en œuvre des modèles et des algorithmes d’apprentissage automatique. Contrairement à d’autres entreprises qui séparent ces fonctions, nos data scientists travaillent sur des projets de la conception à la mise en œuvre. En tant que data scientist principal senior chez Autodesk, vous aurez la responsabilité du développement et de l’entraînement de modèles et d’algorithmes d’apprentissage automatique de pointe, capables d’exploiter efficacement les activités de nos utilisateurs sur la plateforme ainsi que les tendances du secteur afin de créer des recommandations personnalisées qui seront proposées à nos utilisateurs au moment le plus opportun.

Responsabilités

  • Être le fer de lance d’une culture axée sur les données, promouvoir les meilleures pratiques et définir l’orientation des domaines clés de la science des données : segmentation, systèmes de recommandation, prévision, analyse produit, prédiction du taux de désabonnement et insights

  • Identifier, concevoir, prototyper et construire des pipelines d’apprentissage automatique de bout en bout et évolutifs qui améliorent la personnalisation du commerce électronique d’Autodesk à grande échelle

  • Développer et mettre en œuvre des cadres d’expérimentation robustes pour accroître la vélocité tout en conservant une rigueur scientifique, permettant ainsi l’itération et le déploiement rapides de modèles de personnalisation

  • Élaborer des récits convaincants et formuler des recommandations logiques basées sur les enseignements tirés des données et des modèles d’apprentissage automatique

  • Collaborer avec des équipes interfonctionnelles pour lancer, diriger et mener à bien des projets stratégiques complexes et à grande échelle pour les équipes, les services et l’entreprise

  • Jouer le rôle de partenaire stratégique auprès des responsables interfonctionnels de haut niveau pour hiérarchiser et définir la portée des projets, formuler des recommandations et promouvoir des décisions métier fondées sur les données, en soutien aux objectifs stratégiques

  • Encadrer et guider les data scientists et MLE juniors en les aidant dans la planification des projets, les décisions techniques, ainsi que la révision du code et de la documentation

Qualifications Minimales

  • Licence en science des données, statistiques, informatique ou dans un domaine technique connexe

  • 10 ans d’expérience dans la direction de la stratégie de projets techniques, la conception d’apprentissage automatique (ML) et l’optimisation d’infrastructures ML à l’échelle industrielle (par exemple : déploiement de modèles, évaluation de modèles, traitement des données, débogage, réglage fin)

  • 7 ans d’expérience en conception et architecture, ainsi qu’en tests et lancement de produits logiciels

  • Plus de 10 ans d’expérience pratique en exploration de données et en recherche d’informations

  • Expérience en tests A/B et en conception expérimentale

  • Solide compréhension des statistiques, des probabilités et de la modélisation financière

  • Capacité à traduire les enseignements tirés des données en impact commercial

Qualifications Souhaitées

  • Master ou doctorat dans une discipline quantitative : science des données, statistiques, informatique ou un domaine technique connexe

  • Plus de 15 ans d’expérience pratique dans la conception, le développement et le déploiement de systèmes d’apprentissage automatique, idéalement dans le domaine du commerce électronique

What IT Client Services contributes to Cardinal Health

Information Technology oversees the effective development, delivery, and operation of computing and information services. This function anticipates, plans, and delivers Information Technology solutions and strategies that enable operations and drive business value.

IT Client Services provides Tier 1-3 virtual and physical support to the organization's end users for software, hardware, digital employee experience management, conference room technology and meeting support, warehouse technology, server, network, and enterprise systems issues. Frequently responding to escalated issues from the IT Service Center, this group resolves user requests through discussions with users and coordination with internal and external resources and provides education and trainings to users to facilitate knowledge transfer and prevent problem reoccurrence. IT Client Services also maintains ownership for certain end user productivity platforms and capabilities, such as virtual environments and collaboration toolsets, and addresses service outages. This area acquires, installs and upgrades PC components and software, while also performing asset management for software and hardware.

Digital Employee Experience (DEX) Product Owner Role Summary

The Digital Employee Experience (DEX) Product Owner is responsible for leading the execution and value realization of Cardinal Health's Digital Employee Experience transformation roadmap. This role will serve as the business owner and strategic leader for a multi-year DEX program focused on improving employee productivity, reducing digital friction, modernizing IT service delivery, and enabling proactive employee experiences through data, automation, AI, and journey-based design.

The Digital Employee Experience (DEX) product owner role is responsible for ensuring Cardinal Health realizes the full value of its DEX tool investment. This product owner role is responsible for converting telemetry, sentiment, and operational insights into measurable business outcomes including improved employee productivity, lower support costs, optimized technology spending (i.e. tech refresh), and enhanced employee experiences.

The DEX Product Owner will function as both a strategic transformation leader and a traditional technical Product Owner, overseeing a team responsible for DEX analytics, experience campaigns, and value realization while managing the product backlog, change controls, and release governance with Client Engineering and support teams. This role will ensure DEX insights are translated into tested and approved remediation actions, coordinate the deployment of endpoint improvements through established change management processes, and lead the development and socialization of employee communications and targeted experience campaigns that drive adoption, awareness, and continuous improvement of the digital workplace experience.

Responsibilities:

  • Own and lead the Digital Employee Experience (DEX) roadmap, backlog, and governance processes, ensuring alignment to the organization's three-year transformation objectives and value realization targets.

  • Work with business and IT partners to drive the adoption of AI-enabled solutions, self-healing automation, and proactive support models.

  • Serve as the primary business owner for DEX platform capabilities.

  • Lead a dedicated team of DEX analysts and experience specialists responsible for monitoring endpoint telemetry, employee sentiment, and digital experience data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for proactive improvement.

  • Translate DEX insights into prioritized remediation initiatives and actionable workstreams for Client Engineering, End User Computing, Service Desk, Infrastructure, IT Solution Owner application support teams, IT Asset Management, and other operational support teams.

  • Serve as the technical Product Owner for DEX-driven enhancements by managing product backlogs, defining requirements, prioritizing fixes, and ensuring solutions align to business priorities and employee experience outcomes.

  • Partner with Client Engineering and technology teams to govern change controls, release management activities, testing strategies, and production deployments associated with DEX-recommended fixes and enhancements.

  • Ensure all DEX-driven remediation activities are thoroughly validated, tested, and approved through established change management and governance processes before deployment to the enterprise.

  • Develop and execute communication, adoption, and change management strategies for major endpoint updates, operating system changes, application enhancements, and proactive remediation campaigns that impact the employee experience.

  • Lead the creation and socialization of employee-facing communications that clearly articulate upcoming changes, expected benefits, business impacts, and recommended actions associated with DEX-driven improvements.

  • Drive targeted digital experience campaigns that educate employees, improve technology adoption, gather feedback, and continuously enhance employee productivity and satisfaction.

  • Establish closed-loop processes to ensure DEX insights are converted into actions, actions are measured for effectiveness, and outcomes are continuously incorporated into future prioritization and roadmap decisions.

  • Define, monitor, and report key performance indicators related to employee productivity, digital experience scores, service desk demand reduction, automation effectiveness, device performance, and technology investment optimization.

We are Worldwide Clinical Trials, and we are a global team of over 3,500+ experts, bright thinkers, dreamers and doers and, together, we are changing the way the world experiences CROs – in the best possible way.

Our mission is to work with passion and purpose every day to improve lives and we are looking for others who value this same pursuit.

Why Worldwide

We believe everyone plays an important role in making a world of difference for patients and their caregivers. From our hands-on, accessible leaders, to our cohesive and supportive teams, we are committed to enabling professionals from all backgrounds and experiences to succeed. We prioritize cultivating a diverse and inclusive environment that continues to promote collaboration and creativity. We are proud to be a workplace where people thrive by being themselves and are inspired to do their best work every day. Join us!

What Project Management does at Worldwide

Worldwide Clinical Trials Project management is the perfect blend of operational rigor and therapeutic expertise, with a client-focused approach. Our Global Project Leads (GPLs) and Clinical Project Managers (CPMs) expertly guide our project teams to deliver with high quality, focusing on “doing it right the first time”.

The Project Management team is engaged in all aspects of the trial collaborating with scientific and therapeutic leadership, coordinating across project teams, and providing flexible, innovative and proactive solutions. At Worldwide, you will be dedicated to a specific therapeutic area which will not only give you an opportunity to develop in-depth global operational expertise, but also benefit from exceptional scientific and medical background that our experts bring.

What you will do

  • Works effectively across multiple divisions to direct the delivery of projects/programs within cost, time, and quality requirements

  • Provide direct supervision, support, training, and mentoring to project managers

  • Collaborate with Business Development team on proposals and bid defense

  • May have immediate supervision of employees, prepares and may conduct performance appraisals and salary reviews, and applies company policies

  • Works with leadership in all functional areas on the continuous development/improvement of business processes to support cross-functional teams and to ensure that work is uniform, complete, and managed appropriately

  • Serves as a liaison with Business Development and Bids/Contracts for the client presentations and proposal development

  • Assists in resource utilization, policy development, and implementation of goals

What you will bring to the role

  • Strong leadership skills

  • Strong financial acumen

  • Expert knowledge of project management principles and application

  • Knowledge of budgeting, forecasting, and resource management

  • Skilled in process improvement, especially as it applies to clinical trials, clinical development, and project management

Your experience

  • University/college degree (life science preferred) or certification in a related allied health profession from an appropriately accredited institution (e.g., nursing certification, medical or laboratory technology) or equivalent combination of education and experience that provides the individual with the required knowledge, skills and abilities

  • Minimum of ten (10) years of clinical pharmaceutical industry experience including demonstrated skills and competency in clinical project management tasks

  • In lieu of the above requirements, candidates with > five (5) years supervisory experience in a health care setting and eight (8) years clinical research experience in the pharmaceutical or CRO industries will be considered

  • Experience managing Rheumatology studies is required for this role.

In addition to base salary, we offer a competitive benefits package depending on location. We ensure pay equity and transparency and comply with all applicable labor laws. Salary information will be discussed during the interview process, and we encourage candidates to inquire about compensation at any stage.

We love knowing that someone is going to have a better life because of the work we do.

Corporate Travel Consultant

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

Ranked as one of the world’s top five travel management companies, it has a business network in over 97 countries and global headquarters in London, Brisbane, Singapore and New York. Backed by the global strength of Flight Centre Travel Group (FCTG), FCM combines local expertise and global experience to provide clients with a truly bespoke experience.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend four weeks in training (paid).This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM ET Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM ET once or twice a week.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals
  • Ensure accurate and timely completion of reservations while meeting travelers' needs
  • Executing all responsibilities within company guidelines for customer service, documentation of PNRS (Passenger Name Records) and profiles, ticketing, invoicing, and maintaining accuracy throughout
  • Staying fully informed about airline rules, regulations, tariffs, and fare requirements and applying this knowledge accurately to all travel arrangements
  • Deliver consultative support and exceptional customer service throughout the booking process
  • Keeping clients informed about all necessary travel documents and health requirements for their destinations
  • Proficiently handling ticketing, Phase IVs, and exchanges/changes involving complex international fares
  • Expertly managing rerouting and exchange processes, ensuring minimal disruption to travel plans
  • Other duties and tasks as assigned
  • Contribute to a safe, inclusive, and accessible work environment where all Flighties feel welcomed, respected, and supported to thrive

Experience & Qualifications

  • 2+ years of recent, prior experience in corporate travel management, understanding the unique needs and challenges of business travelers.
  • In-depth familiarity with current Sabre GDS (Global Distribution System) for fare calculations, itinerary management, and ticket issuance.
  • Previous exposure to quality control processes to ensure the accuracy and compliance of travel bookings.
  • Proficiency in ticketing procedures and scripting, along with the ability to handle complex itinerary changes and exchanges for both international and domestic travel.
  • Proven ability to navigate and manipulate complex itineraries, international fares, and Passenger Name Records (PNRs) to meet client requirements.
  • A polished and professional demeanor when interacting with clients and colleagues.
  • Proficiency in handling multiple urgent tasks simultaneously while maintaining efficiency and quality in each interaction.
  • The capacity to make quick and effective decisions to resolve travel-related issues promptly.
  • Excellent communication skills to keep clients informed and reassured throughout the travel process.
  • A deep commitment to delivering exceptional customer service with a focus on client satisfaction.
  • Comfortable and proficient in using travel booking systems and various communication tools.
  • Strong technical aptitude with the ability to troubleshoot and adapt to new technologies
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and manage tasks successfully
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connectivity required to support core job responsibilities, including but not limited to video conferencing, access to company systems, and secure handling of company data.

Work Perks! - What’s in it for you:

FCTG is renowned internationally for having amazing perks and an even better culture. We understand that our people are our most valuable asset. It is the passion and dedication of our teams that keep the company on top of the industry ladder. It’s also why we offer some great employee benefits and perks outside of the norm.

  • Have fun:At the heart of everything we do at Flight Centre is a desire to have fun.
  • Reward & Recognition: Celebrate the success of yourself and others at our regular Buzz Nights and at the annual Global Gathering - You'll have to experience it to believe it!
  • Use your smarts:Our people use their quick thinking, expertise, and tenacity to always figure things out.
  • Love for travel:We were founded by people who wanted to travel and want others to do the same. That passion is something you can’t miss in our people or service.
  • Personal connections:We are a big business founded on personal relationships.
  • Diversity, Equity & Inclusion: Commitment to diversity, equity, and inclusion through initiatives like Diversity Day (paid leave to observe a holiday or cultural celebration of your choice) Employee Resource Groups (Racial Equity, Gender Equity, LGBTQ2IA+, Accessibility, Environmental Justice), DEI education initiatives, and equitable practices, including regular equity assessments and inclusive recruitment protocols.
  • A career, not a job:We offer genuine opportunities for people to grow and evolve
  • We back our people all the way: We are strongly committed to supporting every single employee in their professional and personal development.
  • Giving Back:Our Corporate Social Responsibility program supports nominated charities through volunteering and fundraising, complemented by our Office Environmental Program, LEED® Gold-certified office spaces, and 1 paid Volunteer Day per calendar year.

Benefits Include:

  • Paid Time Off: A comprehensive time off package, including up to 15 vacation days (prorated upon hire and increasing to 20 days after 2 years of employment), 5 sick days, 3 personal days, 1 Diversity Day, 1 Volunteer Day, and 9 recognized holidays annually.
  • Travel perks/discounts
  • Health & Wellness Programs and Employee Financial Wellness Services
  • National/International Award Nights and Conferences

  • Insurance including hospital indemnity, AD&D, critical illness, long-term and short-term disability
  • Flexible Spending Accounts
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • 401k program with partial match
  • Tuition Reimbursement Program
  • Employee Share Plan – Ability to purchase company stock on Australian Stock Exchange with partial company match, subject to terms and conditions
  • Global career opportunities in a network of brands and businesses

*Vacation, Personal, and Sick time accrual rates will vary based on full-time or part-time employee status. Recognized Holidays are either paid time off or, if required to work due to job requirements, holiday pay rate, and may vary depending on state.

Location – Remote, USA

For this position, we anticipate offering an hourly pay rate of $28.85 plus commission/incentive earnings based on achievable targets. On target earnings average range between $60,000 - $67,000. The annual salary range listed represents the total compensation package, excluding benefits.

FCM takes a holistic approach to corporate travel, specializing in managing national and global travel programs for medium and large businesses.

To learn more about FCM please click HERE

About the Opportunity

This role will have you arranging domestic and complex international travel for busy executives including air, car hotel and ground transportation. Before you begin your role, you will spend four weeks in training (paid).This program will boost your knowledge, train you on contract airfares and sharpen your Sabre skills. Our corporate travel agents handle the air, car, rail and ground transportation bookings as well as the ticketing, changes and the exchange and queue management.  You will also need to offer exceptional customer service to satisfy our business traveler’s needs. We encourage our Corporate Travel Agents to study the travel polices of our corporate accounts and develop a relationship with them so when our valued business travelers have the need for business travel arrangements, they rest assured that their business travel needs are in the hands of a dedicated team of Corporate Travel professionals they trust and are on a first name basis with.

Our business hours are 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM ET Monday – Friday

A typical schedule will include a 40-hour work week with five 8-hour shifts. Be prepared to work an evening shift until 8:00 PM ET once or twice a week.

  • Coordinate air, hotel, car, and ground transportation bookings for domestic and international travel
  • Build rapport and develop a relationship with business travelers to ensure their business travel needs are in the hands of a trusted team of Corporate Travel professionals

Description

You will manage Exalate’s paid growth engine to drive business growth and brand lift. You will be responsible for launching and improving campaigns quickly across Google, LinkedIn, Meta and Reddit, execute clean tracking in GA4 and GTM, and read the numbers and turn every insight into the next experiment.

This role requires a hands-on, detail-oriented marketer who is not only data-savvy but also creative and curious about the latest marketing innovations — especially in the fast-evolving AI space.

So if you like short feedback loops and visible impact, you will feel at home here.



Requirements

  • One to two years of hands-on experience in B2B SaaS - Google Ads, LinkedIn, and Meta; Reddit experience is a bonus

  • Working knowledge of GA4 and GTM, including event setup and debugging

  • Strong communication, team collaboration, and project management skills

  • Basic SEO and copywriting knowledge: recognize search intent, structure a page and explain how organic and paid support each other. Willingness to create the first draft and messaging for campaigns.

  • Fluent in written and spoken English at a minimum B2 level

  • Solid grasp of CTR, CPL, CAC and the LTV-to-CAC ratio



Key Responsibilities

  • Audit and maintain all paid channels in good shape. Keep naming conventions, budgets and audiences tidy so spend can shift to winners - quickly.

  • Design and launch campaigns

    • Build and optimize Search, Display, and retargeting in Google & Bing Ads.

  • Design and manage LinkedIn campaigns

    • Conversation Ads, Sponsored Content, and Lead-Gen Forms

    • Audience segmentation by job title, company size and matched lists

    • Account-based retargeting for high-value prospects

  • Run Meta campaigns

    • Retarget website visitors and in-platform engagers.

    • Test look-alike audiences and conversion-focused objectives

    • Rotate static, carousel, and short-form video creatives

  • Launch Reddit ads

    • Target relevant subreddits for developers and IT teams

    • Experiment with conversation and promoted-post formats

    • Capture early-funnel interest and feed remarketing pools

  • Measure everything

    • Create a full tagging plan with UTMs, GA4 events and GTM triggers so every click maps to the pipeline.

    • Maintain a Looker Studio dashboard that shows spend, CPL, CAC and qualified demos each week.

  • Create and refine assets

    • Write clear, benefit-led ad copy.

    • Brief designers on static or motion creatives and make quick edits yourself when speed matters.

  • Run constant experiments

    • Launch at least two controlled tests each month on audience, creative or landing page.

    • Record hypothesis, result and next step to grow a living growth playbook.

  • Collaborate closely with product marketing, CRO, content, and brand teams to align campaign messaging and objectives.

    • Share keyword and funnel insights with SEO and content teams.

    • Sync paid-media events into HubSpot so closed-won deals trace back to campaigns.

You will work closely with and report to the Head of Marketing and Growth Ops to ensure that our paid channel contributes to our overall business objectives - growth.



Ideal Traits

  • Experiment first and form opinions later.

  • Treat the budget like personal money.

  • Soak up feedback and iterate quickly.

  • Bring energy, curiosity, and ownership to every project.

What success looks like

  • Month 0 to 3

    • Complete an audit of Google, LinkedIn, Meta and Reddit accounts with a written action plan.

    • Track one hundred percent of conversions in GA4 with clean UTMs.

    • Publish a weekly performance dashboard that the team relies on.

  • Month 3 to 6

    • Reduce cost per qualified demo by ten percent while volume rises.

    • Ship two documented tests each month and apply the learnings.

    • Publish playbooks for campaign builds, tag checks and report refresh.

  • Month 6 to 12

    • Hit or exceed paid-pipeline targets each quarter.

    • Run full-funnel remarketing across web, LinkedIn, Meta and Reddit.

    • Launch a small-budget pilot on one additional channel such as YouTube.

Impact and scope

  • Shape how Exalate acquires and nurtures new customers.

  • Manage a six-figure budget and the tool set that tracks its return.


Tool stack
Google Ads Editor, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Meta Ads Manager, Reddit Ads Dashboard, Google Tag Manager, GA4, Looker Studio, HubSpot, Google Sheets, Microsoft Clarity, Google Search Console, Ahrefs, Supermetrics, Jira (basic knowledge for project management), Slack (virtual office), Figma or Canva (plus)

Our marketing team thrives on innovation, agility, and quick data-driven decision-making. We are looking to add a technical performance marketer to our team, who is eager to learn, experiment, and help scale our paid channels while strengthening our brand. jobs.title: Marketing Guru
jobs.excerpt: Mission: Our engineering team is known for solving problems that others consider impossible.
jobs.description:
Mission:
Our engineering team is known for solving problems that others consider impossible. Now we need a Marketing Guru who can do the same—but in the field of growth.
This isn't about “promotion” or glossy magazines. This is marketing as an engineering discipline of opportunity: analysis, hypotheses, experiments, and strategies that open up new markets before anyone else knows they exist.
You will work directly with the founders and leading engineers, turning technical excellence into a market advantage. Your task is to create a system for attracting new customers from complex and non-obvious domains.

What needs to be done
- Define marketing strategy and performance standards at the company level.
- Conduct marketing as research and development: hypotheses → tests → results.
- Ensure a predictable flow of new inbound leads from target markets (US/Europe).
- Link marketing to revenue, integrate it into the sales and delivery cycle.
- Manage the full cycle of marketing functions (analytics, content, brand, digital).
- Take personal responsibility for results by creating a system rather than dependence on performers.

Key performance indicators
1. Creation of marketing assets
- Timely development of new marketing and commercial materials: landing pages, posts, advertising campaigns, presentations.
- Delivery time: up to 1 week from the moment the task is set.
- Quality: engagement and conversion above industry standards (conversion > 3%).
- Materials directly support the sales funnel and generate inbound demand.

2. Formation and verification of marketing hypotheses
- A continuous process of generating and testing hypotheses about the audience, positioning, and channels.
- Each hypothesis must be tested within 2 weeks with clear metrics (go/no-go).
- We implement an evidence-based marketing approach: we measure, test, and scale.

3. Return on marketing investment (ROMI)
- ROMI is no less than 10:1, with quarterly improvement in lead cost.
- Analytics are based on CV, UV, CPL, and ROI metrics.
- Budget optimization is achieved by prioritizing channels with maximum profitability.

4. Administrative and reporting discipline
- Transparency and manageability of the process through accurate reporting, documentation, and metrics.
- 100% compliance with internal standards for reporting, documentation, and deadlines.
- As the team scales, advanced performance and engagement metrics are added.

5. Brand recognition and awareness
- Builds and strengthens Gehtsoft brand awareness in target markets (the US and Western Europe).
- During the first 90 days, basic brand awareness metrics are established and growth is tracked.
- The goal is to steadily increase brand awareness among target audiences.

6. Marketing and sales synergy
- Works closely with the sales department to create a unified lead generation and conversion cycle.
- Joint responsibility for achieving revenue and funnel filling goals.

Indicators:
≥ 50 new MQLs (Marketing Qualified Leads) per week,

conversion to meetings > 20%,

further stages of the funnel — above the industry benchmark.

Who we are looking for
- A strategist with an engineering mindset: hypothesis → experiment → result.
- A leader who can look for opportunities rather than excuses.
- Someone who sees patterns where others see noise.
- A specialist who can turn ideas into a system and a system into results.

Requirements
- Experience in B2B/B2C marketing, digital and content strategies.
- Case experience in the US and Western European markets.
- Ability to link marketing metrics to financial indicators.
- Team management and C-suite working skills.
- Ability to quickly immerse yourself in IT markets, technologies, and client industries.
- Financial and operational maturity: working with ROI, budget, and risks.

Why Gehtsoft
Gehtsoft USA is an engineering company founded in 1999, specializing in non-recurring custom development. Our clients are based in the US and Western Europe, mainly in the B2B and FinTech sectors.
We are not looking for marketers who will embellish presentations.
We are looking for researchers who will discover new areas of growth before others do.
If you see marketing as a discipline of finding patterns and creating value, and consider data to be the best source of inspiration, then welcome aboard.

Shape the Future of Medicare Advantage Performance

Health plans today face unprecedented challenges, including evolving CMS regulations, increasing pressure to improve quality outcomes, rising member expectations, and tighter financial margins.


At Press Ganey, we help health plans navigate these complexities and achieve measurable results. Through industry-leading expertise in quality, member experience, analytics, and regulatory performance, we partner with organizations to improve Star Ratings, optimize member outcomes, enhance operational effectiveness, and drive sustainable growth.


We are seeking a Consultant to join our Stars Consulting Center of Excellence. This role is ideal for a Medicare Advantage professional who combines strong analytical capabilities with deep knowledge of Stars performance and regulatory quality programs. You will work directly with health plan leaders to identify opportunities, solve complex challenges, and deliver strategies that improve performance across the most critical quality measures.


What You'll Do


As a Senior Consultant, you will serve as a trusted advisor to health plans, helping clients improve quality performance and achieve strategic objectives.


Key Responsibilities

  • Lead consulting engagements focused on Medicare Stars and regulatory performance improvement.
  • Analyze and interpret data across HEDIS, CAHPS, HOS, Part D, operational measures, and Special Needs Plans (SNPs).
  • Conduct performance assessments, measure trending, gap analyses, cut-point modeling, and root cause analyses.
  • Develop executive-level recommendations and actionable improvement strategies based on data insights.
  • Partner with health plan and medical group stakeholders to identify opportunities for quality, experience, and operational improvement.
  • Design and facilitate workshops, training sessions, and process improvement initiatives.
  • Manage project plans, timelines, deliverables, budgets, and engagement outcomes.
  • Build strong client relationships and serve as a primary point of contact throughout engagements.
  • Monitor CMS guidance, regulatory requirements, and technical specification updates, translating changes into meaningful client recommendations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate Stars consulting strategies with analytics, CAHPS, HOS, and member experience solutions.

Areas of Consulting Impact


Stars Center of Excellence

Provide end-to-end consulting support across HEDIS, CAHPS, HOS, Part D, and SNPs, helping health plans improve performance, close quality gaps, enhance member outcomes, and maximize Star Ratings.


Regulatory Readiness

Guide clients through evolving CMS and state requirements by conducting readiness assessments, simulations, and strategic planning initiatives aligned to quality, compliance, and Stars performance goals.


Performance Stabilization & Transformation

Support organizations during critical business transitions, including M&A integrations, organizational restructuring, and SNP launches, through governance design, stakeholder alignment, quality program optimization, and sustainable performance improvement strategies.


Qualifications

Required

  • 2+ years of experience in health plan quality, Medicare Stars, healthcare consulting, experience management, or performance improvement.
  • Hands-on experience supporting Dual/SNP and MA Star Ratings performance.
  • Knowledge of one or more quality domains, including HEDIS, CAHPS, HOS, Part D, medication adherence, or quality operations.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience using Excel, Access, SQL, SAS, or similar tools.
  • Demonstrated success driving measurable quality or performance improvement initiatives.
  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders and communicate effectively with executive audiences.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
  • Strong project management and organizational skills.
  • Bachelor's degree required.

Why Press Ganey?

This is an opportunity to join a high-impact consulting team that helps some of the nation's leading health plans improve quality, elevate member experience, and achieve stronger business results. You'll work on meaningful challenges, collaborate with industry experts, and directly influence the performance of programs that serve millions of Medicare beneficiaries.


If you're passionate about Medicare Advantage quality and want to help shape the future of Stars performance, we'd like to hear from you.

From initial concept to build, launch, and post-launch iteration, this Product Manager is responsible for bringing new savings and annuity products to market that are simple, trustworthy, and built to scale.

Along with deep product design and strategy skills, this is a highly cross-functional role. The Product Manager will partner with a dedicated product squad, as well as Legal/Compliance, Operations, Marketing, and Strategy, to take products from zero to one and ensure each new offering is compliant, transparent, and customer-centric.

How You'll Contribute:

As the Product Manager for Customer Acquisition, you will:

  • Own the new product vision and roadmap, prioritizing initiatives based on business opportunity, customer research, and effort.
  • Engage with customers to understand needs, pain points, and trust drivers, balancing these qualitative insights with quantitative data trends.
  • Conduct competitive product analysis to identify gaps and opportunities for new savings and annuity products and translate them into product concepts.
  • Collaborate with design and engineering on rapid prototyping and iteration cycles to test new product concepts, features, and pricing structures before full-scale launch.
  • Develop product metrics (e.g., adoption rate, time-to-launch, early retention, customer feedback scores) with robust instrumentation and reporting.
  • Collaborate with Operations, Legal, Marketing and Compliance teams to design new products that are both simple to understand and robust in terms of regulatory requirements.
  • Become the expert and point of contact for all new-product-related questions, feedback, and requests across the organization and with key external partners.
  • Write clear, concise PRDs and product specs, including problem statements, hypotheses, success metrics, and rollout plans, that both technical and non-technical stakeholders can act on.
  • Use AI tools to speed up research, concept iteration, and content generation while maintaining rigorous standards for data quality and regulatory sensitivity.

What We're Looking For:

  • 6+ years of product management experience, specifically with a track record of taking new products from concept to launch (0-to-1 experience strongly preferred).
  • Data-driven decision maker with a track record of using evidence (customer research, market sizing, pilot results, cohort analysis) to guide every priority.
  • Ability to turn abstract complexity (risk checks, regulations, eligibility rules) into simple, intuitive product experiences without sacrificing compliance or trust.
  • Skilled at prioritizing tradeoffs between speed to market, customer experience, compliance, and long-term brand equity, and aligning teams on those decisions.
  • Strong communicator who can articulate strategies, tradeoffs, and launch results to Marketing, Engineering, Design, Operations, Legal, and Executive stakeholders.
  • Proven ownership mindset with the ability to independently chart strategy, execute, and iterate quickly in a dynamic environment.
  • Go-to-market leader with experience partnering with Marketing to plan and execute launches, positioning, and lifecycle programs that scale and sustain product adoption.
  • Regular user of AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, and execution while applying strong judgment in a regulated domain.

Nice to Have:

  • Fintech or Insurtech experience, particularly launching new financial or insurance products.
  • Startup or high-growth background, especially in 0-to-1 product environments.
  • Experience in another function (e.g., engineering, design, data science) that informs cross-functional collaboration.
  • Experience defining and leveraging AI/ML for new product use cases (e.g., pricing optimization, personalization, product recommendation engines).

How This Role Connects to Our Values:

We look for product leaders with a proven ownership mindset, who dig into problems and opportunities with minimal direction. This role is ideal for someone who is energized by learning, experimentation, and iterating on product strategies with others. We support whole-person growth through flexibility, development, and inclusive practices, and are committed to building a diverse team that reflects the customers we serve.

Compensation:

Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several U.S. geographic markets. The base pay for this position ranges from $165,000/year in our lowest geographic market up to $210,000/year in our highest geographic market plus bonus. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Benefits Highlights:

Employees who meet benefit eligibility guidelines and work 30 hours or more weekly, have the ability to enroll in Group 1001’s benefits package. Employees (and their families) are eligible to participate in the Company’s comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance plan options. Employees are also eligible for Basic and Supplemental Life Insurance, Short and Long-Term Disability. All employees (regardless of hours worked) have immediate access to the Company’s Employee Assistance Program and wellness programs—no enrollment is required. Employees may also participate in the Company’s 401K plan, with matching contributions by the Company.

Group 1001, and its affiliated companies, is strongly committed to providing a supportive work environment where employee differences are valued. Diversity is an essential ingredient in making Group 1001 a welcoming place to work and is fundamental in building a high-performance team. Diversity embodies all the differences that make us unique individuals. All employees share the responsibility for maintaining a workplace culture of dignity, respect, understanding and appreciation of individual and group differences.

jobs.excerpt: Шукаємо автора/ку курсу "Becoming CFO" — людину, яка допоможе фінансовим менеджерам перейти від контролю цифр до ролі стратегічного партнера бізнесу.
jobs.description:
Шукаємо автора/ку курсу "Becoming CFO" — людину, яка допоможе фінансовим менеджерам перейти від контролю цифр до ролі стратегічного партнера бізнесу.

Ми у Projector Institute ми створюємо освіту, яка справді змінює кар’єрні траєкторії.

Нам важливо не просто навчити інструментам, а допомогти перейти на новий рівень впливу — у цьому випадку з фінансового менеджера до CFO як співархітектора бізнесу.

Зараз шукаємо автора/ку, який/яка сам(а) прожив цей перехід: працює або працював(ла) CFO, приймав(ла) рішення про залучення капіталу, будував(ла) фінансову стратегію та взаємодіяв(ла) з CEO і бордом. Нам важливо, щоб ти мислив(ла) категоріями вартості бізнесу, а не лише фінансової дисципліни, і вмів(ла) передати це мислення іншим.

(на створення курсу передбачено 2–3 місяці, ще 2 місяці — на проведення)

Кого ми бачимо перед собою, коли уявляємо ідеального/ну автора/ку курсу Becoming CFO:
— ти діючий або екс-CFO середнього або великого бізнесу;
— маєш досвід роботи з CEO та бордом;
— приймав(ла) рішення щодо структури капіталу та залучення фінансування;
— працював(ла) з growth-стратегіями, а не лише cost control;
— маєш досвід прийняття рішень в умовах невизначеності;
— мислиш через value creation, ROIC, довгострокову вартість бізнесу;
— можеш пояснити складні фінансові концепції через реальні кейси;
— будував(ла) фінансову функцію як систему, а не лише звітність;
— Готовність ділитися досвідом через реальні кейси, розбір процесу мислення, помилок та прийнятих рішень;
— В тебе легко вдається передати іншим свій ентузіазм та любов до фінансів.

Просто чудово і буде перевагою, коли ти також:
— маєш досвід M&A (оцінка, due diligence, інтеграція)
— працював(ла) з інвесторами або фондами (VC/PE)
— брав(ла) участь у масштабуванні бізнесу або підготовці до exit
— проводив(ла) стратегічні сесії
— маєш досвід викладання або менторства middle/senior спеціалістів
— вже взаємодіяв/ла з нашим Інститутом раніше.

Тому якщо коротко, то загалом будуть 2 основні задачі:
1. Написати програми курсу (розробити ідею курсової роботи, розробити домашні завдання та наповнити курс матеріалами для вебінарів)
2. Провести курс (онлайн вебінари 2 рази на тиждень, перевірка та фідбек на домашні завдання, комунікація з студентами).

Дізнатися більше про кураторство в Projector Institute — клац.

Бути частиною команди — це:— мати цілковиту довіру та допомогу у разі потреби від команди (маємо корпоративні лекції, як допоможуть стати і бути найкращим автором та куратором);
— мати можливість вдосконалювати свої навички комунікації, наставництва та педагогіки;
— бути в оточені людей, які закохані у свою справу;
— мати гнучкий графік (часткова зайнятість, що дає змогу поєднувати з іншими заняттями);
— мати знижку на всі освітні продукти Projector та корпоративну підписку на Projector Library.

Якщо все вище тобі відгукується, і ти хочеш допомогти фінансистам перейти від ролі “контролера” до ролі CFO — людини, яка визначає, куди рухається бізнес, — будемо раді познайомитися

Так, Вільна Освіта, яка допомагає людям будувати карʼєру на ринку tech&creative професій – існує. І саме ти можеш стати рушієм її вдосконалення та масштабування.

jobs.description:
Шукаємо автора/ку курсу “Product Management Advanced” — людину, яка вміє допомогти PM-ам перейти від execution mindset до product ownership mindset: приймати рішення через дані, discovery, бізнес-цінність, технічні trade-offs, growth, retention, monetization, AI і складну взаємодію зі стейкхолдерами.

Ми у ProjectorInstituteстворюємо курси, які допомагають спеціалістам робити якісний стрибок у професії. Працюємо з практиками з індустрії й будуємо навчання навколо реального досвіду, а не теорії.

Для цього курсу шукаємо спеціаліста/-ку, який/-а вже працює на senior / lead product-рівні та може показати, як виглядає зріле продуктове мислення в реальній команді. Нам потрібна людина, яка вміє пояснити, як PM будує партнерство з engineering, приймає рішення без повної інформації, пише сильні specs, працює зі stakeholder pressure, розбирає growth loops, читає retention, думає про monetization, використовує AI в роботі й захищає продуктові рішення через impact.

(на створення курсу передбачено 2–3 місяці, далі — запуск і проведення)
Кого ми бачимо перед собою, коли уявляємо ідеальногоавтора/ку курсу “Product Management Advanced”
  • ти Senior Product Manager, Lead Product Manager, Group Product Manager, Principal PM або Product Lead із досвідом у продуктовій компанії, SaaS, mobile, marketplace, fintech, edtech, B2B або іншому digital-продукті
  • добре розумієш різницю між middle PM, який керує задачами, і senior PM, який будує довіру, приймає складні рішення, працює з невизначеністю та відповідає за impact
  • ти маєш сильний досвід роботи з продуктовими метриками
  • вмієш проводити discovery на senior-рівні
  • працював/-ла з growth, retention і monetization не на рівні теорії, а через реальні задачі
  • можеш навчити PM-а говорити з engineering як партнер
  • впевнено працюєш зі складними стейкхолдерами
  • розумієш, як AI змінює роботу PM-а: аналіз research, аналітика, документація, prompt engineering для PM, AI-аудит власного workflow
  • ти можеш навчати через практику: симуляції PM / Engineering конфліктів, stakeholder review з pressure, написання specs, growth loop mapping, retention-аудит, onboarding redesign, monetization analysis, AI-feature spec, discovery sprint і фінальний product case
Просто чудово і буде перевагою, коли ти також:
  • маєш досвід розвитку PM-ів до middle / senior рівня: менторство, hiring, performance review, career calibration
  • працював/-ла у growth-команді або відповідав/-ла за retention, activation, monetization чи pricing
  • маєш досвід запуску AI-фіч або AI-enabled продуктів
  • можеш принести на курс власні продуктові кейси
  • вмієш працювати з Amplitude, Mixpanel, GA4, Looker Studio, product dashboards або іншими аналітичними інструментами
  • маєш досвід у SaaS, marketplace, subscription, mobile, fintech, edtech, productivity або B2B-продуктах
  • можеш давати студентам глибокий фідбек по product cases
  • вмієш говорити про Product Management без культу фреймворків
Тому якщо коротко, то загалом будуть 2 основні задачі:
  1. Написати програми курсу разом із командою Projector Institute: сформувати структуру модулів, логіку занять, практичні завдання, симуляції, домашки, фінальний product case і навчальний шлях, який допоможе студентам перейти від execution mindset до product ownership mindset.
  2. Провести курс: вести заняття, пояснювати складні продуктові теми простою мовою, розбирати кейси, давати студентам персональний фідбек, проводити симуляції складних PM-ситуацій і допомагати їм працювати як middle / senior-level product managers — через дані, discovery, бізнес-логіку, технічну взаємодію та impact.
Дізнатися більше про кураторство в Projector Institute — клац.

Бути частиною команди — це:
— працювати з сильною продюсерською командою
— мати свободу у створенні курсу, але з підтримкою методистів
— впливати на рівень освіти на ринку
— працювати з мотивованою аудиторією дорослих студентів
— розвивати свій публічний профіль як експерта

jobs.description:
Шукаємо автора/ку курсу «AI for Paid Ads» — людину, яка допоможе досвідченим performance-маркетологам перейти від точкового використання AI до власної AI Operating System: з агентами, автоматизованими workflow, контрольованими експериментами та вимірюваним впливом на щоденну роботу.

Ми у Projector Institute створюємо освіту, яка справді змінює кар’єрні траєкторії. Нам важливо, щоб навчання було прикладним, чесним і побудованим на досвіді людей, які продовжують працювати у професії.

Шукаємо активного/ну performance-практика, який/а керує великими рекламними бюджетами, глибоко працює з Meta Ads і Google Ads та вже інтегрував/ла AI у реальні операційні процеси. Не на рівні «попросити ChatGPT написати оголошення», а на рівні агентів, автоматизованого аналізу, запуску й перевірки гіпотез, контролю кампаній та системної економії часу.

Разом ми створимо курс, на якому студенти не просто протестують кілька AI-інструментів, а побудують власну робочу систему, проведуть holdout-тест і зможуть показати конкретний результат: скільки годин заощаджено, скільки гіпотез перевірено та які процеси вдалося прискорити.

(на створення курсу передбачено 2–3 місяці, далі — запуск і проведення у форматі живих онлайн-занять, практики в рекламних кабінетах та перевірки домашніх завдань)

Що ми бачимо перед собою, коли уявляємо ідеального/ну автора/ку курсу «AI for Performance Marketing»:

— ти Senior Performance Marketing Lead, Head of Performance, Head of Paid Acquisition, User Acquisition Lead або Growth Lead із сильною експертизою в медіабаїнгу;

— особисто ведеш або куруєш рекламні кабінети із сукупним бюджетом від $100k на місяць;

— маєш глибоку практику в Meta Ads і Google Ads та можеш працювати з реальними кампаніями наживо;

— відповідаєш не лише за запуск реклами, а й за систему тестування, масштабування, контролю бюджетів та оцінки результату;

— регулярно використовуєш AI та автоматизацію у власних процесах: будуєш агентів, workflow, інтеграції, автоматизовані звіти, алерти або сценарії аналізу кампаній;

Join Amgen’s Mission of Serving Patients

At Amgen, if you feel like you’re part of something bigger, it’s because you are. Our shared mission—to serve patients living with serious illnesses—drives all that we do.

Since 1980, we’ve helped pioneer the world of biotech in our fight against the world’s toughest diseases. With our focus on four therapeutic areas –Oncology, Inflammation, General Medicine, and Rare Disease– we reach millions of patients each year. Amgen is advancing a broad and deep pipeline of medicines to treat cancer, heart disease, inflammatory conditions, rare diseases, and obesity and obesity-related conditions. As a member of the Amgen team, you’ll help make a lasting impact on the lives of patients as we research, manufacture, and deliver innovative medicines to help people live longer, fuller happier lives.

Our award-winning culture is collaborative, innovative, and science based. If you have a passion for challenges and the opportunities that lay within them, you’ll thrive as part of the Amgen team. Join us and transform the lives of patients while transforming your career.

Senior Manager, Master Data Management & Reference Data

What you will do

Let’s do this. Let’s change the world. In this vital role you will translate business priorities into scalable data capabilities, establish enterprise data standards, and lead cross-functional delivery across business and technology teams. Amgen is seeking an experienced data management leader with biotechnology or pharmaceutical industry experience to advance enterprise Master Data Management (MDM), Reference Data, and Data Governance capabilities.

Experience with Reltio MDM and/or ontology and terminology management platforms, such as SciBite or TopQuadrant, is required.

  • Serve as the data engagement lead for an assigned business function, applying knowledge of its data, standards, processes, and priorities to deliver measurable data improvements.

The Senior Legal Contract Manager is responsible for independently reviewing, redlining, negotiating, and managing sponsor-facing legal and commercial contracts. This role primarily supports Master Services Agreements (MSAs), including sponsor-provided templates, Confidential Disclosure Agreements (CDAs), MSA amendments, ad hoc sponsor contracts, contract notices, and related documentation. The position requires the ability to apply internal guidance documents, playbooks, approved fallback positions, and standard clauses; identify, resolve, and appropriately escalate legal, operational, financial, regulatory, and business issues; propose practical contract language; and manage contract matters from intake through execution. The role involves frequent interaction with sponsors, Finance, Business Development, Operations, Therapeutic Leaders, Legal Counsel, and senior stakeholders, including participation in and management of sponsor/client negotiation calls. The Senior Legal Contract Manager is expected to prioritize contract matters based on business urgency, deal impact, revenue considerations, and operational need while representing the company professionally in sponsor negotiations. What you will do Review, redline, comment on, and negotiate MSAs, including sponsor-provided templates and amendments to existing MSAs. Review, draft, revise, and negotiate CDAs, MSA amendments, contract notices, ad hoc sponsor agreements, and other sponsor-facing contract documents. Apply internal contract guidance documents, playbooks, approved fallback positions, and Worldwide standard clauses when reviewing and revising sponsor templates and proposed contract language. Identify contract terms that create legal, operational, financial, regulatory, or business risk; independently resolve routine issues; and escalate material, non-standard, or higher-risk issues to Legal, Finance, Operations, Business Development, Therapeutic Leaders, senior management, and other stakeholders as appropriate. Draft and propose alternative contract language that supports business objectives while protecting Worldwide’s legal and commercial interests. Evaluate the commercial and operational impact of contract terms, including implications for revenue, payment terms, scope, timelines, deliverables, and operational execution. Job Location: London, Greater London, United Kingdom

At IQVIA, our Senior Project Managers play a pivotal role in bringing innovative medicines to patients worldwide. You'll provide strategic leadership for complex global clinical trials, partnering directly with sponsors and cross-functional teams to deliver studies that accelerate the development of life-changing therapies.

This is an opportunity to lead large-scale, multi-regional studies focused on renal, obesity and/or MASH (Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatohepatitis) for some of the world's most innovative pharmaceutical and biotechnology companies while expanding your leadership impact and helping shape the future of clinical research.

Why Join Global Study Leadership?

Global Study Leadership is a global, full-service team delivering clinical trials through both therapeutically aligned and customer-dedicated delivery models. You'll work on some of the industry's most complex global clinical trials, partnering directly with leading pharmaceutical and biotechnology sponsors across therapeutic areas including Oncology, Rare Disease, CNS, Cardiovascular, Immunology, Respiratory, Renal, Obesity, MASH (Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatohepatitis), Cell & Gene Therapy, Infectious Disease, Ophthalmology and Women's Health. Supported by a collaborative global network, flexible ways of working and AI-enabled technology and data-driven insights, you'll have exceptional opportunities to broaden your expertise, expand your leadership impact and accelerate your career within one of the world's leading clinical research organizations.

What You'll Be Doing

As the strategic leader of your studies, you'll be accountable for the successful delivery of complex global clinical trials from start-up through close-out, ensuring quality, timeline, budget, regulatory and customer objectives are achieved.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the delivery of complex global and multi-regional clinical studies, driving operational excellence and successful study outcomes

  • Serve as the primary strategic partner for sponsors, providing leadership, guidance and innovative solutions to drive successful study outcomes

  • Provide leadership and direction to cross-functional teams across regions, fostering collaboration, accountability and high performance

  • Oversee study timelines, budgets, quality, risks, financial performance and operational delivery to ensure study success

  • Drive proactive risk management, issue resolution, decision-making and stakeholder alignment throughout the study lifecycle

  • Ensure studies are delivered in compliance with ICH-GCP, regulatory requirements and contractual commitments

What We're Looking For

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences, Healthcare or a related scientific discipline

  • 7+ years of clinical research experience, including significant project management experience leading global or multi-regional clinical trials within a CRO, pharmaceutical or biotechnology environment

  • Experience leading renal, obesity and/or MASH (Metabolic Dysfunction-Associated Steatohepatitis) global clinical studies is strongly preferred

  • Strong knowledge of clinical trial conduct, ICH-GCP guidelines and applicable regulatory requirements

  • Proven success leading cross-functional teams and managing study delivery, including timelines, budgets, quality, risks and operational performance

  • Demonstrated ability to build trusted sponsor relationships and effectively manage senior stakeholders in a global environment

  • Exceptional leadership, communication, problem-solving and decision-making skills

  • Passion for advancing clinical research and improving patient outcomes

Build Your Future with IQVIA

If you're looking for a role that combines global exposure, strategic leadership, sponsor partnership and meaningful work, we'd love to hear from you. At IQVIA, you'll have the opportunity to work on high-profile global studies, collaborate with industry-leading sponsors, leverage cutting-edge technology and build a rewarding career with one of the world's leading clinical research organizations, all while helping bring innovative treatments to patients faster.

Position Summary

Shift paradigm is seeking a Full-Stack Developer with deep, hands-on Adobe Edge Delivery Services (EDS) experience and broader modern web and platform skills to join our team in building high-performance, composable web experiences. The role is best suited to someone who is comfortable in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments, where requirements evolve quickly, priorities shift, and the right path forward is not always fully defined at the outset. This role works directly with our clients on large, complex projects, so client facing or agency experience is a huge plus!

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain high-performance, edge-rendered websites and web applications using Adobe Edge Delivery Services (EDS), developing reusable, semantic, high-performance blocks and components in native JavaScript, HTML5, and modern CSS3
  • Serve as a secondary point of ownership and backup for our existing EDS-based digital properties, working alongside our current developer to ensure coverage, continuity, and shared architectural decision-making
  • Scaffold and configure new EDS projects on the AEM boilerplate, managing .hlx project configuration, routing/rewrites, and config.yaml
  • Own page-loading performance: tune eager, lazy, and delayed loading phases (loadEager, loadLazy, loadDelayed) and programmatic auto-blocking to hit elite Core Web Vitals (LCP, INP, CLS) and Lighthouse scores
  • Bridge engineering and content teams by configuring and optimizing document-based authoring workflows (Google Docs, Microsoft Word, Adobe Document Authoring)
  • Manage a Git-first deployment workflow (GitHub, GitHub Actions) where code changes sync directly to the edge, and work with CDN/edge configuration (e.g., Fastly, Cloudflare), including caching and TTL strategy
  • Serve as a client-facing technical resource, translating client requirements into working solutions and clearly explaining technical trade-offs to non-technical stakeholders
  • Integrate EDS-delivered pages with the broader Adobe ecosystem where needed (AEM Assets, headless APIs) and with CRM/MarTech systems as our platform strategy requires
  • Leverage AI/agentic coding tools (e.g., Copilot, Claude Code, Cursor) to plan and execute development work, from task decomposition to autonomous or semi-autonomous code generation and review.
  • Participate in technical discovery, estimation, and solutioning conversations with clients during project kickoff and delivery, as needed.
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-documented code and contribute to code reviews and engineering best practices

Required Qualifications

  • 4+ years of professional full-stack development experience, including 2+ years of hands-on experience building, testing, and launching live production websites on Adobe Edge Delivery Services (EDS) - or a strong AEM background with demonstrated, fast ramp-up on EDS
  • Expert-level native/vanilla JavaScript (ES6+), semantic HTML5, and modern CSS3 (custom properties, Grid/Flexbox), with sound judgment about when a heavier framework (React, Angular, Vue) is or isn’t the right tool for EDS-based pages
  • Proven track record optimizing for Core Web Vitals Largest Contentful Paint (LCP), Interaction to Next Paint (INP), and Cumulative Layout Shift (CLS) and Lighthouse performance
  • Working proficiency in React and Next.js for building non-EDS front-end applications and internal tools
  • Mastery of Git/GitHub workflows: branching, pull requests, code review, and CI automation (e.g., GitHub Actions)
  • Experience with DevOps practices and tooling (CI/CD pipeline design, infrastructure-as-code, containerization, or cloud deployment) beyond basic GitHub Actions usage
  • Experience with document-based authoring and document-to-HTML content workflows
  • Experience with back-end development and API/integration work (REST, GraphQL, or similar)
  • Proven experience working directly with clients or business stakeholders in a client-facing capacity
  • Demonstrated ability to thrive in fast-paced, high-ambiguity environments with shifting priorities and evolving requirements
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, and the professional maturity to operate as a long-term, trusted member of the team
  • Comfortable working independently and taking ownership of deliverables with limited day-to-day direction

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience migrating legacy AEM Sites (HTL/Sightly, OSGi, Sling Models) to a modern EDS architecture
  • Hands-on experience with agentic AI development workflows - both planning multi-step technical work for AI agents to execute and directly operating agentic coding tools in production codebases.
  • Experience with .NET/C# for back-end services or API development
  • Experience with edge/CDN configuration (e.g., Fastly, Cloudflare), including caching strategy and Edge-Side Includes (ESI)
  • Experience with the broader Adobe Experience Cloud (Adobe Target, Adobe Launch / Web SDK, AEM Assets)
  • Experience in a digital agency or consulting environment supporting multiple concurrent client engagements
  • SEO fundamentals, Open Graph/schema configuration, and edge-side analytics implementation
  • Adobe certifications

Compensation & Benefits

The salary range for this role is $130,000 to $145,000 USD. Salary is based on several factors including but not limited to skillset, relevant education, level of experience, certifications, and scope of responsibilities.

In addition to base salary, SH/FT offers benefits such as medical, dental, vision, STD/LTD, Life/AD&D, Flexible Paid Time Off, and various other ancillary benefits and perks.

We welcome and encourage applications from people with disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process.

Candidates must have current US or Canada work authorization. For US candidates, this employer participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the US.

No relocation assistance can be offered at this time.

All inquiries are held in strict confidence.
